sanskrit: saṃnidhattāṃ ca me vāṇī bhuvanatrayavanditāsevitaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiśca bhūtapreta piśācakaiḥtadā brahmā samutthāya praṇamya stutavānprabhumprasīda jagatāṃ nātha ! prasīdānandadāvyaya !sahasrapādayuktāya śarvāya paramātmanehuṃkārāya namastubhyaṃ vaṣaṭkārāya te namaḥsarvajñāya śaraṇyāya sadyo jātāya te namaḥanantāsana saṃyuktamanantāyānta kāriṇeyogapīṭhāntarasthāya yogine yogadāyineparāya parameśāya nirguṇāya namo'stuteadhvānadāyine tubhyaṃ ṣaḍadhvāya namo'stutepratyāhārasthitānāṃ tu pratiṣṭhānāṃ sthitāya cadhāraṇābhyāsa yuktānāṃ purastātsaṃsthitāya cadhyeyāya dhyeyagamyāya dhyeyādhyeyāya te namaḥsamādhinā'dhigamyāya samādhānāya te namaḥsahasrākṣaradevāya ayutākṣararūpiṇe* * * * * * * ṇi tvayāntamapurā prabhopitāmaha mahāprājña ! mayā nigaditā śṛṇuaṣṭāṣṭau ca sthānāni śṛṇu ca tapodhananaimiśe devadevaśa gayāyāṃ prapitāmahapuṣkare jaraje gandhiṃ viśvantavimaleśvaramujjayinyāṃ mahākālyaṃ mahākāṭe madotkaṭamrudrakoṭyāṃ mahāyogī mahāliṃgaṃ sthaleśvaresvarṇākṣe sahasrākṣaṃ vṛṣe ca vṛṣabhadhvajamsūryaṃ kanakhale caiva bhadrakarṇe sadāśivam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvaretāstri siddhāyāṃ kāraṇḍe tu kapardinamdhyāne śuddheśvaraṃ caiva gāyatryā muktakeśvarasamaliṃgaṃ virasthāṇuṃ kapāliṃ karavīrakedīpte marukeśvaro jñeyaṃ nepāle tu paśoḥ patimgaṃgāsāre amara * * * * mokāramarejaṭilaṃ vāmeśvaraṃ caiva saumyaṃ ca kakudeśvaraujapyeśvare triśūlaṃ ca śrīśaile tripurāntakamhemakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ bhūbhuvaṃ gandhamādanedānavānāṃ vadhārthāya vārāhaṃ vinyakeśvarelaṃkāyāmardhadevaisaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaramaṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ tu nāmāni mayā proktāni te'naghaiti vīratantre aṣṭaṣaṣṭisthāna (kathanaṃ nāma) prathamaḥ paṭalaḥtantrāṇāmudbhavaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhotanoti vipulānarthāntatvamantra samāśritānkāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathāvijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tathānalamcandrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathākiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caiva aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhitāḥkāmikaṃ caiva viprendra trividhaṃ bhedamucyatecintyaṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ saptadhā kāraṇaṃ bhavetsuprabhedasya vikhyātaṃ bhedamanyanna vidyatevimalaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa aṃśumānsuprabhedakamvīraṃ ca rauravaṃ caiva makuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathāsvāyaṃbhuve viśeṣeṇa tadvidhena pravakṣyatevīratantraṃ ca viprendra trayodaśaṃ bhedamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: makuṭākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ dvividhenābhidhīyatecandrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca caturdaśavidhaṃ bhavetprodgītākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhedamucyatesiddhatantraṃ ca viprendra caturvidhena cocyateśarvoktaṃ tu mahātantraṃ paṃcabhedena cocyatekiraṇākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ navadhā bhedamucyatetantrakāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava snehādviśeṣataḥjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ devavanmukhamucyatemukhaṃ prati triṇetraṃ syātsarvāṃgalakṣaṇairyutaḥtatra kāyaṃ mahāproktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanamcaturdaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi paṃcadaśāṃgulaṃ tu vāaṣṭādaśāṃgulaṃ vāpi navadaśāṃgulaṃ tu vādvāviṃśatirvā viprendra kārayeddeśikottamaḥutsedhaṃ cāṣṭadhā hitvā ekāṃgulaṃ caiva vistaramtribhāgaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ madhye suṣiramucyateśeṣamāyamiti proktaṃ guṇaireva vivarjayetpadaṃ pratiguṇe vṛddhiraṣṭabhirhrāsayettataḥsaptaviṃśatibhirhrāsaṃ labdhamiṣṭamiti smṛtamtriṃśadbhirhrāsayettāni śeṣaṃ tithirihocyateśeṣaṃ vāramiti proktaṃ āyaṃ vyayaṃ ca yoni caāyādhikaṃ vyayaṃ hīnaṃ saṃpatkaramihocyatetasmātsarvaprayatnena āyahīnaṃ na kārayetdhū?mraśvā gardabhaṃ kāko doṣānyetāni varjayetevaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kartavyaṃ pustakaṃ paramviśvāmitro'tha vālmīkiḥ kāśyapaścāṅgirāstathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturdaśāṃgulādīni kramādvinyasya dehinaḥjagatī śatvarī caiva atiśatvari eva cabrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva cacaturdaśāṃgulādīni devānāmihacocyateṣaṭpaṃktirvātha paṃcairvā lekhayetpustakaṃ tataḥpaṃktirevaṃ samākhyātaṃ tattannāmādhidevatāṛṣīṇāṃ bhūrjapatre tu lekhayettu dvijottamadvau pārśvakampa saṃyuktau pustakāyamatatsamamśivāgre maṇḍapaṃ kuryādīśāne dakṣiṇe'pi vāvedībāhye tu paritaḥ paṃca kuṇḍāni kārayetsthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitamyathāṃkurārpaṇaṃ kuryātpaṃcāhe vā tryahepi vāsa hiraṇyaṃ sakūrcaṃ ca somarājādhidaivatamvinyasettu viśeṣeṇa pālikāścāṣṭadikṣu cahṛdayena tu mantreṇa bījāni vinyasettataḥsuptadeśe samutthāpya pālikāḥ sthāpayettataḥsvarṇena tantunā vipra kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdālepayetpustakaṃ tatra śayane śāyayettataḥśālyardhāṃstaṇḍulānnyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilānnyasettattadāgamabījena śāyayecchayanopariādyakṣarasamāyukta manusvārasamanvitamvastreṇāveṣṭayettatra pustakaṃ ca viśeṣataḥsarasvatīṃ nyasettatra pustakasya tu madhyameśuddhodakena saṃpūrya sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakammūlamantreṇa vinyasya arcayettu viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa vastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcādīni vinyasetbalavikariṇīṃ balapramathinīṃ sarvabhūta damanīmhṛdayādīṣasaṃghaiśca pūjayettu vidhānataḥpālāśaḥ pūrvatobhāge aśvatthaṃ dakṣiṇe tathāudumbaraṃ tathaiśānyāṃ pālāśairvāpi hūyatesamidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa īśānenājyameva casarṣapānsadyamantreṇa netreṇa tu yavāṃstathāsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyatedravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pustakaṃ sparśayeddhṛdāsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaretattadāgamabījena prokṣayedbardhanīṃ tataḥhavirnivedayetpaścāttāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥbrāhmaṇānpūjayettatra saptakanyāśca pūjayetkāpālaṃ paṃcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍete samayāḥ smṛtāḥtantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyatiaṣṭāviṃśatibhedena śaivabhedaṃ vidhīyatedīkṣitasya subīrasya śivabhaktiratasya caadīkṣitaṃ na śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cittantrāvatāramevoktaṃ paṃcākṣaraṃ tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahastrikāyāṃ tantrāvatāro dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥśrīpaṃcākṣarakalpaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho !namaskāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayamtadvargāntaṃ saptamaṃ syātpaṃcākṣaramiti smṛtamcaturthyā tu samāyuktaṃ paṃcākṣaramiti smṛtamyakāreṇa samāyuktaṃ paṃcākṣaramihocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛgvedo jāyate vipra nakārākṣaramucyateatharvavede vākāraṃ yakāramitihāsakeśikāraṃ taijasamāyuktaṃ vākāraṃ vāyumeva canakāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu īśvareṇa samāyutamsthānaṃ sadyomukhaṃ caiva nakārākṣaramucyateanuṣṭhubhchandasāyuktaṃ mantriṇā ca samāyutamvākāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu skandastatrādhidaivatampuruṣasya mukhaṃ sthānaṃ vākārākṣaramucyatesāvitrī chandasā yuktaṃ bhāradvājena saṃyutampaṃcākṣaramiti proktaṃ praṇavaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥakāraṃ brahmadaivatyamukāraṃ viṣṇudaivatamṛgvedastu akāraḥ syādyajurvedamukārakamakāraṃ sātvikaṃ vidyādukāraṃ rājasaṃ bhavetukāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyānmakāramābhicārakammakāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ syādevameva krameṇa tuoṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramihocyateaṃgulyā prajapedekaṃ paṃcadhā mṛṇmayaṃ bhavetśatasaṃkhyaistu vijñeyaṃ pravālaistu sahasrakampadmākṣaiḥ koṭiguṇitaṃ sauvarṇairdaśakoṭikamnyāsaṃ kuryāttato mantrī paṃcākṣaramihocyatekaniṣṭhādyaṃguṣṭhāntaṃ saṃhāranyāsamucyatekaranyāsaṃ purākṛtvā aṃganyāsaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuśikāraṃ karṇadeśe tu makāraṃ hṛdaye nyasetsarvāṃgeṣu ca viprendra oṃkāraṃ vinyasettataḥpaṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśairvā japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japaṃ kuryāttu viprendra praṇavena samāyutamnadītīre śataṃ vidyātsahasraṃ devatālayepaṃcaviṃśantato lakṣairvaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnuyātpraviśecchivamīśānaṃ * * saṃsāra sāgarātiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīpaṃcākṣarakalpastṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥsarvapāpa(praṇāśā)rthaṃ mantroddhāraḥ kathaṃ bhavetmananaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarātgaṃgākūle samudre vā prabhāse vā viśeṣataḥanyeṣu śuddhadeśeṣu mantramuddhārayetkramātsnānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra tatsthāne mantramuddharetācāryastu śucirbhūtvā kṛtopavāsasaṃyutamratnena * * * vipra akṣaraṃ lekhayeddhṛdābindornādassamutpannastasmācchaktirajāyatakalāyā vyaṃjanaṃ jātaṃ vyaṃjanā * * mantrakaḥavargaṃ ca kavargaṃ ca cavargaṃ ca ṭavargakamādivargeṣu ṛ-ṛca caturakṣaraṃ varjayetpūrvaṃ hṛsvaṃ samākhyātaṃ paraṃ dīrghamihocyatesadyojātaṃ tu gokṣīra sadṛśaṃ varṇamucyatepuruṣaṃ kuṃkumaprakhyaṃ īśānaṃ sphaṭikaṃ bhavetdvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ sustanāṃ ca suyauvanāmṣadaṃgaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi hṛdayaṃ ca śirastathāindudhūmraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca kiṃciddhūmraṃ tathaiva caṣaḍaṃgānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mantraṃ varṇaṃ vicintayetjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktāṃ yajñopavītasaṃyutāmstrīrūpaṃ bhāvayedbrahmā ṣaḍaṃgaṃ puruṣo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavetraktapaṃkajasaṃyuktaṃ bhinnāñjanasamaprabhamakṣarasyādisaṃyuktaṃ binduṃ caiva samāyutamśivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ prathamaṃ cāṣṭavargakeprathamasyākādasaṃgṛhya śivaviṣṇusamāyutampaṃcamasya prathamaṃ syādvitīyaṃ saptamasya caaṣṭamasyādi samāyuktaṃ māyānalasamanvitamprathamasya dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitamgaṇāmbikā ca caṇḍeśo nandīśaśca tathaiva cabhṛṃgīśaśca mahāsenaḥ svanāmādyakṣarairyutamvāyussomastatheśāno brahmā viṣṇuśca saṃyutamvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśamsvanāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitamśrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṃgalamṣaṣṭhavargāddvitīyaṃ tu caturthādyena saṃyutamvisargeṇa samāyuktaṃ pāśupatāstramucyatebindunādasamāyuktamācāryaṃ bījamucyatemātrāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca * * * gaṇameva camūrtipānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāmevameva krameṇa tuyakārādidvayaṃ vargaṃ caturakṣaramucyateanantāsanaṃ tadviprendra yogāsanaṃ tathaiva cavimalāsanaṃ tu viprendra svanāmādyakṣarairyutamāgneyamaṇḍalaṃ caiva vinyasettu viśeṣataḥtatvāmaṇḍalamevoktaṃ svanāmādyakṣarairyutamvyomavyāpi mahāmantraṃ ṣaṇṇavatyakṣarairyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvādaśasya padasya bahiśyadvivitathā punammantramuccāryate vipra sarvakāmānavāpnuyātśivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ śivamantramihocyatevyomaśca rūpāśca vaścaivaṃ rūpāyaśvata eva cataśca yaścaiva dhvāyaśca pukamaśvadṛdṛmaśca cadaśca pāśca vineraśca neśca miśca na eva caevaṃ krameṇa viprendra vinyasedastramantravitniścayaśca gīpaścaiva tumaguśca jātaśca bhāśca tavyoścaścaiva ye yośca omaśca dhaśca eva caviśca sarva oṃ bhraśca jaścedīriśca vāyaniścaevaṃ krameṇa vinyāsaṃ sarvakāmānavāpnuyātagastyena samāyuktaṃ bṛhatīcchandasā yutamvasiṣṭhena samāyuktaṃ prakṛticchandasā yutamācāryasya tu bījasya ṛṣicchando devatāatriṇā ca samāyuktaṃ paṃcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥjagatī śakvarī caiva anuṣṭubtriṣṭhubheva caāgameva tu bījāni pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ* * * * dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādavibhūṣitamsaptamasyādisaṃyuktaṃ trayodaśa samanvitamtṛtīyasyādimaṃ gṛhya saptamasya tṛtīyakamcintyākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyasyādisaṃyutamkāraṇākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ prathamasyādi saṃyutambindunādasamāyuktamajitākṣaramucyatedvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitamdvādaśa svara saṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu māyābījena saṃyutamantyākṣarasamāyuktamādyakṣarasamanvitamaṣṭavargāttṛtīyaṃ tu analena samāyutaḥsuprabhedākṣaraṃ proktaṃ saptavargasya cādikamvijayaṃ caiva viprendra paṃcamasyāntasaṃyutamniśvāsatantra mevoktamaṣṭavargatṛtīyakambindunādasamāyuktaṃ vīratantramihocyateakṣarāṇāṃ paraśreṣṭhaṃ rauravaṃ procyate mayāmāyānalasamāyuktaṃ makuṭākṣaramucyatebindunādasamāyuktaṃ vimalaṃ caiva kathyatebindunādasamāyuktaṃ candrajñānamihocyatebindunādasamāyuktaṃ bimbasyākṣaramucyatebindunādasamāyuktaṃ prodgītaṃ ca mayocyatebindunādasamāyuktaṃ lalitasya tu mantrakamanalena samāyuktaṃ siddhatantramihocyatesaptamasya dvitīyena bindunādasamanvitamdvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitammāyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunāda samanvitamdvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitammāyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitamṛṣicchandodaivatānvakṣye āgamānāṃ viśeṣataḥtavarūpeṇa saṃyuktaṃ kāmikādīni sapta cajagatīcchandasāyuktaṃ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatamadīkṣitaṃ na śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ na prakāśataḥaṣṭavargatṛtīyāntā ādyakṣarasamāyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ tadardhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavetyaṣṭinā saṃghaṭitvā tu dhvajamāropayettataḥyāgasya maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā īśe vā cāgnigocarepaṃcaṣaṭsaptahastairvā ṣoḍaśastambha saṃyutamvedibāhye tu paritaḥ paṃcakuṇḍāni kārayetvedīmadhye nyasecchālīṃ darbhaiścaiva paristaretabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasecchālimadhyamesa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sa hiraṇyānsakūrcakānsamidājyacaruṃ lājān apūpena samanvitamgaṇānāṃceti hutvā tu pūrṇāhutiṃ yadasya caśūlaṃ para"'sukhaḍgaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ padmaṃ ca saṃyutamprathamaṃ bhūtarātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ gandhamucyatesiddhānāṃ paṃcamaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ rākṣasamucyatepaṃcāhaṃ ṛṣirātrādi siddhāditryahaṃ bhavetkautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇamsnapayetkalaśaṃ tatra hṛdayena tu deśikaḥsādhitaiḥ kalaśaistatra snāpayenmūlaberakamprāgagraṃ tu catussūtraṃ udagagraṃ tathaiva capūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalaśānnyasya vittamaḥdvitīyāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvarāṃśca daivatānpradhāna kumbhe svarṇasya pādyaṃ pūrve tu vinyasetnair-ṛtyāṃ gandhatoyaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ tu kuśodakamīśānyāṃ dadhi saṃyuktaṃ prathamāvaraṇānviterajanī cūrṇaṃ tu kadalītilasarṣapa saṃyutamnāraṃgasya dvayaṃ caiva dvitīyāvaraṇe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ vai snapanaṃ kuryāt sarvaśāntikaraṃ paramsthāpane paṃcaniṣkaṃ tu utsave tu dviniṣkakammūrtipānparivārāṇāṃ yathā śaktyā tu dakṣiṇāiti vīratantre vighneśasthāpanārcanasnapanotsavavidhiraṣṭapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥguruvaktrāttu vijñeyamanyathā naiva kathyateīśādi sadyaparyantaṃ uddharettu yathākramamcakraṃ trayodaśaṃ grāhya paṃcādaśa samanvitamvāsavasya caturthaṃ tu śūlādyaṃ tu yathā tathāvajrāntena samāyuktaṃ īśānasya tṛtīyakamtadeva punaruddhṛtya agnibījordhvavāsavamvaruṇasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitamvajrāddvitīyasaṃyuktaṃ varuṇasya tu paṃcamamvāsavasya caturthaṃ tu śaṃkarānyamataḥ paramsomasyaiva dvitīyaṃ tu ṣoḍaśena samanvitam* * * * * * * * punastadbīja saṃyutamvaruṇāpati saṃgrāhya cakrasyāntena saṃyutamgadāvāyostukaṃ dvitīya sthānena samanvitampuruhūtadvitīyaṃ tu pūrvoktena samanvitammārutādyaṃ samuddhṛtya cakrāmudrā * * * *mārutasya dvitīyāntaṃ vahnāvāsava saṃyutamanilasya paṃcamenaiva vāsavasya dvitīyakamdhanadasya caturthena yuktaṃ cakratrayodaśamśaṃkarasya dvitīyāntaṃ varuṇādyena saṃyutamdvitīyāntavāsavasyāntaṃ vāsavasya trayodaśamsomāntaṃ tu daśāntena pavanasya caturthakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitamvahnibījordhva * * * dvāsavena samanvitamekādaśena saṃyuktaṃ mārutasya caturthakamjalādhipa caturthāntaṃ vāsavennaṃ samanvitamīśānasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsa * * * śāntakamvahnibīja samāyuktaṃ vāsavena samanvitamanilaṃ tu samuddhṛtya vāsavaikādaśena tuṣoḍaśena samāyuktaṃ ghoraṃ sarvārthakāmadamdhanadasya ca caturthaṃ tu vajrāntena samanvitamvaruṇāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vāsavaikādaśena cagadāyudhaṃ samuddhṛtya vāsavena samanvitampavanaṃ gṛhya * * * * * nte naiva bhūṣitamśūlasyāntaṃ samuddhṛtya khaḍgāntasyādadhastataḥvaruṇasya paṃcamaṃ gṛhya vāsavena samanvitamgadāntāntāṃ samuddhṛtya vajrapaṃcamabhūṣitamvajrāntena tu saṃyuktaṃ gadāvāsava saṃyutampavanasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya ṣoḍaśena samāyutamsomāntāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vajrāntena samanvitamīśasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya vajreṇaiva samanvitamvahniṃ caiva samuddhṛtya vāsavena samanvitamkuberasya caturthaṃ tu * va tasya tṛtīyakamcandrāntaṃ tu samuddhṛtya cakreṇaiva samāyutamkuberāntaṃ samuddhṛtya indrādyena samāyutamaṃkuśasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vajreṇaiva samāyutamcandrasyaiva caturthaṃ tu vajrāntena samāyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuberāntaṃ vāsavenaiva khaḍgaṃ caiva tu paṃcamampāśasya paṃcamaṃ grāhya vāsavena samanvitamvāsavena samāyuktaṃ vāyupaṃcamameva cavaruṇasya paṃcamaṃ paścād vajreṇaiva samāyutamīśānāntaṃ samuddhṛtya vajreṇaiva vibhūṣitamagnibījaṃ tatordhvaṃ tu vāsavena samāyutamanalasya paṃcamaṃ paścād vajreṇaiva samāyutampavanasya caturthaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitamsadyādīśānāṃ ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadambrahmoddhāramidaṃ proktaṃ vijayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre brahmoddhāravidhirekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥvijayamaṇḍalamevaṃ tu brūhi me śaśibhūṣaṇa !sarvapūjāphalaṃ caiva sarvayajña pitāmaha !sṛṣṭuvanāmanuṣṭhābhiḥ brahmaṇaḥ padadāyikāvijayāpatimanuṣubhiḥ sarvānisya sādhanamviprakṣatriyaviṭchūdrairanyajātistu varjayetpaṃcagavyena saṃsnāpya mahā havirnivedayetprāsādasya purobhāge gomayenānulepayetvaiśyasyāṣṭāṃgulaṃ caiva śūdrāṇāṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulammaṇḍalaṃ tatra madhye tu padapuṣpaṃ tu vinyasetmaṇḍalaṃ tatra vinyasya sahasraṃ vā tadardhakamnityaṃ triṃśapaścatamā vāṣṭottaraṃ śatamevaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrvarukṣaṃ samuddharetyathā śraddhānukālasya nityaṃ maṇḍalapūjanampālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarāvaṃ ca yathākramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭadroṇena śālīnāṃ tadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ bhavetaṃkurānarpayitvā tu jvaladbhirdīpasaṃyutamadhamaṃ caikasandhyāyāṃ nityaṃ dīpasamāyutamevaṃ saptadinaṃ kuryād rātrau caivādhivāsayetṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvāra samanvitamumā maheśakumbhaṃ tu mūla bimbaṃ tu pūjayetsthaṇḍilaṃ tu tadūrdhve tu kuṃbhaṃ caiva tu vinyasetuśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva karpūraṃ caiva kuṃkumamhomayettu viśeṣeṇa sarvadravya samāyutamsa sūtra kūrcasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥprabhāte vimale kuryātsnānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥnṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ stotramaṃgalavācakaiḥsnapanaṃ tu tataḥ kuryādyathā śāstroktamārgataḥdevānāṃ svarṇapaṭṭaṃ tu umāhe matsya maṃgalamsthalikā daṇḍighaṇṭā ca mahāghaṇṭāṃ tu dāpayetsaptamaṇḍalamālikhya saptalokānsupūjayetmaṇḍalaṃ tu pṛthakkuryāt pratyekaṃ prasthaśālināsvarṇaparvatamevaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ parvameva vāmudgaparvatamevaṃ tu saptaparvatameva vāācāryaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ vastrāṃgulīyakādibhiḥuttamaṃ tu triniṣkaṃ tu ācāryasya tu dakṣiṇāsarvaṃ māheśvarairyuktaṃ bāhujānāṃ tu pūjayetvastraṃ dhānyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ candanaṃ dāpayettadāsarvānamāvṛtaṃ kuryāttadgṛhaṃ praviśettataḥārdrāyāṃ caiva nakṣatre deveśaṃ pūjayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchatiiti vīratantre vijayamaṇḍalavidhiḥ ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥtatsarvaṃ brūhi me nātha ! śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabhośailajaṃ ratnajaṃ caiva dhātujaṃ dārujaṃ tathācaturvidhaṃ tu śailaṃ syātsaptadhā ratnajaṃ tathāmṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ saptadhocyateśailajaṃ liṃgamākhyātaṃ dravyasya lakṣaṇamucyatesuśvetaṃ ca samākhyātaṃ jayadaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamśilālakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ dhanadhānya sukhapradambhṛṃgamudgasamākāraṃ pūja * * karī smṛtāviprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ api dhānyasamṛddhidāśvetā prātipadā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥmarakataṃ puṣparāgaṃ ca nīlaṃ caiva tu ratnajāākarṣaṇe tu vaiḍūryaṃ sphaṭikaṃ putravṛddhidamnī * * * raṇe kārye ratnajānāṃ phalaṃ bhavettāmraṃ putrasamṛddhyarthaṃ kāṃsyaṃ vidveṣakārakamsīsakaṃ rogakaraṇaṃ * * māyuṣyavardhanamdevadāru śamīvṛkṣaṃ pippalaṃ candanaṃ tathāmadhūkapadmaḍuṇḍūka karṇikārastathaiva caete vargāstu catvāro dvijātikramayogataḥsaikataṃ gomayaṃ cānnaṃ paiṣṭaṃ gaulaṃ phalaṃ tathāsaikataṃ mokṣakāmānāṃ gomayaṃ roganāśanamgaulaṃ prītipradaṃ proktaṃ phalamiṣṭārtha siddhidamkṣaṇikānāṃ tu liṃgānāṃ na kuryātpīṭhabandhanamprayāṇakāśakra nānāntu śubhāśubhaparīkṣakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhvajaṃ ca bherī murajaṃ śubhānisarvaśatru patitākṣaya pīḍā yātragaśubhaṃ satatāsunimittaṃ bhavedgacched durnimittamahe sthitiḥyasmindeśe tathā kṛtvā prāṅmukhaḥ sa pathi sthitaḥyātatapāsthigandhāṃśca saṃkṣinnākṣara vāriṇivakrāścarkarāpyaṃ ca ka ikṣāṃ jharjharīdarīmsūtra pādavadākāro rekhāmiva tridhā smṛtāveṇuṃkaravadākāraṃ lūtāpādasamāyutākalaṃka kṛṣṇarogābhaṃ kṛṣṇābhūka sannibhamtrāsaṃ sphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śuktibhyānnarasannibhājambūphalasamākārā snānacūccakasaṃnibhāvimalaṃ hemasadṛśaṃ kāṃsyaṃ lohasya saṃnibhamkṛṣṇe kṛṣṇāni naśyanti śvete kṛṣṇa sugandhitākharjūrapatra * * * dūrvāstambākṛtiḥ śubhākālakaṃ rogadaṃ jñeyaṃ trāsaraṃ rāṣṭravardhanamdarī vināśayordhānyaṃ hanti tanmale * * *ekavarṇāśilā grāhyā bhuktimuktipradāyikāstrīpuṃ napuṃsakā śailā bālā vṛddhā tu madhyamāghaṇṭāśabdāttu pulliṃgāḥ svarahīnā napuṃsakāḥdīrghaśabdata yā vṛddhā hṛsvā bālā iti smṛtāḥpādādhānaśilāṃ kuryānnapuṃsakena viśeṣataḥyasyagarbha gṛhārdhaṃ tu liṃgaṃ kanyasamucyatepaṃcabhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ tu uttamaṃ liṃgamucyateśrīpradaṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ rājyadaṃ bhavetroganāśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ paittalaṃ liṃgamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃgulyādīva tasyāntaṃ sarveṣāṃ jātirucyatesphaṭikaṃ marakataṃ caiva māṇikyaṃ padmarāgakamindranīlaṃ puṣparāgaṃ vajraṃ caiva tu kārayetsvayoniṃ pauṣṭikaṃ jñeyaṃ anyoktaṃ mokṣakāmadamratnānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ dhātujaṃ pīṭhamucyateliṃgatāratribhāgaṃ tu pīṭhavistāramucyatevṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā ṣoḍaśāṃśena bhājitampadmatuṇḍaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ dvayaṃśaṃ valayaṃ bhavetevaṃ pīṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ stvānāṃ phalamucyatemāṇikyaṃ muktidaṃ jñeyaṃ padmarāgaṃ dhanārthakamvaiḍūryamāyurvṛddhiḥ syādrāṣṭravaśyaṃ pravālakamevameva krameṇaiva jñeyaṃ ratnasya lakṣaṇamevaṃ dvividhamākhyātaṃ calasthāpanakaṃ śṛṇuhastā ca revatī caiva svātī caiva triruttarāprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakamśālināsthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhve pālikā nyasetnavāhairvāpi saptāhaiḥ paṃcāhairvā viśeṣataḥpratiṣṭhā maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakalpaṃ tu vittamaḥudyāne śuddhadeśe tu gṛhe vāpi viśeṣataḥṣoḍaśastambha saṃyuktaṃ madhyame vedikā bhavetyāvadaśraṃ bhavetpīṭhaṃ tāvadaśraṃ tu kuṇḍakammaṇṭapaṃ bhūṣayedvidvān pūrvoktena vidhānataḥpuṣpamālyairalaṃ kṛtya kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇampraviśenmaṇṭapaṃ tatra jale caivādhivāsayetsavastrānsahiraṇyāṃśca vidyeśvara samanvitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ liṃgaṃ prakṣālayettataḥśuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥtadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasetśayanaṃ paṃcadhā kalpya yathā pūrvoktamārgataḥmuṇḍajaṃ tu dukūlaṃ vā kārpāsikamathāpi vāvṛkṣatvacāca kartavyaṃ carmajaṃ tu vidhīyateśayane śāyayeddevaṃ prāsādena tu mantrataḥprākāraṃ paścime pīṭhaṃ śayane śāyayeddhṛdāśuddhodakena saṃpūrya śarāveṇa pidhāya cadvārakalaśaṃ vinyasya dvārapālānsamarcayetsthāpayedvidhinā vipra ! svasvanāmnā viśeṣataḥvardhanīṃ gauribījena vinyaseddeśikottamaḥdaśāyudhaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarṇenaiva tu deśikaḥvidyeśvarānnyasettatra svasvanāmnā ca mantrataḥnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād hṛdayena tu mantrataḥsamidājya caruṃ lājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānsamidho hīśamantreṇa puruṣeṇājyameva casarṣapaṃ sadya mantreṇa hṛdayena yavaṃ tathāghṛtamikṣetiṃ mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caiva tu hūyaterātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tatra svapnāni ca parīkṣayetekāgniṃ vātha paṃcāgniṃ kuryādvai deśikottamaḥhomaṃ na kārayedvidvān samidājya caruṃ vināsarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaranhutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāttu viśeṣataḥmantranyāsoktamārgeṇa nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tato budhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanīmapi piṇḍikāmsnapanaṃ kārayettatra śatāṣṭaṃ paṃcāśadeva tupaṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātcalaliṃga sthāpanaṃ proktamumayā sahitaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre calaliṃga pratiṣṭhāṃvidhiḥ eka ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥsṛṣṭimūrtipratiṣṭhāṃ tu brūhi me parameśvara !umāskandahitaṃ caiva sukhāsanaṃ tathaiva cagaṃgādharaṃ ca paṃcaite sṛṣṭirūpamihocyatepratirūpasargaṃ pūjā ca tiṣṭhā gati nivṛtti cayamarohiṇyāditya puṣyendu hasta pauṣṇa triruttarāsthirarāśau prakartavyaṃ ubharāśāvathāpi vāpratiṣṭhā nakṣatra pūrve tu aṃkurānarpayettataḥprāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ kārayettataḥekādaśa dvādaśakaraṃ trayodaśakaraṃ tathāṛṣicchando devatānāṃ vakṣyāmi surasattama !bhāradvājo bhṛguścaiva tathāṃgirasagautamāḥtṛṣṭup cānuṣṭup ca * * * * * prakṛtistathāuttamottamamevaṃ tu chandasānāṃ vidhīyatevighneśaśca kuberaśca brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥkramād jñātvā tu viprendra ! kārayedvidhi pūrvakamdāruṇā ca prakartavyaṃ śilpinā lakṣaṇairyutamāsanaṃ cāpi vṛkṣaṃ vā kramukaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu vāavakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ caiva puṣakoṭara varjitamkūṭaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ vāpi prapāṃ vāpi ca kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktibījamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakarmārthasādhanamśuddhasphaṭika saṃkāśaṃ tryakṣaṃ daśabhujairyutamdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitampāśaṃ cāṃkuśaghaṇṭāṃ ca nāgavahniṃ ca vāmakeetatsakalamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadamiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasra saṃhitāyāṃ mantroddhāraścaturthaḥ paṭalaḥviśeṣaṃ śrotumicchāmi taṃ me brūhi maheśvaraayogyāni ca puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ ca tapodhanakaravīra sahasrebhyo bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyatepadmapatra sahasrebhyaḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ viśiṣyateśatapatrasahasrebhyaḥ sahasraparṇaṃ viśiṣyatebakapuṣpasahasrebhyo dhurdhūrakaṃ viśiṣyatedroṇapuṣpasahasrebhyo apāmārgaṃ viśiṣyatekuśapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatevyāghātakasahasrebhyaḥ śaṃkhapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatevyāghrapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ sadābhadraṃ viśiṣyate* * * * * * dvipra bṛhatpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyateśvetārkasya sahasrebhyo bṛhaddroṇaṃ viśiṣyatesvarṇadhurdhūrapuṣpaṃ tu nīlotpalasamodbhavaiḥpunaḥ pūjāḥ prakartavyāḥ sarvalokahitāya cadroṇapuṣpa sahasrebhyo jñeyaṃ viṣṇukrāntiṃ ca pastathābilvapatrasamaṃ jñeyaṃ * * * * * * * *padmapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ vakulaṃ pa * * * *śvetaṃkusuma * raktotpalamapāmārgaṃ bhavetgandhapuṣpī gandhapuṣpā padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet
