sanskrit: evaṃ vai maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā madhye vediṃ tu kalpayetcaturaśrārdhacandraṃ ca vṛttaṃ padmaṃ tathaiva caīśāna indrayormadhye ṣaṭkoṇamiti kathyateumāsahitamevoktaṃ ekāsanasthite'pi cacaturaśraṃ ca yoniṃ ca trikoiṇaṃ vṛttameva vāīśāna indrayormadhye saptakoṇaṃ tu kārayetpūrvādīśāccaturdikṣu vedāśraṃ kuṇḍamucyatekalyāṇa sundaraṃ proktaṃ candraśekharamucyatekoṇeṣu vṛttakuṇḍaṃ tu śivāgniṃ cāṣṭakoṇakamsukhāsanavaddikṣvaṣṭau śivāgniṃ cāṣṭakoṇakamekāsanasthitādevyā yonyākāraṃ vidikṣu vaivitānaiścordhvamācchādya aṣṭadikṣu dhvajānnyasetdhvajamadhye likhitvā tu aṣṭadikṣu ca vinyasettṛtīyaṃ pratimāśuddhiḥ caturthaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇamsaptamaṃ śayanaṃ caiva aṣṭamaṃ homameva cadaśarimaṃmiha proktaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathagomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā śālinā vikirettataḥparistarettu darbhaiśca navavastreṇa chāditambrāhmike tu nyasedvajraṃ indranīlaṃ tu pūrvataḥnair-ṛtyāṃ puṣparāgaṃ tu mauktikaṃ vāruṇe nyasetīśānyāṃ tu mahānīlaṃ evaṃ devasya vinyasetcaturdikṣu ca madhye ca svarṇāni nikṣipettataḥpratimāṃ kṣālayettatra āmvenaṃ vāriṇā punaḥādityasya pade caiva netramokṣaṇamucyatetaṇḍulaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ tilameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: umā skandasahitaṃ nyasya tasyopari viśeṣataḥtāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye madhvājyaṃ caiva nikṣipetabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau pūrvādīśāntaṃ vinyasetsasūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca lokapālādhidevatānkṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhya jyotirmaṇḍalamālikhetsuvarṇanakha saṃyuktaṃ hemadūrvā samanvitamakṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tasyāgre tu viśeṣataḥpūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa agnimukhaṃ ca kārayetaṣṭottaraśatenaiva pratyekaṃ hūyate kramātmadhyame skandamevaṃ tu skandamantreṇa hūyatesvarṇena nakhadūrveṇamadhvājyaṃ tu tarpayetghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caivaṃ tu tarpayetbrāhmaṇāndarśayettatra brahmajajñānamantrataḥdarśayedbrahmacārīṃśca skandasyaiva tu deśikaḥāpohiṣṭheti saṃprokṣya arghya saṃyutameva capaṃcagavya samāyuktaṃ abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetśuddhairuttheti mantreṇa śuddhodakena snāpayetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutamgītavādya samāyuktaṃ śaṃkhakāhala saṃyutamnānābhaktajanaissārdhaṃ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇamnadītaṭākatīre vā hrade gatvā viśeṣataḥśālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ tatra vinyasetnavavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya kūrcenaiva samanvitamcaturdvāra samāyuktaṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥsa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca vidyeśvara samanvitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekarātraṃ tritātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vāvāstuhomaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamālayaṃ praviśettatra puṣpadantapade sthitaḥgaurībījena devyātha guhaṃ vai skandabījataḥuśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva elālavaṃga saṃyutamtato'dhivāsanaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamtadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasettoraṇānarcayettatra dvārakumbhāṃśca vinyasetsavastrānsāpidhānāṃśca lokapālādhidevatānśayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya aṇḍajādyairanukramātkṣaumaṃ kārpāsajaṃ vāyaṃ muṇḍajasyeti kīrtitamvṛkṣatvacānukartavyaṃ carmajaṃ tadvidhīyatepaṃcabrahmeṇa mantreṇa śayanaṃ paṃca kalpayetpracchādanena saṃyuktaṃ śayane śāyayecchivamprākśiraḥ paścime pādaṃ vinyaseddeśikottamaḥnavakumbhānsamādāya trisūtrairveṣṭayettataḥpaṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭayetpaṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ śivakumbhaṃ ca vinyasetskandakumbhaṃ nyasenmadhye skandamūlena mantrataḥsa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sahiraṇyānsakūrcakānambikāṃ ca umādevīṃ īśapatnīṃ tathaiva caprajñāṃ cāgasutāṃ caiva pārvatī ca tathaiva cakumāraṃ ca guhaṃ caiva subrahmaṇyaṃ tathaiva caśaravaṇodbhavaṃ caiva kārtikeyaṃ ca vinyasetgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca svasvabījena pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: elālavaṃgakarpūra timbujātīphalaṃ muramvardhanyāṃ sudakumbheṣu evameva kramānnyasettato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitampaścime cakravṛkṣastu udumbaraṃ tu cottareśamī caiva apāmārgaṃ bilvavṛkṣa samanvitamsoma īśānayormadhye palāśa samidhā tathāmudgaṃ māṣaṃ ca viprendra ! navadravyamihocyateaghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tuśirasā ca tilaṃ hutvā śivamantreṇa mudgakamtriyambakena mantreṇa caruṃ caiva tu hūyateevaṃ krameṇa hotavyaṃ tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥdravyaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa hotavyaṃ deśikottamaḥdravyānte caiva dravyānte pratimāṃ saṃspṛśettataḥcaturdikṣu caturvedaṃ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥpaścime camakaṃ prācyāṃ pavamānaṃ tathottaremāheśvara samāyuktaṃ nṛttaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaretataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥsṛṣṭirūpa pratiṣṭhāyāṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtamsamidājyacaruṃ lājān datvā paṃcadaśāhutiḥājyaṃ sadyena hotavyaṃ hṛdayena caruṃ hunetanyairhomaṃ na kartavyaṃ ācāryeṇaiva hūyatehutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhuti mathācaretācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathā śāstrokta mārgataḥpaṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadyāt śikhākarṇe gale tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhamaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ tu madhyamaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavettadardhamupadeṣṭā ca vāstuhomaṃ tadardhakamdaivajñadviguṇaṃ tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettataḥparyaṣṭi parivārāṇāṃ yathā śaktyā tu dakṣiṇāsumuhūrte sulagne ca devamutthāpayettataḥghṛtaṃ śirorpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hemadūrvāṃkurākṣataiḥmantranyāsoktamārgeṇa paṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyutambrahmamaṃgena saṃyuktaṃ snāpayecchiva kumbhakamskandamūlena viprendra ! skandakumbhābhiṣecayetvardhanīṃ sthāpayeddevyāḥ sahāsanagate yadisnapanaṃ kārayettatra naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥbhojayetsaptakanyāśca brahmacārīṃśca bhojayetkāpālaṃ pāṃcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍaite samayāḥ smṛtāḥśaivānsaṃbhojayettatra samayānbhojayettataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātpratiṣṭhākaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayetiti vīratantre sṛṣṭimūrtipratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ dvāṣaṣṭhitamaḥ paṭalaḥvaktumarhasi deveśa anugrahārthaṃ prabho ! mamarohiṇī ca punavasve tiṣye mṛgaśirastathāsthirarāśau ca kartavyaṃ ubhayorapi kārayetṛṣabhaṃ vāhanaṃ caiva ardhanārī tathaiva caete tu paṃcamūrtiśca sthitimūrtirudāhṛtāpaṃcaṣaṭ saptahastaṃ vā aṣṭahastaṃ navaṃ tathāavakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ kṛtvā paṃktimānamathocchrayamdhvajamadhye likhettatra lokapālasya vāhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darbhamālābhirācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtampūrve tu caturaśraṃ tu agneraśvatthapatravatvṛttaṃ tu vāruṇe caiva vāyavyāṃ paṃcakoṇakamindraīśānayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ tu kārayetīśāna indrayormadhye ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ nyasetpūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu kuṇḍaṃ syāccaturaśrakamardhanārīśvaraṃ proktaṃ kirātārjunamucyatevṛttapaṃcāśrapadmaṃ ca saptakoṇāṣṭakoṇakamsahāsane tu viprendra ! āgneyādiṣu yonikamkirātārjunamevoktaṃ vīreśaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥaśvatthaṃ ca trikoṇaṃ ca paṃcāśraṃ cāṣṭakoṇakamsaptakoṇaṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ vīreśamadhunocyatesoma īśānayormadhye hariṇāṃ vṛttakuṇḍakamevameva krameṇaiva kuṇḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥratnanyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ satyakasya pade'thavānavavastra samāyuktāṃ pratimāṃ tatra vinyasetindranīlaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ sphaṭikaṃ marakataṃ tu vāpūrvādiṣu nyasedetān paṃcabrahma samuccaranardhanārīśvaraṃ caiva śivabhāge tu vinyasetnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netrayugmayute dineśālyopari nyased devaṃ pracchannapaṭasaṃyutamśilpinaṃ pūjayet tatra śilpinaṃ tu visarjayetpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ kalaśānaṣṭa vinyasethiraṇya nakhadūrvā ca ghṛtapātramapātrakampaṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇairyuktaḥ prokṣayet pratimāṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ājyena caruṇā caiva netreṇaiva śatāhutiḥmadhvājyaṃ tarpayed dhīmān netramantrasamanvitamghṛtamikṣe ghṛtaṃ tarpya savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayetpracchannapaṭamāvarjya janān sarvān pradarśayetpavamānaṃ samuccārya paṃcagavyābhiṣecanamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād rathe vā śibike'pi vānadītaṭākatīre vā gomayenānulepayetsnāpayet paṃcagavyena vyomavyāpi samuccaransa vastra paridhānena kūrcenaivacchādayetprapāṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra ! kalaśānaṣṭa vinyasetekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vāvāstuhomaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamvyomavyāpi samuccārya snāpayedgandhatoyakaiḥsarvagandhaṃ samāloḍhya lepayet pratimāṃ tataḥśālinā vikiredbediṃ bhāradvaya samanvitamlājairdarbhaiśca vikired aṇḍajādīni kalpayetvastreṇaivordhvamācchādya vyomavyāpi ṣaḍaṃgakaiḥsthāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanīṃ sthāpayecchivampūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhānnyasettataḥtasya bāhye tu parito lokapāla ghaṭānnyasetekāsanastha devyāśca antarālāśca vardhanīaśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭaṃ pūrvādidikṣu cagaurī vṛṣabha kuṇḍābhyāṃ palāśenaiva hūyateyavasarṣapa saṃyuktaṃ navadravyaṃ ca hūyatepuruṣeṇa caruṃ hutvā lājānghoreṇa caiva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tilānvai śiromantreṇa aṣṭottaraśatāhutiḥādyākṣaraṃ tu hṛsvaṃ ca dīrghaṃ brahmāṃga mucyatedravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā sparśayetpratimāṃ tataḥsthiti nyāya prakāreṇa nyāsaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥpūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā sarvadravya samanvitamīśānena tu mantreṇa kuryāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥupadeṣṭā mūrtipāṃścaiva padārthīn sarvāṃśca pūjayetsthitimārga prakāreṇa aṣṭatriṃśatkalaśān nyasetgeyanṛttādisarvāṃśca prāsādaṃ ca pradakṣiṇamprāsādena pratiṣṭhāpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vastrairābharaṇairapibrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śaivānsaṃbhojayettataḥsthitimūrtiridaṃ proktaṃ saṃhārasthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre sthitimūrtipratiṣṭhā triṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥkiṃ vā saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ sthāpanaṃ parameśvara !nṛttaṃ caiva tu kāmāri kāladāhaṃ tathaiva caṣaṣṭhe saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ sthāpanaṃ tviha cocyatehaste ca revatī caiva svātī caiva triruttarāaṃkurānarpayet pūrvaṃ navāhe saptame'thavādakṣiṇe cottare cāpi kārayellakṣaṇānvitammaṇṭapaṃ caiva viprendra ! ekāśītipadaṃ kurutasya bāhye tu parito mānuṣe kuṇḍamucyatevṛttaṃ caiva ṣaḍaśraṃ ca padmaṃ saptāśrameva caīśāna indrayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ ca kārayetcaturaśraṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ paṃcakoṇakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśāna indrayormadhye saptakoṇaṃ tu kārayettripuraghnaṃ tathā dikṣu catuṣkoṇaṃ trikoṇakamīśāna indrayormadhye saptāśraṃ kārayettataḥsatyakasya pade caiva ratnanyāsaṃ tu kārayettasyoparinyaseddevaṃ ṣaṇṇavatyaṃ viśeṣataḥpuṣṭikaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca puṣparāgaṃ tathaiva camāṇikyaṃ madhyame sthāpya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥsusnigdhaśālinā kuryātpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥratnanyāsamidaṃ proktaṃ netramokṣaṇamucyatenayanadvayayukte tu dine lagne śubhe tathānṛttarūpaṃ tadūrdhve tu vinyasecchiva mantrakaiḥsthāpayet kalaśānaṣṭau lokapālādhidevatānsuvarṇasūcinā vipra ! śilpinā praharettataḥjyotirmaṇḍalamālikhya netramantra samāyutamnetramantreṇa viprendra ! aṣṭottaraśataṃ pṛthaksuvarṇadūrvayā vipra ! madhvājyaṃ caiva tarpayettāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye ājyaṃ caiva tu vinyasetghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ caiva tu tarpayetgordhenurbhavyamantreṇa darśayedgāṃ viśeṣataḥṣaṇṇavatyena mantreṇa prokṣayet tu viśeṣataḥpracchannapaṭamāvarjya darśayenmānuṣāṃstataḥśuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa tantrīṇāṃ ca saṃyutamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇamprapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa kalaśān vinyaset tataḥekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃca vā saptarātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇḍapasyaiśadigbhāge snānavedyupari nyasetghṛtaṃ śirorpaṇaṃ kuryāt svarṇadūrvāṃkurākṣataiḥkṣālayecchuddhatoyena * * * nantu kalpayetaṣṭatriṃśat kalānyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṃgenaiva vinyasetsumūhūrte sulagne ca nakṣatrakaraṇānviteṣaṇṇavatyena mantreṇa abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetpūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ kalaśe vā bhiṣecayetpūrvokta lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ arcayet tu viśeṣataḥpratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayetśaivān saṃbhojayet tatra yathā śaktyādi dakṣiṇāyāvad rudrapuraṃ sarve dadhyākṣaye naraḥādyeṣu tritayeṣveṣu na dhvajārohaṇa kriyāevaṃ kṛte mahāśānti rājarāṣṭrasukhāvahamevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchatiiti vīratantre saṃhāramūrtipratiṣṭhavidhiḥ catuṣṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥkathaṃ gaurī pratiṣṭhā ca brūhi me parameśvara !rohiṇī ca punarvasvo puṣye mṛgaśirastathāsthirarāśau tu kartavyaṃ aṣṭamaṃ grahavarjitamdvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ sustanāṃ ca suyauvanāmkaraṇḍamakuṭāṃ caiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitampādanūpura saṃyuktāṃ devyā rūpamihocyatepūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktaṃ maṇṭapaṃ kārayettataḥtasyā vṛtapadaṃ trīṇi madhyame kuṇḍamucyatelakṣaṇena prakartavyaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā sahahemaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya aṣṭadikṣu krameṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedasī se kā cotpalaṃ caiva kalhāraṃ kṛntakaṃ tathāmusalī palāśapuṣpaṃ ca droṇapuṣpasamaṃ bhavetsūryāvartaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca * * * * * meva cavajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca marakatamauktikāni canīlotpalasamā jñeyā sarvaratnāni caiva hiaṃkolasaṃkaraścaiva priyaṃguścampakeva capālāśapuṣpaṃ viprendra raviraśmisamāyutamyavagodhūmanīvāra brīhivaiṇavakāni caaṃkurāṇi prakartavyaṃ pūjayecchivamādarātkadambārjuna sindūraṃ kuḍumaṃ kusumāni cakadalīpuṣpapunnāga nāganandī tathaiva camadhūka dhūrtapuṣpaṃ ca karapāddhirdhavāni vāgirirāgakakau girikakaca dhurdhūraka samaṃ bhavetpuṣpāṇāmapyalābhe tu phalānāṃ pūjayettataḥmūlānāmapyabhāve tu bhaktyā caiva tu pūjayetketakīmādhavīpadmaṃ madhudhī pūjayetsadānīlakaṇṭhī ca mevaśca talapoṭakameva caevamevaṃ krameṇaiva yo naraḥ pūjayetsadāpuṣpādhyāyamidaṃ proktaṃ karṣaṇasya vidhiṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ puṣpalakṣaṇaṃ paṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvarapuṣyamāsādiṣaṇmāsaṃ devatānāṃ divā bhavetdivāmāsaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādrātrimāsaṃ ca varjayetmaitrādityamakhāsvātī tvaṣṭārvāśravaṇāśśubhādvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca paṃcamī ṣaṣṭhisaptamī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvitīyavarge viprendra ! tṛtīyākṣara saṃyutambindunāda samāyuktaṃ mūlamantramihocyatehṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni cocyateādityasya pade caiva gomayenānulepayettadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasetnavavastraṃ nyasettatra pratimāṃ vinyaset tataḥabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vāmādyādīni vinyasetkṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhya jyotirmaṇḍalamālikhetvastreṇāveṣṭya tad devyāḥ pracchanna paṭasaṃyutamabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vāmādyādīni vinyasetagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya paṃcāśatsaṃkhyayā hunettāmrapātre'thavā kāṃsye ghṛtaṃ madhu ca pūrayetmadhuvātā ṛtāyeti madhunā tarpayettataḥgaurdhenu bhavyamantreṇa savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayetnetramantrasamāyuktaṃ dhānyarāśīṃ ca darśayetpaṃcagavyena viprendra ! abhiṣekaṃ samācaretnadītaṭākakatīre vā gomayenānulepitesnāpayet paṃcagavyena jalādhivāsanaṃ kurujalamadhye nyased devīṃ gaurībījena deśikaḥsavastraṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca vāmādyāścaiva vinyasetekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vāsnāpayet paṃcagavyena navavastreṇa veṣṭayettadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasettasyo parinyaseddevīṃ gaurīmūlena deśikaḥpracchanna paṭasaṃyuktaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhodakena saṃpūrṇāḥ pratyekaṃ vastraveṣṭitāḥgaurībījena mantreṇa sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakampratyekaṃ vastrasaṃyuktaṃ pradhāne hema vinyasetpūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ manonmanīṃ tvīśagocaregandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya gaurīmūlena mantrataḥtato homaṃ prakurvīta nava vā paṃca eva vāgaurīmūlena mantreṇa samidhā hūyate kramātśiromantreṇa lājaśca mudgaṃ vāmena hūyateevameva krameṇaiva pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥdevasyatveti mantreṇa annāhutimathācarethavyavāheti mantreṇa sarvadravya samanvitamnṛttageya samāyuktaṃ rātrau jāgaramucyategaurīmūlaṃ japettatra āgneyādi caturdiśimantranyāsoktamārgeṇa sṛṣṭi nyāsaṃ tu kārayetsamidājyacarūṇāṃ tu homayed deśikottamaḥhutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramātvastrairābharaṇairyuktaṃ gobhūmīkāṃcanādibhiḥtato muhūrtamudvīkṣya devīmutthāpayet kramātsṛṣṭinyāsa krameṇaiva devyā aṃgeṣu vinyasetsnāpayet tu viśeṣeṇa gaurīmūlamanusmaransnapanaṃ kārayetpaścād yathā vibhavavistarambrāhmaṇān bhojayettatra saptakanyāśca bhojayetgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā śālinā vikirettataḥsthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevīṃ diśi dakṣiṇato nyasettatra viṣṇuṃ samāhūya dadyādudaka pūrvakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayenātiṣṭha mantreṇa aśmānaṃ sparśayet tataḥīśānena tu mantreṇa lājahomaṃ tu kārayettriḥkṛtvā tu viśeṣeṇa hutvā cittādibhistathābhinnāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ sahāsanamataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre gaurī sthāpanavidhiḥ paṃcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥsauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ lohajaṃ vāpi kārayetlakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā vadanupūrvaśaḥadhamaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ pādukasya tu dairghyakamaṃgulyādi trayāṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ * * * * *evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktāṃ pādukāṃ kārayet tataḥratnānāmapya lābhe tu suvarṇādīni kārayetmaṇṭapasya tu saṃskāraṃ vibhavena samanvitamdarbhamālābhirāveṣṭya catustoraṇa saṃyutammuktādāmairalaṃkṛtya puṣpamālopaśobhitamaṣṭadroṇena śālīṃśca tanmadhye vinyasettataḥpadmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretjalāduttīrya deveśaṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā navavastreṇa veṣṭayetācāryasya ca bījena sarvāṃgeṣu ca vinyasetupadeṣṭā śarīraṃ tad ācāryo jīva ucyatemantranyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitamaṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ paṃcabrahma nyaset kramātastraṃ karatale caiva vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥprākṛtaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya śivohamiti bhāvayetsvarṇasūtreṇa saṃyuktaṃ kautukaṃ bandhayet tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samāloḍhya ca sarvaṃ tu lepayet tu samantataḥpratimaṃ navavastreṇa pidhāya sakalaṃ tataḥnavakumbhaṃ samādāya sūtreṇāveṣṭayet tataḥsa vastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca paṃcaratna samanvitampratimasyaiśa digbhāge sthāpayecchiva kumbhakamvardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurī bījena sthāpayet* * * * * * * * tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥtato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitamkhadiraṃ ca śamī caiva apāmārgaṃ tathaiva casarveṣāmeva homānāṃ madhye pālāśamucyatemudgamāṣaṃ ca viprendra ! navadravyamihocyatecaruhomaṃ śikhā caiva lājānvai kavacena tuīśānena tilaṃ hutvā mudgaṃ sadyena hūyatesahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhamathāpi vāugro'tidhāśrīmo ete homasya daivatāḥbalavikaraṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūta manonmanīdravyānte pratimāṃ spṛṣṭvā paṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgakaiḥvyomaṃ prāsādamantraṃ ca brahmamaṃgaṃ tathaiva catrāṇi parvāṇi te yaṃ nṛtta samākulaiḥsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantarehūyate kramaśo vipra ! vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥparyaṣṭi paricārāṃśca śivadīkṣāvaho viduḥathā vasānahomaṃ tu pradhānāgnau tu hūyateprabhāte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ācāryādi ca sarvaśaḥpaṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadyād ācāryasya viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttamaṃ triguṇaṃ proktaṃ ācāryasya tu dakṣiṇāstotrādadhvayīnādīnāṃ tadardhaṃ dakṣiṇā śubhepadmasya pūrvadigbhāge vedāśraṃ kuṇḍamucyatepavamānena saṃprokṣya śuddhairutthai tato druvatpādukau vinyasenmadhye navavastrasya coparibhūtavargānta vargeṣu agniṃ saṃyojayet tataḥśivaviṣṇusamārūḍhaṃ pādukābījamucyateśrībhūmī dakṣiṇā diśi tathā devau prakīrtitaupūrayecchuddhato yena sa kūrcānsāpidhānakānpādukādīśa digbhāge vardhanīṃ vinyasettataḥmanonmanīṃ pradhānasya vinyasettu viśeṣataḥtato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā sahasumuhūrte sulagne ca vardhanīṃ vinyasettataḥgandhapuṣpādinā''pūjya vinyasecchivamantrataḥācāryaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ paryaṣṭi paricārakānnityotsavaṃ tu kāle tu pradakṣiṇamathācaretbrahmacārī vahitvā tu pādukāvarcayet tataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātpādukā sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ citrasthāpanakaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre pādukāsthāpanavidhiḥ ṣaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥcitrapratiṣṭhā kiṃ devabrūhi me parameśvara !citraṃ ca trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathamṛṇmayaṃ śūlasaṃyuktaṃ bhitticitre paṭe'pi vācitrasya saṃnidhau caiva pratiṣṭhāmaṇṭapaṃ kururatnanyāsaṃ ca kartavyaṃ umādevyā viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedikā brahmabhāge tu mānuṣe kuṇḍamucyatedevyāśceddikṣu viprendra ! yoniraśvattha patravatnayanamokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netrayugmayute dinejalādhivāsanaṃ noktaṃ śayane śāyayet tataḥbhāraśāli samāyuktaṃ vedimadhye paristaretparistaret tu darbhaiśca aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇakamdarpaṇaṃ śāyayettatra pracchanna paṭasaṃyutamdevyāścaiva tu vāmādi vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥ* * * * * * * devaṃ devyā vardhanīṃ nyasetgandhapuṣpādinā'bhyarcya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayetsamidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapā * gameva casadyena samidhā hutvā hṛdayenājyameva casarṣarpaṃ netramantreṇa mudgamīśānamantrataḥsarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccarantataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥtato vāsāna homaṃ tu ājyena caruṇāyutamcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryād adhyayanaṃ tataḥhutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāt tadanantaramhomīnāṃ tu padārthīnāṃ pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥtasyordhve darpaṇaṃ sthāpya mūlamantreṇa saṃyutampradhāna kalaśaṃ caiva snāpayet tu viśeṣataḥhavirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥsarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca sthāpana kramameva hipratiṣṭhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ ācāryāya pradāpayetiti vīratantre citrapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ saptaṣaṣṭhitamaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vimānasthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvara !rohiṇī ca punavasvā puṣyo mṛgaśirastathādvitīyā paṃcamī caiva dvādaśī vā trayodaśīevamādiṣu kāleṣu vimānasthāpanaṃ kuruprāsādasyaiva purataḥ prapāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥmadhyame vedikāṃ kuryād hastamātrocchrayaṃ bhavetnāgaraṃ drāviḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ tu śṛṇuṣvathavṛttaṃ ca paṃcakoṇaṃ ca padmaṃ caivāṣṭakoṇakamcaturdikṣu ca īśānyāṃ yathoktaṃ kuṇḍamucyatevitānadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtamkuberasya vidhiḥ prokto drāviḍasya tu vṛttakamtasya pūrve jalāvartaṃ vastramālyairalaṃkṛtamcaturdikṣu nyasettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā navavastreṇa veṣṭitaḥprāsādaṃ darbhamālābhirveṣṭayet tu viśeṣataḥvāstudevabaliṃ dadyāt pūrvokta vidhinā sahalambayennavavastreṇa prāsādena tu mantrataḥprāsādahomaṃ kartavyaṃ garbhagehe viśeṣataḥsamidhāmīśamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyateśāntihomakrameṇaiva caturdikṣu ca homayetprāsādameva homena śivāsanamatha śṛṇuśālinā vikirettatra bhāradvayena saṃyutampadmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretśuddhodakena saṃpūrya vastrakūrcasamanvitānnavakumbhān samādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturdaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitampradhānakalaśe naiva * * * * * vinyasetpūrve tu viṣṇukumbhāsyu dakṣiṇāmūrtidakṣiṇepūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu śivavidyeśvarasya tuuttare caiva durgāyāṃ vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥhavirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥsamidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānīśānyādīni sadyāntaṃ hṛdayena trayaṃ yutamvimānabījaṃ sarveṣu hutvā caiva śatāhutiḥmantranyāsoktamārgeṇa nyāsaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥtato vāsana homaṃ ca kartavyaṃ deśikottamaḥvimānabījasaṃyuktaṃ paṃcaviṃśatirucyatesviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantarehutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhutimathācaretśirasopari viprendra ! kumbhamudvāhayet tataḥvimānamūlasaṃyuktaṃ vyomavyāpi samuccaranpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ snāpayet svasvamantrataḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya havirdadyādviśeṣataḥsaptakanyāśca viprendra ! vastrādīni ca dāpayetvimānasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ mānuṣasthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre vimānasthāpanavidhiraṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥmānuṣasthāpanaṃ ko vā śivajñānābhipūritāntatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva caturānana !śivaprasāda siddhāṃśca pratimādīni kārayetśailajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi mṛṇmayaṃ citrameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catvāri paṃcaṣaṭtālaṃ mātrāṃgulena kārayetśivaprasādakāle tu yadrūpaṃ saṃbhavanti vaiṛṣīṇāmṛṣirūpaṃ tu nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpavadbhavetilā ca piṃgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathaiva caalaṃpuruṣā ruhrī ca śaṃkhinī daśamaḥ smṛtaḥvimalā ghoṣaṇī caiva pṛthivī āvinī tathāśodhanī vyādhinī caiva rasāvatī ca mudvatīsarvagā caiva nāḍyastā viṃśatissahitāṣṭabhiḥtasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu prathamasya caturdaśahṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni vinyasetdevatānāṃ vāhanānāṃ sthāpayedevameva tunavaratnaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ vā vinyaseddeśitottamaḥmadhyame kalpayeddevīṃ paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyatepūrvādiṣu caturdikṣu īśānyādyaṣṭakoṇakamnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā adhivāsya tato budhaḥvāstu homaṃ tataḥ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamśayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya kārpāsairvastraveṣṭitamkāye tu vinyasedvipra ! paṃcaviṃśatikaṃ tathāśabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasogandhaśca paṃcamaḥśrotratvakcakṣurjihvā ca ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu paṃcamampaṃcaviṃśati tatvāni śarīre vinyaset tataḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya paścātkumbhāni vinyasetpratimā dakṣiṇe bhāge kuṃbhaṃ mūlena sthāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ sthāpayet kumbhamaṣṭakamnāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro kumbhe pūrvādi vinyasetdhanaṃjayottare nyasya gandhapuṣpādinārcayettato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā sahasamidājya carūnlājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānpaṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥtataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥtato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājya carūnsahahutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramātupadeṣṭāraṃ saṃpūjya yathā śāstrokta mārgataḥmantranyāsokta mārgeṇa sṛṣṭi nyāsaṃ tu kārayetpaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena prāṇādatyaya kumbhakānnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥhāṭakaṃ vastra saṃyuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ dāpayet tataḥmānuṣaṃ sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ piṇḍikā sthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre mānuṣasthāpanavidhiḥ ekona saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥpiṇḍikā sthāpanaṃ kiṃcit tatsarvaṃ me vada prabho !prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamstambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ caturdvārasamanvitamvitānadhvajamācchādya digdhvajaiśca pralambitamśālibhirvikirettatra taṇḍulaiśca tilaistathāpīṭhaṃ prakṣālayedvipra ! prāsādena tu mantrataḥvalmīke ca taṭāke ca kuśamūle tathaiva caśuddhakṣetre tu vai brahma mṛdbhissaṃkṣālayedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratipatpaurṇamāsyāṃ vā kārayettu śivadvijaḥsomabhārgavasaumyānāṃ vārā śreṣṭhatamāḥ smṛtāḥaṣṭamasthā grahāḥ sarve kartuḥ kurvantu susthitamgrahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipātakeevaṃ parīkṣā kartavyā sarvasaṃpatkarāya caūṣaraṃ kukumimiṣṭarja? valmīkāḍhyaṃ ca varjayetpītā vaiśyā iti proktā kṛṣṇā śūdrā iti smṛtāḥadhikaṃ cottamaṃ jñeyamadhamaṃ nyūnameva caevaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kuryātkarṣaṇamuttamamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyukto valavānmadhyamovaraḥkṣīravṛkṣayugaṃ badhvā gocarmeṇaiva bandhayetācāryaḥ sakalīkṛtya navavastreṇa veṣṭayettīkṣṇa śṛṃgāya vidmahe vedapādāya dhīmahi (tanno vṛṣaḥ) pracodayātprāgudakkarṣayettatra ācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥācāryāya pradātavyaṃ sahagau vṛṣabhau tathāśalyaṃ vimocayettatra lakṣaṇena samanvitampūjānte sparśayankartāyidaṃgastannirīkṣayetasthiśalyaṃ śirasparśāntadadhastaṃ ca dvayamānataḥtrihaste śṛṃgalāśalyamaṃgha sparśāttu deśikaḥaṃgārakatrihaste tu bāhusparśanamucyatekaniṣṭhāṃ guṣṭayoḥ sparśātkarārdhaikāṃgamucyatenābhikorparaṃ haste jānusparśameva cakughnaṃsatvā tu viprendra gomayenānulepayetaśvatthodumbaro vātha śaṃkuṃ grāhayettataḥtatra madhye sthitaṃ śaṃkuṃ tanmānena tu bhrāmayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra svastimaṃgalavācakaiḥśuddhodakena saṃpūrya vinyaset pīṭhabāhyataḥvardhanyāṃ nikṣipet tatra pūrvādīśāntameva casakūrcaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ pṛthak pṛthakdakṣiṇe caiva raudrī ca kālī nir-ṛti gocarebalapramathinīṃ saumye vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥmadhye manonmanīṃ devīṃ nyastvā gandhādinā yajettato homaṃ prakurvīta kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vāvṛttapīṭhasya he brahman vṛttakuṇḍamihocyatesamidhassadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena caiva hiveṇumīśānamantreṇa mudgaṃ ca śirasā tathāgaurībījena mantreṇa pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāt tadanantareupānaṃ pādamityuktaṃ jagatī jaṃghonujaṃ tathākaṇṭhaśca hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ nābhiścaiva tu paṭṭikākaṇṭhaśca hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ bāhūcaivordhva vāmanamevaṃ vai padmapīṭhe tu teṣāṃ rūpaṃ prakalpayettataḥ prabhāte (vimale) sumuhūrte sulagnakepaścādgarbhagṛhaṃ gatvā ācāryaḥ śilpibhissahavṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa prāsādena samanvitampīṭhaṃ visarjayet tatra jalamadhye tu nikṣipetṣaṇṇavatyakṣarairyuktaṃ vyomavyāpi samuccaranaṣṭabandhaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitamvāyuke neṣṭakā cūrṇaṃ sadṛśaṃ ghanatailakamtāmrapātre viśeṣeṇa pācayecchilpinā saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivaloke mahīyatetat tadaṃśāni vinyasya sūtrāgramupakalpanamtanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryādaratnimātramucchritāmgātrasaṃveṣṭanaṃ kuryād vitānenordhvaṃ veṣṭayetvedibāhye tu parito navakuṇḍāni kārayettat tat pīṭhākṛtiṃ brahman tat tat kuṇḍamihocyatetadardhaṃ taṇḍulān nyasya taṇḍulārdhatilān nyasetbālasthānasya cāgre tu yātrāhomaṃ tu kārayetsa sūtraṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca savastraṃ hema saṃyutamabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitānācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā śirasā dhārayed ghaṭamvimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānvedimadhye nyaset tataḥgandhapuṣpādinā pūjya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayetsamāloḍhya viśeṣeṇa liṃgamāloḍyayet tataḥtato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitamudumbaramapāmārgaṃ khadiraṃ ca viśeṣataḥīśāna indrayormadhye śamīṃ caiva tu vinyasetsarveṣāṃ caiva homānāṃ palāśedhyamihocyatesamidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa vaktreṇājyaṃ tathaiva canetreṇaiva tu mudgaṃ syān māṣaṃ hṛdayamucyateprāsādena tu mantreṇa pratyekaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥsarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaranjayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyatecaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥpuruṣasūktaṃ japitvā ca stotreṇaiva samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navavastraparīdhānaḥ soṣṇīṣassottarīyakaḥpraśāntamānaso bhūtvā snāpayelliṃga mūrdhanipūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ vidyeśān snāpayet tataḥsnapanaṃ kārayet tatra yathāvibhavavistaramhavirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dapayet tataḥpīṭhasthāpanamevoktaṃ jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre piṇḍikāsthāpanavidhiḥ saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥjalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvaraprāsādakaraṇe caiva śilpinā sparśayet tataḥpatane dūṣite spṛṣṭe pūjāhīne tathaiva catrirātre paṃca saptāhe aṃkurārpaṇamārabhetpālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarābaṃ ca tridhā bhavetprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakamṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyuktaṃ caturdvāra vibhūṣitamsamakhaṇḍaṃ vartamānaṃ ca śivādhikyaṃ tathaiva cakuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣye samakhaṇḍasya padmaja !indra īśānayormadhye aṣṭakoṇaṃ tu kārayetcaturaśraṃ ca yoniṃ ca ardhacandraṃ trikoṇakampūrvādīni kramadṛddhiṃ īśāne saptakoṇakamtrairāśikasya kuṇḍāni śrūyatāṃ caturānana !svayamudbhūtaliṃgasya sthāpitasya maharṣibhiḥeteṣāṃ prokṣaṇe kāle tat tat pīṭhākṛtiṃ yathāpūrvoktena pramāṇena kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt tu deśikaḥgomayenopalipyātha toraṇa dhvajasaṃyutamvedyopari nyasecchāliṃ bhāradvayasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretcandanāgarukarpūraṃ uśīraṃ kuṃkumairyutampuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra paṃcagavyena snāpayetkautukaṃ bandhayet paścāt hṛdayena tu mantrataḥtasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śālibhistaṇḍulaistilaiḥvardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurībījena sthāpayettasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā yātrāhomaṃ tu kārayetsamidājya carūṇāṃ tu pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥīśānena tilaṃ hutvā spṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ tato budhaḥdaśamudrā ca dātavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitampraviśya maṇṭapaṃ vidvān - yedvedi madhyamebāle sthāne kṛte hyevaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikottamaḥnavakumbhānsamādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭitānpaṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭitampaṃcabrahmaśivāṃgaiśca śivamantreṇa sthāpayetsa vastrān sahiraṇyāṃśca sakūrcān sāpidhānakāngandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya pāyasānnaṃ nivedayetsamidājya carūnlājānsarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānpalāśaṃ pūrvato bhāge udumbaraṃ cāgnigocarekhadiraṃ paścime nyasya vāyavye bilvameva capalāśasamidhā caiva pradhānāgnau tu homayetstotramantraṃ japitvā tu pavamānaṃ japet tataḥcaruṃ tat puruṣeṇaiva lājānghoreṇa caiva hitilān hutvā tu śikhayā mudgaṃ tu kavacena tudravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā spṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ tu sarvaśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāt tadanantareāpo rājā idaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratyekaṃ caru hūyatemantranyāsokta mārgeṇa svadehe caiva vinyasetsarvadravya samāyuktaṃ pūrṇāhutimathācaretpūjāparyuṣito liṃgaṃ vyapohya kalaśaṃ tataḥpaṃcāsanaṃ tadākalpya pūrvoktavidhinā sahavyomavyāpi mahāmantraṃ vinyasya liṃgamūrdhanivimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād garbhagehaṃ praveśayetsnāpayecchiva kumbhaṃ tu gaurībījena vardhanīmsnapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ yathā vibhavavistarampaṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥviprādīṃśca dadecchaivān paryaṣṭi paricārakānevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātiti vīratantre jalasaṃprokṣaṇavidhireka saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥvṛṣabha sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !pūjāṃśocca pramāṇena adhamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhavetpūjāṃśena samāyuktaṃ madhyamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhavetathavā garbhamānena yathāvad garbhamucyateathavā tālamānena tritālamadhamaṃ bhavetsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā śilā bhavetgalamaṃśena kartavyaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ pṛṣṭhadairghikamdvandvayoradhamāṃśaṃ tu gomukhākṛtireva cakarṇadvayasamāyuktaṃ kiṃkiṇīrupaśobhitampādāccatvāramaṃśaṃ tu caturaṃśaṃ tu bālakamūrumūlasya vistāraṃ dvayaṃśamiti kathyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śailaje mṛṇmaye lohe ratnanyāsaṃ tu kārayetindranīlaṃ ca ratnādi pūrvādika caturdiśivṛṣabhaṃ kṣālayed vidvān puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥpūrvokta vidhinā kuryād akṣihomādikārayetvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa jale caivādhivāsayetjalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ praviśedālayaṃ prati (tataḥ)madhyame vedikāṃ kuryāt paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyatesaptavargāccaturthaṃ tu tadvargāttu tṛtīyakamvṛṣabhamūlamidaṃ jñeyaṃ hutvā brahmamihocyatetadūrdhve vinyasedvipra paṃcabhiḥ kambalairyutampracchanna paṭa saṃyuktaṃ abhitaḥ kalaśān nyasetvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa vinyased deśikottamaḥaṣṭavidyeśvarān bāhya kalaśasyādhi daivatāntato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā sahaīśānādīni sadyāntaṃ kramān mantramihocyatevṛṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā tu dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāt tataḥhavyavāhādimantreṇa pūrṇāhutimathācaretgāyatryā paṃcabrahmaṃ tu snāpayet kumbhameva caācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchativṛṣabhasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ athāgnisthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre vṛṣabhasthāpanavidhirdvāsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥagnipratiṣṭhāṃ deveśa ! tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !prāsādasyāgni digbhāge agnivimānamucyateathavā garbhamānaṃ vā navadhā bhājite tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvitālamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ tritālaṃ madhyamaṃ bhaveteka hṛdayaṃ tripādaṃ ca catuśśṛṃgaṃdvayaṃśiraḥpadmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ ūrdhvakeśa samanvitamsruvākṣatomaraṃ caivetyete vāmakareṣu caevaṃ samāsataḥ proktaṃ pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇumarakataṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya paścime tu pravālakamnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryān netradvayayute dinebindunāda samāyuktaṃ agnimūla mudāhṛtamnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktavidhinā sahajalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt tasya mūlena mantrataḥprāsādasyāgrataścaiva pūrvoktamaṇḍapaṃ kurucaturdikṣu ca īśānyāṃ trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamucyatepratisthaika digbhāge agnimūlena vinyasetśayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpyaḥ pratimāṃ vinyaset tataḥtasyaiva vāmabhāge tu svāhā bījena vardhanamhutāśanaṃ pāvakaṃ ca analaṃ havyavāhanampūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ vinyaset tu viśeṣataḥtato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ palāśasamidhāyutammudgamāṣaṃ ca nīvāraṃ bilvaṃ caikādaśaṃ bhavettataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥtato vāsana homaṃ ca samidājya carūn yutamvimāne sthāpayedvidvān pratimaṃ paścimaṃ mukhamsvasvanāmnaiva mantreṇa snāpayet kumbhameva cabrāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra paryaṣṭiparicārakānagnisthāpanamevoktaṃ mātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti vīratantre agnisthāpanavidhistrisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥmātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāvighneśaṃ pratimaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayed vidhipūrvakamcaturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca padmāsanopari sthitamvīrabhadraṃ mayā proktaṃ brāhmī caiva śṛṇuṣvathadakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe haste akṣasūtrakamaṇḍalumtrinetrāṃ caturbhujāṃ caiva jaṭāmukuṭa dhāriṇīmpadmāsanopariṣṭāt tu māheśvarīṃ ca kārayetdakṣiṇe'dakṣiṇe haste akṣamālākamaṇḍulumdvinetrāṃ caturbhujāṃ devīṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharāmkārayed vaiṣṇavīṃ devīṃ vārāhīṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇumakuṭena samāyuktāṃ varāha mukha saṃyutāmcaturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca śyāmavarṇa samāyutāmcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca vighneśaṃ kārayet tataḥmāyānala samāyuktaṃ bindunāda samāyutamhṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghāhyaṃgāni cocyatenayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte naiva mārgataḥjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥpūrvavanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte naiva mārgataḥcaturaśraṃ yonikuṇḍaṃ ardhacandraṃ trikoṇakampūrvādīni kramān nyasya kuṇḍānyetāni vinyasetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra pavamānena prokṣayetśayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kuryāt tasyopari nyaset tataḥkaumārīṃ vahnideśe tu vaiṣṇavīṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāmuṇḍīṃ vāyudeśe tu uttare vīrabhadrakamtasyaiva vāmabhāge tu kumbhānvinyasya deśikaḥvastreṇa veṣṭayed vidvān suvarṇe naiva saṃyutāntato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitamsamidājya carūnlājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānpaṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgaiśca pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥtato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājyena saṃyutamhutvānte tu spṛśedbimbaṃ dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥuttarābhimukhīrdevīḥ sthāpayed deśikottamaḥpratiṣṭhākumbhamādāya snāpayet svasvamantrataḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayet tatra saptakanyāśca bhojayetmātṝṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ proktaṃ kumārasthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre mātṛsthāpanavidhiścatuḥ saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥkumārasthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !pūjābhāgasamutsedhaṃ pratimaṃ socchrayaṃ bhavetcatvāraḥ paṃcatālaṃ vā ṣaṭtālaṃ vāpi kārayetvaradābhayahastaṃ tu akṣamālākamaṇḍalumjayā ca vijayā caiva devyau pārśva sthite sadāebhistu lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ pratimāṃ kārayet tataḥprathamasya caturthaṃ tu bindunāda samanvitamhṛsvā brahma samākhyātā dīrghābhyaṃgāni cocyatevajraṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakamsusnigdhaṃ kārayettatra nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuruakṣihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā netreṇaiva śatāhutiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghṛtamikṣeti santarpya savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayet* * * * tṛtīyaṃ tu māyānala samanvitamsaptavargāccaturthaṃ tu māyātatva samanvitambrāhmaṇān darśayet tatra puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥnavavastrasamādhānaḥ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇammūlamantreṇa viprendra ! pracchanna paṭasaṃyutamjalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ snāpayet paṃcagavyakaiḥmadhyame vedikāṃ kuryātparitaḥ kuṇḍamucyateindra īśānayormadhye kuryātkuṇḍaṃ trikoṇakamśālinā vikiredvedīṃ taṇḍulaṃ ca tilaṃ nyasetśāyayed vedikāmadhye prākśiraskā vidhīyatekautukaṃ bandhayet pūrve hṛdayena tu mantrataḥjayā ca vijayā caiva dvau pārśvau sthāpayet kramātpūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhān kramānyasetsenāpatiṃ surāgraṃ ca harasūnuṃ tathaiva cagandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya svasvanāmnā ca mantrataḥtato homaṃ prakurvīta pālāśasamidhā sahaśālinīvāragodhūma mudgaiścaiva samanvitamskandamūlena hotavyamājye naiva śatāhutiḥtato vāsanahomaṃ tu samidājyacarūyutamcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥsviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantareutthāpya śayanāddevīṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu kārayetsnāpayet skandamūlena skandakumbhaṃ viśeṣataḥāvāhayet tu vāmena sadyena sthāpanaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvāhne ca parāhne ca śaṃkucchāyāṃ viloñcayetvāstu devānsamarbhyarcya puruṣaṃ pūjayettataḥmahātapasi saṃbhūtaṃ bhūtākāraṃ mahābalamprāgeva tattanmānena madhyasthenaiva kārayetpaṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya ṣaṇṇavatyena mantrataḥdaśasūtrāṃśca prāgagrānudagagrāṃstathaiva camadhye navapadaṃ kṛtvā caturdikṣu ca vinyasetdakṣiṇe tu vivasvāṃśca ṣaṭpadaṃ caiva bhujyateuttare ṣaṭpadaṃ bhuṃkte pṛthivīdhara eva casāvitra savitāścaiva āgneyyāṃ tu padadvayamrudraradrojayaścaiva vāyavyāṃ tu padadvayeādityassatyakabhraṃśa antarikṣaśca pūrvaśaḥgandharvo bhṛṃgarāgaśca bhṛṃgaścaiva tu dakṣiṇepuṣpadantaśca varuṇa apsaraśca tathaiva cauttareṣu tathā rogānnāgo mukhyastathaiva capūtanā nair-ṛte caiva pāparākṣasi vāyaveevaṃ vinyasya devāṃśca puruṣaḥ procyate mayāāpāpavatsake vipra vāmabāhuriti smṛtaḥrudro rudrodayaścaiva vāmapādaṃ prakīrtitammitraścaiva tu liṃgasya vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛṣṭhameva camāse bhādrapadeṣvādi pūrvaśīrṣakamucyatephalgunyāditrayo māsāḥ paścimaṃ śira ucyatepūrvaśīrṣaṃ tu madhyāhne sāye dakṣiṇaśīrṣakamuṣaḥkāle tu sarveṣu uttare śira ucyatevakṣye balividhiṃ yaśca tāvacchṛṇu tapodhana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhādyā hṛdayā caiva puṣpaṃ tu śirasā tathānaivedyaṃ hṛdaye naiva nityotsavaṃ tu kārayetpratimāṃ pūrvato gatvā paścāt tu kṣaṇikaṃ bhavetutsavaṃ kārayet tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitamskandasthāpanamevoktaṃ jyeṣṭhā sthāpanakaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre skandasthāpanavidhiḥ paṃcasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥjyeṣṭhāyā sthāpanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !pūjāṃśocca pramāṇena pratimotsedhamucyatecatvāraḥ paṃcaṣaṭtālaṃ pratimasyocchrayaṃ bhavetmakuṭena samāyuktāṃ raktavastra samanvitāmdakṣiṇe putrasaṃyuktāṃ sūkarānanasaṃyutāmevaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ devyā rūpaṃ prakalpayetmūlamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi dvitīyasya tṛtīyakambindunādasamāyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhāmūlamiti smṛtamprathamasyaikādaśaṃ yuktaṃ bindunāda samanvitampaṃcamāt paṃcamaṃ gṛhya bindunāda samanvitamratnanyāsaṃ tu kartavyaṃ paṃcaratnaṃ tu mūlataḥakṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryād ājyenaiva śatāhutiḥjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryān mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vāpūrvoktamaṇḍape ramye madhye vedikayā yutamvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayetvāstu homaṃ divā kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamśayanaṃ paṃcabhiḥ kalpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetdakṣiṇe vāmapārśve tu putraṃ putrī samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmādi śakti saṃyuktaṃ kākaṃ ca kramān nyasetsavastrāṃ sāpidhānāṃ ca sahiraṇyaṃ sa kūrcakamtato homaṃ prakurvīta pālāśasamidhā sahaśālinīvāragodhūma mudge naiva samanvitammūlamantreṇa viprendra ! aṣṭottaraśatāhutiḥcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥmūlamantreṇa hotavyaṃ pratyekaṃ tu śatāhutiḥutthāpya śayanāddevīṃ sthāpayen mānuṣe padepaṃcabrahma śivāṃgaiśca snāpayecchakti kumbhakānbrāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra śaivān saṃbhojayet tataḥaṃganyāsakaranyāsaṃ paṃcabrahmeṇa kārayetāvāhayet tu sadyena vāmena sthāpanaṃ bhavethṛdayena caruṃ dadyān nityotsavaṃ tu kārayetprāsādasya samotsedhaṃ dhvajadaṇḍaṃ vidhīyatebherītāḍanakaṃ kṛtvā aṃkurārpaṇameva catato grāmabaliṃ dadyāt śuddhānnaṃ pratisamāyutamtṛtīyamṛṣirātraṃ tu caturthaṃ gandhamucyatejyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ saptamaṃ rātramityetā rātridevatāḥsnapanaṃ kārayet tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitamevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātiti vīratantre jyeṣṭhā sthāpanavidhiḥ ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥsnapanaṃ vividhaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !grahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipādakeadbhutānāṃ samutpanne prāyaścittādi saṃbhaveprāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekādaśakaraṃ vātha trayodaśakaraṃ tu vāadhamaṃ pūrvatrayaṃ siddhaṃ madhyamaṃ cāparaṃ bhavetṛṣicchando devatā vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !ādityena samāyuktaṃ uttamatrayamucyatevighneśena samāyuktaṃ madhyamaṃ trayamucyatechandenaiva samāyuktaṃ adhamatrayamucyatemaṇṭapaṃ navaṣaṭtriṃśat * * * gātra saṃyutampūrvoktena vidhānena maṇṭapaṃ kārayet tataḥproktaṃ tu navabhedena procyate tu mayā dvija !vitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtamcaturdvāra samāyuktaṃ catustoraṇa saṃyutamsṛkpaṭṭadevāṃgaiḥ netradīpairalaṃkṛtamsahasrakalaśaṃ caiva uttamottamamucyatepaṃcāśadadhika dviśataṃ uttamādhamamucyateekāśītistu madhyaṃ syān madhyamasya viśeṣataḥsumuhūrte ca sulagne ca sūtrapādaṃ tu kārayetaṣṭādhikaṃ ca viprendra ! catvāriṃśacca saṃyutamuttarāgraṃ tathaiva syādevameva krameṇa tumadhyame paṃcaviṃśattu taddvayāvṛta vīthikānbāhye padadvayaṃ nyastvā paṃca paṃca padāntareevameva krameṇaiva vidhīnāṃ lopayet kramātvyūhāntare prakartavyaṃ vyūhasthāpanamākramātpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra pavamānena prokṣayetkalaśānprati nikṣipya ardhakaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetevameva prakāreṇa hīnaṃ cāpi na kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śālyardha taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhatilaṃ nyasetpadmamaṣṭadalaṃ caiva darbhaiścaiva paristaretkalaśānāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye uttamaṃ droṇapūritamapakvamati pakvaṃ ca hīnaṃ kālaṃ ca varjayettriguṇī kṛtamoraṃ vā veṣṭayet kuṃjarākṣavatśuddhodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ kūrcamadhye vinikṣipetpaṃcāsanopariṣṭāt tu sthāpayet kumbhameva cagandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vyomavyāpi samuccaranpūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭakumbhān nyaset kramātvidyeśānāṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vinyaseddeśikottamaḥuttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ cāṣṭahastakamvistāraṃ tu catustālaṃ kalaśānveṣṭayet kramātcūrṇitaṃ hṛdaye naiva vinyasedeśikumbhakevastrairdhūpaiśca dīpaiśca gandhaiścaiva tu pūjayetmadhya vyūhaṃ tu vinyasya bāhya vyūhaṃ padaṃ nyasetājyaṃ caiva tu pūrve tu āgneyyāṃ dadhi vinyasetvāruṇyāṃ tu madhunyasya vāyavyāṃ tu nalaṃ nyasetevameva prakāreṇa vyūhaṃ prati nyaset tataḥsarṣapaṃ śālinā caiva vidikṣu vinyaset tataḥvibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī pramathādhipaḥpūrvādi vinyased vidvān pradakṣiṇakrameṇa tualābhe caiva viprendra ! yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipetkalaśānpaṃcaviṃśāṃstu vyūhaṃ prati nyaset kramātkuṣṭhaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva raghumāṃci tathaiva cauśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva tṛṇakaccolajambakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lodhraṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva caturviṃśati saṃyutamagnirudrodbhutāśī ca piṃgalaḥ khātato haraḥśālinīvāragodhūma priyaṃguṃ caiva saṃyutamlohaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ caiva caturviṃśati saṃyutamkālarudraśca vikhyātaḥ sarvadharma patistathālokāntaraḥ sphuṭā lokaḥ tryambako nāgabhūṣaṇaḥeteṣāṃ devatānāṃ tu vyūhe vyūhe prakīrtitāḥpūrvābhimukhaṃ saṃsthāpya śivomāṃ caiva deśikaḥgandhapuṣpādinā caiva kalaśānpratipūjayettato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena samanvitamsamidājya carūnlājān sarvadravya samāyutamcittādīni jayādīni homayet tu viśeṣataḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya śivakuṃbhaṃ ca vardhanīmcaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥmūlaberamanuprāpya nirmālyaṃ ca visarjayetpaṃcāsano pariṣṭāt tu śivaṃ dhyāyed vicakṣaṇaḥtato garbhagṛhaṃ gatvā prāsādena samanvitamsthāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vardhanyāṃ pīṭhakaṃ nyasetyathā sthāpanamārgeṇa sthāpayet parameśvaramvastraṃ dadyād hṛdā caiva gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dāpayetācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātiti vīratantre sahasrakalaśasthāpanavidhiḥ saptasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥko vā paṃcaśataṃ snānaṃ brūhi me parameśvara !prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catustoraṇa saṃyuktaṃ darbhamālopaśobhitammuktādāmairalaṃkṛtya maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍayet tataḥtriṃśat sūtra samāyuktaṃ prāgagrāṇi vinyasetmadhye navapadaṃ padmaṃ aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamtadbāhye tu paritaḥ padaṃ paṃca sthitāni tuśālinā vikiret tatra āḍhakaṃ kalaśaṃ pratipadmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretśuddhodakena saṃpūrya kumbhamādāya maṇḍapevardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu gaurībījena sthāpayetkūrcaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya navaratnāni vinyasetśivakumbhe śivaṃ sthāpya vardhanyāṃ ca manonmanīmvastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya svarṇaṃ tatraiva vinyasetdvitīyāvaraṇe caiva ṣaṭsaptati ca vinyasetaśītikalaśaṃ caiva vinyased deśikottamaḥtṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva aṣṭāviṃśati vinyasetsaptamāvaraṇe caiva śatakumbhāṃśca vinyasetkūrcān kalaśa saṃyuktān śuddhodakena pūritānutkūrcaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ cāhuradhaḥ kūrcaṃ tu śāntikamelālavaṃgatakkola nimbujātī phalairyutamgomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva dadhikṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathāsarṣapaṃ mudgamāṣaṃ ca priyaṃguṃ ca samanvitamajaḥ kāpāli buddhī ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥagnīrudro hutāśaśca dvitīyāvaraṇe nyasettṛtīyāvaraṇe nyasya devatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvathaāgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu kramādvinyasya devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturthāvaraṇe nyasya devatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvathasaṃyoktā ca samāyuktaṃ paṃcamāvaraṇe nyasetvyomavyāpiṃ japet tatra brahmāṃgaiśca samanvitamyathā sthāpitamārgeṇa snāpayet kalaśāṃstataḥācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt paṃcāṃgabhūṣaṇaissahaevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātiti vīratantre paṃcaśatasnapanavidhiḥ aṣṭasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥsnapanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !prāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakamdvāviṃśatiśca sūtrāṇi pūrvābhimukhameva canavapādeṣu padmaṃ syād aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamyadbāhye varaṇādbāhye padadvayaṃ ca hrāsayetśatadvayaṃ ca paṃcāśat padānyatra sthitāni tudarbhaiḥ paristaret tatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayettriguṇī kṛtasūtreṇa veṣṭayet kuṃjarākṣavatjalabhāṇḍaṃ samādāya secayedudakaṃ hṛdāelālavaṃga takkolairuśīra candanairyutamvinyasecchivakuṃbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpiṃ samuccaranabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitamvajraṃ marakataṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakamvinyasecchiva kumbhe tu vardhanyāṃ paṃcaratnakambāhyāvaraṇakaṃ tatra ṣaṭtriṃśatkalaśān nyasetkapālīśo vajrapāṇiḥ pinākī tridaśādhipaḥtṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva kalaśān ṣaṣṭi vinyasetpanasaṃ kadalī caiva mātuluṃgaphalāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāmyaṃ mṛtyuharaṃ caiva dhātā dharmapatistathāpaṃcamāvaraṇaṃ caiva ṣaṭsaptatiṃ nyaset tataḥkālarudro hutāśaśca jvalano dahanastathādravyaṃ ca devatā yuktaṃ koṇe koṇe ca vinyasethṛdā ca samidho hutvā hṛtaṃ tu śirasā tathāsarṣapaṃ * * * * * netramantreṇa caiva hisarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccarandiśāsvadhyayanaṃ kuryāt stotramantraṃ japet tataḥsnāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu prāsādena tu mantrataḥtṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ paścāt caturthāvaraṇaṃ punaḥpaṃcavarṇa havirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥpaṃcāśad dviśataṃ proktaṃ uttama trayamucyatemadhyama trayake vipra ! aṣṭottaraśataṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre paṃcāśad dviśatasnapanavidhiḥ ekonāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥetat sarvaṃ samāsena aṣṭottaraśataṃ tvathaprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ caturaśrakamcatustoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālābhirāvṛtamstambhāni veṣṭayet tatra gomayenānu lepayetdvividhaṃ sūtrapādaṃ tu śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathāuttarāgraṃ tathaiva syād sūtrasyaitāni nirdiśetcaturdikṣu ca viprendra ! dvārārthaṃ tu padaṃ tataḥtasya bāhye tu paritaḥ padadvaya sthitāni tuidamanyat pravakṣyāmi cakrasthāpanamucyateuttarāgraṃ tathaiva syāt tālamātreṇa cāntaramtāsāṃ pūrve diśo vipra ! tālamātreṇa cāntaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturbhiḥ kalaśānnyasya pauṣṭikaṃ tviha cocyateśālinā vikiret tatra adhikaṃ kalaśānpratiparistarecca darbhaiśca puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥastramantreṇa kṛtvā tu vāmena śoṣaṇaṃ bhavetāḍhakena tu saṃpūrṇān adhamaṃ tu vidhīyatebhinnaṃ kālaṃ ca suṣiraṃ bhedacchedaṃ ca varjayetśarāvaṃ caiva viprendra sūtreṇa veṣṭayet tataḥpradhāna kalaśaṃ vipra ! śuddhodakena pūrayetkalaśasya mukhe rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ madhyamake nyasetmadhyame śivakumbhaṃ tu prāsādena tu vinyasetśivakumbhe śivaṃ pūjya vardhanyāṃ gaurimeva capūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakumbhāṃśca vinyasetprathamāvaraṇaṃ hyetad dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇupādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ payaḥtṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva caturviṃśat kalā nyasetlājācūrṇa śamī caiva nīvāraṃ nālikerakamkarpūraṃ hariberaṃ ca viṃśatiṃ kalaśān nyasetagnīrudro hutāśaśca piṃgalaḥ khātako haraḥete'pi daivatāḥ proktāḥ kalaśeṣūdake nyasetcatuścatvāri kalaśān caturthāvaraṇe nyasetdāntadūrvā ca takkolaṃ puṃnāgaṃ jāti pāṭalīvyāghranakhīśatāverī maṃjiṣṭhā nāgakesarambhītā ca sahadevī ca viṣṇukrāntiḥ suvarcalābalabhadrī mahābhadrī apāmārgendu vallikācaturthāvaraṇe caiva vinyased deśikottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālarudraśca vikhyāto dharmādharmapatistathāhantā ca krūradṛṣṭiśca ūrdhvaśepho mahābhujaḥatiścalaḥ pāśahasto mahābala eva cavibhīṣaṇo mahāvego laghuvegastathaiva cakapardī meghavāhaśca jaṭāmakuṭadhārakaḥdhanuścaiva tu viprendra ! kalaśeṣūdake nyasetitareṣāṃ tu devānāṃ śivābhimukhameva caprathamāvaraṇe cāṣṭau dvitīye dvādaśa nyasetdevatānāṃ ca viprendra ! catvāriṃśadghaṭān nyasettato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdikṣu palāśakaiḥsadyādīśānaparyantaṃ kramād hutvā śivavrataiḥprāsādena tu mantreṇa paṃcāśaddhūyate kramāthutvānte tu yadasyeti juhuyāt tadanantareācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥpaścāt paṃcāsanaṃ kalpya sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ prakalpayetvardhanīṃ tasya vāme tu snāpayed gauri mantrataḥpaṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet kalaśaṃ tataḥcaturthaṃ paṃcamaṃ snātvā evamevaṃ krameṇa tuevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātiti vīratantre aṣṭottaraśata snapanavidhiḥ aśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥekāśītiḥ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva caturānana !pūrvokte naiva mārgeṇa kārayed deśikottamaḥśuddhodakena saṃpūrya śarāveṇa vidhāyateśālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradadya phalabhakṣyaṃ tu samaryāke viśeṣataḥpūṣṇe ca dadhimitre ca mahiṣakṣīrameva camahendre piṣṭamevaṃ tu * * * madhurucyatekakvānaścata * * the bimbāna ca grahakṣatesamudramatsyaṃ viprendra bhṛṃgarājabaliṃ tataḥiṣṭeva śatapiṣṭe dauvāriśca gravakeasure madhukaṃ vidyācchoṣe ca tilataṇḍulaiḥmukhye'pi dhānyacūrṇaṃ tu dadhi saṃyutameva caṛgvedave gulaṃ caivaditidaivastu modakaiḥāpe tathā pavatse ca ajamāṃsaṃ ca matsyakamindre balistathā dadyādindrajaye tu mudgakamcarakīghṛtamenaṃ tu pitāri lavaṇaṃ tathāsphaṭitaḥ kṛtopavāsaṃ ca evameva baliṃ dadetācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā upavāsasamanvitampraṇavādyena saṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyācchivadvijaḥevameva mahāśāntissarvasaṃpatkarāya caśivalokamavāpnoti śivavanmodate sadākarṣaṇasya vidhiḥ prokta ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ karṣaṇa vidhiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥkasminkule tu saṃjātāstatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !samāsātkathayiṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇusarveṣāṃ ca guruścaiva gururityabhidhīyateapramatto bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ vā gurupūjakaḥśaivāssaptavidhā jñeyāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathatṛtīyastu mahāśaivāścaturthaścānuśaivakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādena tu mantreṇa gaurībījena vardhanīmvinyaseccaiva viprendra ! abhitaḥ kalaśairyutamadhamaṃ tvaṣṭahastaṃ syān madhyamaṃ navahastakampurāṇaṃ putranāśaḥ syāt keśayuktaṃ dhanakṣayaḥpūrve tu nava kumbhaṃ tu āgneyyāṃ navakumbhakamvāruṇyāṃ navakaṃ vidvān vāyavyāṃ navakaṃ nyasetsa vastrān sāpidhānāṃśca sakūrcān vāripūritānlohaṃ priyaṃgupuṣpaṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ phalamallikāparṇakā śatapatraṃ ca tailaṃ kastūri rocanārajanī bhadrakoṣṭhaṃ ca saralaṃ kṛṣṇamālikāsiṃhī ca śaṃkhapuṣpī ca lakṣmī sthalāravindakamrudraparṇī mahālakṣmīrdhūrdhūreṇa samanvitamnadyāstīre ca goṣṭhe ca balmīke vṛṣaśṛṃgakevidyeśakuṃbhe nikṣipya paṃcagavyena saṃyutamvāruṇyāṃ navake caiva * * saṃ vinyaset kramātsaumyāyāṃ viṣṇumāvāhya * * caṇḍīśagocaresamidājya carūnlājānsarṣapena samanvitamvyomavyāpiṃ japitvā tu ājyena paṃcaviṃśatiḥsnāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpiṃ samuccaranpaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet kalaśān budhaḥācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt padārthīn pūjayet tataḥekāśītiriti proktā ekonapaṃcāśat śṛṇuiti vīratantre ekāśītisnapanavidhiḥ ekāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥekona paṃcāśatkovā tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya vitāno parisobhitamgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayetmadhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tadbāhyekaṃ tu vīthikāśālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktena vidhānataḥmadhyame'ṣṭa padaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpādinārcayetvastradvaya samāyuktaṃ sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakamkalaśān vinyaset tatra savastraṃ sāpidhānakamcandanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva meva māṃjī muraṃgulamśatapuṣpaṃ tathā vyāghrī dhātrī pūrvā harītakīhaṃsapuṣpā gandhapuṣpā mahādroṇī samanvitamajaḥ kapālīṃ buddhiśca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥagnīrudro hutāśī ca piṃgalaḥ pādako hariḥyāmyo mṛtyuharo dhātā (vidhātā) karṇakārikāsaṃyoktā ca viyoktā ca niyoktā ca prakīrtitaḥkālarudraśca vikhyāto dhātā dharmapatistathāvirūpākṣo dhūmravarṇo lohito daṃṣṭra vā budhaḥbhūtapālo lokapālaḥ kṣetrapālastathaiva caetepi daivatāḥ proktāḥ kalaśeṣūdake nyasetaiśānyāmeka homaṃ vā palāśasamidhā sahaśālinī vāragodhūma mudge naiva samanvitamhutvānte tu yadasyeti pūrṇāhutimathācaretgaurībījena vardhanyāṃ snāpayecchivakumbhakampaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena snāpayet sarvakumbhakamevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivaloke mahīyateiti vīratantre ekonapaṃcāśat snapanavidhiḥ dvayaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snapanaṃ paṃcaviṃśacca brūhi me parameśvara !prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamvitānopari saṃchannaṃ digdhvajaiśca pralambitamgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayetmadhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tadbāhyeka padaṃ tyajetāḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā prasthaṃ vā śāli vinyasettaṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasya darbhāṃścaiva paristaretpaṃcaratna samāyuktaṃ sa kūrcaṃ sāpidhānakampūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakumbhāṃśca vinyasetpaṃcagavya samāyuktaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakamāgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu catvāraḥ kumbha ucyateelālavaṃga takkolaṃ timbujātiphalaṃgulamdāntā dūrvā ca takkolaṃ puṃnāgaṃ jātipāṭalīyathā krameṇa vinyasya pūrvādīśānamantakamvibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥjvalano dahano babhruḥ bhasmāntakaḥ kṣayāntakaḥkālarudraśca viprendra ! kalaśasyādhidevatāḥtato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ pālāśasamidhā sahasamidājyacarūnlājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānpaṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgena yathā krameṇa hūyateācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥgaurībījena vardhanyāṃ snāpayet tu viśeṣataḥpaṃcavarṇa havirdadyāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥpaṃcaviṃśatirevoktā ṣoḍaśaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre paṃcaviṃśati snapanavidhiḥ tryaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalaśān ṣoḍaśān kiṃ vā brūhi me parameśvaraprāsāda syāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamvitāne nordhvamācchādya digdhajaiśca pralambitamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayetmadhye navapadaṃ sthitvā tasyāvṛta padaṃ tyajetśālinā vikiret tatra pūrvoktavidhinā sahaparistarecca darbhaiśca gandhapuṣpādinārcayetgaurī bījena vardhanyāṃ sthāpayed deśikottamaḥāgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu caturaḥ kalaśān nyasetvastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya viṇikābhiralaṃkṛtamgomūtraṃ gomayaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtaṃ tathāsadyādīśānaparyantaṃ yathā krameṇa vinyasetsnāpayecchivakumbhaṃ tu vyomavyāpi samuccaranpaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena sthāpayet kalaśāṃstataḥācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥiti vīratantre ṣoḍaśasnapanavidhiḥ caturaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥnavakumbhāḥ kathaṃ deva ! brūhi me parameśvara !prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamvitānoparisaṃchannaṃ digdhvajaiśca pralambitamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ gomayenopalepayetsūtrapātaḥ prakartavyaḥ ṣaṭsūtraṃ prākśiro bhavetśālinā vikiret tatra āḍhakaṃ kalaśaṃ pratiparistaret tu darbhaiśca padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetsavastraṃ paṃcaratnaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānakamsavastrānsahiraṇyāṃśca gandhodakena pūritān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrve gomūtrakaṃ caiva gomayaṃ cāgnideśakeājyaṃ cottarataḥ sthāpya nair-ṛte ca kuśāmbujampūrvādīśāna paryantaṃ aṣṭavidyeśvarān nyasettato homaṃ prakurvīta palāśasamidhā sahasaptadravyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ paṃcabrahmasamāyutamhutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛddhūyate kramātācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥgaurībījena vardhanyāmanantādi svamantrakaiḥadhamasyādhamaṃ proktaṃ śītakumbhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre navakumbha snapanavidhiḥ paṃcāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥetat sarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasijvaramārī vināśāya sarvāriṣṭavināśanamtriṃśat tanmadhyamaṃ proktaṃ aṣṭāviṃśati cādhamambimbaprabhānvabhāyuktaṃ bhinnaṃ kālaṃ ca varjayetkṣālayed dhṛdaye naiva darbhairupari vinyasetśālyardhataṇḍulān nyasya taṇḍulārdha tilān nyasetvastrapūtena toyena pūrayedghaṭameva cauśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva kumbhamadhye hṛdā nyasetvajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ mauktikaṃ tathāsakūrcaṃ sāpidhānaṃ ca puṣpamālā samanvitampaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena arcayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥpūrvarātre'dhivāsyātha nṛttageya samanvitamevameva nyaset kuṃbhaṃ śivastatrādhidevatākumbhasya saṃnidhau vipra ! śānti homaṃ tu kārayetevameva prakāreṇa upakumbhaṃ ca vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantranyāsoktamārgeṇa sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu kārayetliṃgasyopari viprendra ! hastamātroccamucyateabakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṭharatrayasaṃyutamdvau pārśvau pṛṣṭhataścaiva vinyaset tu tripādikānnālaṃ tatraiva vinyasya caturaṃguladairghyakamvyomavyāpiṃ samuccārya kumbhamāropayet tataḥaho rātraṃ sravan mūrdhni sarvadoṣanikṛntanamsandhyāyāṃ pūjayet paścāt pūrvoktavidhinā sahadinānte'pi ca viprendra ! kumbhāvarohaṇaṃ kuruācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥśaivān saṃbhojayet tatra samayān bhojayet tataḥśītakumbhavidhiḥ prokta adbhutānāṃ vidhiṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre śītakumbhavidhiḥ ṣaḍaśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥadbhutānāṃ vidhiḥ ko vā tat sarvaṃ brūhi me prabhobhūmikampe diśādāhe dhūmaketānupasthiteanāvṛṣṭyādikāle tu grahaśāntiṃ samācaretśālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā taṇḍulān vinyaset tataḥsthāpayeccaiva viprendra ! trayaṃ caiva tu madhyametrayāṇāṃ madhyame caiva grahāṇāṃ caiva vinyasetcandramāgneya digbhāge aṃgārakaṃ tu dakṣiṇeketuṃ ca vāyudigbhāge uttare tu bṛhaspatimbhāskarasyeśvaro devaḥ pūrvābhimukha eva carāhoḥ kāliṃga devastu yamodevaśśanestathābudhaśca viṣṇudaivatya ityetā grahadevatāḥindrāṇī ca prajāpatyaḥ sarpā brahmādhidevatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ pūrve tu viprendra ! sikataiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kuruādityasya ca vṛttaṃ syāśukrasya paṃcakoṇakamrāhoḥ śūrpākṛtiścaiva dhanuścaiva śanaiścarebṛhaspatestu vijñeyaṃ budhasya bhagavān bhavettattadvarṇāni puṣpāṇi pūjayed deśikottamaḥaṃgārakasya khadiraṃ apāmārgaṃ budhasya caśamīṃ śanaiścare vidyād rāhoḥ dūrvāhutirbhavetaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi aṣṭāviṃśatireva vāevaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ homayecchivadīkṣitaḥeṣāmīśeti mantreṇa ādityasyaiva hūyateśukrahomamiti proktaṃ āpyāyassomamabravītagnirmūrdhā ca sometā aṃgārakasya hūyateśanno devī prajāpate śanihomaṃ prakīrtitamādiyasyo bṛhatsāmajñānamācāryaṃ homamucyatepaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgena prāsādena samanvitamkṣīrasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śrīrudreṇa viśeṣataḥativṛṣṭirbhavet tatra subhikṣaṃ kurute tataḥmahāmārī pravṛtte tu snapanaṃ tu sahasrakamraktakanyā samutpanne śṛṇu tatvaṃ pitāmaharājñāṃ grāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā vināśaṃ vrajati dhruvamvāhanānāṃ kṣayo yāmye bhāryānāśastu nair-ṛtejvarāpasmāraṃ vāyavyāṃ saumye vyādhimavāpnuyātnirmālyakuṇḍe dṛśyeta rājarāṣṭravināśanamdhānyaśālāya nāśaḥ syādvāre dveśmagṛnyakambrāhmaṇakṣatriyāṇāṃ ca antarmaṇḍalake bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyahāre'pi dṛśyante śūdrāṇāṃ kṣayamāpnuyātagnijādikṣayaṃ caiva mahāmaryādibhittikeevameva prakāreṇa adbhutaṃ dṛśyate bhayamvyapohya sakalaṃ tatra paṃcagavyena prokṣayetghanaṃ kṛtvā tu taddeśe śāntihomaṃ tadūrdhvataḥpūrvavadvidhinā yuktaṃ homaṃ kuryāt tu deśikaḥevaṃ kṛtvā mahāśāntiṃ sarvadoṣaharāya cavyapohya sakalaṃ tatra diśāhomaṃ tu kārayetsnāpayed devadeveśaṃ mahāhavirnivedayetpuṇyāhaṃ kārayet tatra pavamānena prokṣayetanyevācādbhutotpanne snapanaṃ kārayet tataḥadbhutānāṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ kṛttikādīpa ucyateiti vīratantre adbhutaśāntividhiḥ saptāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥko vā tu kṛttikādīpaḥ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !kārtike tu tathā māse nakṣatre kṛttikāyutekṛttikādīpahīne tu jvaramārī pravartatenavavastreṇa kṛtvā tu vartiṃ kārpāsa saṃyutamśiva prapūrite pātre vinyased dhṛdayena tuprāsādamūrdhni vinyasya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥjātī vā campakaṃ vāpi kramukaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tu vāprāsādasadṛśaṃ vāpi galāntaṃ vāpi kārayetetaddīpena saṃyojya paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥvastreṇa veṣṭayet tatra ghṛtena ca pariplutamdīpaṃ saṃyojya viprendra ! sadyojātena mantrataḥvimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādgarbhagehaṃ praveśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācārya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥdīpadaṇḍaṃ tu viprendra ! viṣṇudīpena yojayetprāsādena tu mantreṇa dīpān sarvatra yojayetnānādīpa samāyuktaṃ rātrau mahotsavaṃ kuruanādiveśyā saṃyuktaṃ gaṇikādāsibhissahaevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātkṛttikādīpa evoktaḥ agrāśanamataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre kṛttikādīpavidhiḥ aṣṭāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥagrāśanaṃ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !śubhe muhūrte maṃgalye bhūmi saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhavetcaitre cāryāpabharaṇī kuryāt bhūmipraveśanamdvitīyā daśamī grāhyā vṛṣavṛścika karkaṭāḥbhūmipraveśanaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣikarma tvathocyatemūlā punarvasuścaiva rohiṇī cottaratrayamnavamīṃ caiva viprendra ! varjayet kṛṣi karmasuvṛṣabhe karkaṭe mīne mithune siṃhalagnakeśvetau raktau ca kapilau nāgacchinnau vṛṣau tathāgocarmarajjunā caiva halaṃ caiva tu bandhayetprāgukta vasayedbhūmiṃ sadyojātena mantrataḥmūlānurādhā hastā ca maghārauhiṇi revatīśatabhiṣak ca nakṣatraṃ praśastaṃ bījakarmasuekādaśī tṛtīyā ca praśastā bījakarmaṇiyamakumbha tulā madhyāḥ śeṣāṃstu parivarjayetevameva prakāreṇa bījāvāpanamucyatebhūmi praveśanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvābhimukhamāsthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛdena bhūmirūpaṃ tu prākśiraḥ kārayed budhaḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayet tatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayejjanānbindunāda samāyuktaṃ mūlamantramihocyatenaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāllājāpūpa samanvitamaṃjaliṃ śālicūrṇaṃ tu mūlamantra samanvitamnamo'stu subhage ! nityaṃ kṛṣikarmedhyatāmihaācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād daivajñaṃ pūjayet tataḥtato bhaktajanaissārdhaṃ praviśedālayaṃ praticaṇḍeśa pratimāyuktaṃ sarvātodya samanvitamhastatrayottarāyāṃ ca rohiṇyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥśukaṃ grāhyāstramantreṇa śirasā dhārayet tataḥraviraśmisusaṃtaptaṃ prabhinnaṃ kṣipalūkhalehastaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ caiva revatyaśvatireva caśraviṣṭhā śatabhiṣak caiva anūrādhā triruttarāmeṣavṛścikamīnāstu varjyāḥ śeṣāstu pūjitāḥtaṇḍulaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ nālikeraphalairyutampratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ evamevākṣamaṃ dadetevaṃ nivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥagrāśanamidaṃ proktaṃ bālasthāpanamataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre agrāśanavidhirekonanavatitamaḥ paṭalaḥbālasthānaṃ kathaṃ deva ! tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !dvāramānena vā ku * bhittimānena vā punaḥśailajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi bālaliṃgaṃ karoti hipūjāṃśoccaṃ nava kuryādviṣva? māgānvitaṃ tu ?tritālaṃ madhyamoktaṃ adhamaṃ tu dvitāla * * ?
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptamo vā nyaśaivastu śaivānāṃ bheda ucyatemahāśaivaḥ kevalo vipraḥ kṣatriyo vaiśya eva casavarṇāmbaṣṭha madhyasthau kulālapāraśavāstathāanyeṣāmihajātī nāmanya śaiva mihocyatekauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva bhāradvājo trireva caśivena dīkṣitāścaiva śivabrāhmaṇa ucyatekauśikaścottaramukhaḥ kāśyapaścaiva dakṣiṇeatrirūrdhvamukhaṃ jñeyaṃ evameteṣu dīkṣitāḥkauśikaḥ śivabhaktastu kāśyapastvīśvareṇa tuatressadāśivaścaiva umādhūrtastu dīkṣitaḥśivadīkṣātparaṃ jātaḥ śivabrāhmaṇa ucyategokarṇe tu bharadvājo nāgarikastu gautamaḥśaivaṃ pāśupataṃ somaṃ lākulaṃ ca caturvidhameteṣāmapi tantrāṇāṃ navatvaikasya tu saṃkaraḥtantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyatikāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathāvijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamathānalamcandrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathākiraṇaṃ vā tulaṃ tvetāstvaṣṭāviṃśati saṃhitāḥācāryaṃ śivamevāhuḥ śiva ācārya ucyatesaubhadro viṣayākhyātā kauśalā māgadhāstathākeralaścāryadeśaśca mālavaṃ ca marūṇi cajonakāstuluvāścaiva karṇāṭakaśca deśataḥkumārī himavanmadhye * * * * * * * *haihalaṃ bagharaṃ jonyaṃ varjayelliṃgakarmaṇi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tena mānena kartavyaṃ liṃgasya bhāgamuttamamadhamo brahmabhāgaḥ syān madhyamo * ṇu? ucyateliṃgasūtraṃ tu kartavyaṃ nālaṃ caiva tu kalpa * ?bālaliṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ evameva krameṇa tuvāruṇe vāpi kartavyaṃ bālasthānamihocyatetrihastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā saptahastamathāpi vābālasthānasya vāme tu prapālitvā * * * *?vṛttaṃ vā caturarthaṃ vā a * *?ni * * * *?sthā *?lopari vinyasya śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīmāvāhya devadeveśaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayetpūrvavat sthaṇḍile vipra ! atrāhyeva? tu kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādiśaivakule jātassa tu vaidika ucyatedīkṣitasya kule jātassarvāgamaviśāradaḥsarvāyavasaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥkriyādi jñānaparyantatantrajñāna viśāradaḥsanābhiḥ kunakho * * bālo vṛddhastathaiva caatidīrgho'tihṛsvaśca atisthūlaḥ kṛśastathānagnaprabhā tathā kṣībaśmaśruromādivarjitaḥanabadyāśca viprendra gaṇakāśca tathaiva cavyasanāḥ krūrakarmāṇaḥ pāradārika corakāḥkuṣṭhinaścakṣuhīnāśca badhirāḥ śrutidūṣakāḥrājarāṣṭrāpi naśyanti tasmindeśe na varṣatiādiśaivena kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhādyarcanāntakamsa gotreṇa tu sambandhaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācanaeṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ viprendra jātānāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥupanayana kālānte maṇḍale pūjayecchivamsthiraliṃgaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ spṛśyate tvabhicārataḥātmārthaṃ pūjayennityaṃ sarveṣāṃ jātireva caācāryahastayordadyācchiva lokamavāpnuyātśivadvijānāṃ sarveṣāṃ na doṣāya prakalpayetācāryahastayordadyācchiva lokamavāpnuyātpatitaṃ cānucāṇḍāla dhūpadeśevikaṃ śivimgrāmakukkuṭamevaṃ tu saṃspṛṣṭvāgniṃ tathaiva casnānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprenda sa prāsādena saṃyutamprayaṃ prātastrayaṃ sāyaṃ * * madyādayācitamṣoḍaśānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ ca pūrvamevācarettathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣā(yā) maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇuiti vīra tantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ ācārya lakṣaṇaṃ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥmaṇḍalaṃ kīdṛśaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhotatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanaudyāne caiva goṣṭhe vā mahātaṭākatīrake vāatha śuddhagṛhe vāpi kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ tataḥśrutihastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā ṣaḍhastamadhamatrayamdaśaikādaśahastaṃ tu dvādaśaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetṣoḍaśastambha saṃyuktaṃ paṃktimānamathocchrayekramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ vā vakulī ketakī tathānālikerasya patreṇa vidheyamācchādanaṃ tataḥdigdhvajaiśca samāyuktaṃ vitānopariśobhitamevameva krameṇaiva pūrvaṃ bhūmiṃ parīkṣayetvaiśyasya vasudhā pītā kṛṣṇā śūdrā iti smṛtāvaiśyasya ṣaḍrasā jñeyā śūdrastu kaṭukā smṛtāmūtragandhā tu vaiśyasya śūdrā viṣṭhānugandhinīhastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ pūrayettena pāṃsunāhīnācāpyadhamaṃ jñeyamadhamaṃ ca vivarjayetpaṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥpāṃsubhiśchāyayitvā tu dhiṣṇyaṃ samyak prakalpayetpūrvāgraṃ saptahastaṃ syādudagagraṃ tathaiva caīśo jayanta ādityā satyakaśca bhṛśastathābhṛṃgaśca pitṛ sugrīvo varuṇaścāsurastathāardhārdhadvipadaṃ bhuṃkte pūrve tu samarīcakaḥardhārdhadvipadaṃ bhuṃkte uttare pṛthivīdharaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrajayaśca viprendra īśānaika padasthitāḥcarakī vidārī caiva pūtanā pāparākṣasīpururṣaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃkalpya * * rīke śiro bhavetsāvitrīṃ candra ca viprendra dakṣīmabahurucyateindrajayastathaiva syāddakṣiṇaṃ pādamucyategandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca varuṇaścaiva pūjitampūrve catuṣpade caiva aṣṭādaśa tu bhājayetevameva krameṇaiva caturdikṣu ca bhrāmayetbāhyakārṇaṃ pade cārdho vartayedvṛttameva caprativāraṇarekhā ca ekāṃgulena kārayetaṃgulenaiva bhūmitvā * * * * * * * *aṃgule naiva viprendra upaśobhāṃ ca vartayetkesaraṃ tu tribhāgaikaṃ karṇikāṃ caiva vartayetmokṣadaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ śāntikaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathanair-ṛte śānakoṇe vā vāyavyāgneyameva vākhādirāḥ śaṃkavaḥ kāryā bilvacūtakadambakaiḥaṣṭāṃgulasamutsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ nāhamucyatedalāyāmaṃ ca viprendra caturdaśāṃgulaṃ bhavetśobhā vapyupaśobhāṃ ca vartayedaṃgulāntarāmaṇḍalaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi muktācūrṇena saṃyutamgairikaiṣṭaka cūrṇaiśca indranīlasya cūrṇakaiḥharidrā cūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍale vinyasettataḥmadhyame pītavarṇaṃ tu agre śvetamihocyateāgneyyāṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca yāmye kṛṣṇamihocyatetadante rajanīṃ nyasya śālipiṣṭaṃ tadantake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vāhastaṃ ca triṃśatirvāpi ita urdhvaṃ na kārayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi dalasaṃkhyā vidhīyatepuruṣaṃ pūrvadale nyasya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe daleāgneyyāṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiramīśānake dalekavacaṃ vāyudeśe tu netramīśāna deśakedaityake tu pade caiva śiṣyādhivāsanaṃ bhavetbrāhmīke maṇḍale kuryādevameva krameṇa tuprokṣayedambhasā caiva puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥāvāhayettato devaṃ sadyo jātena mantrataḥsāṃnidhyaṃ puruṣeṇaiva īśānena tu pūjayetnivedaccaraṇaṃ tasmātsarvopadaṃśa saṃyutampātraśeṣaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ taṃ tacchiṣyāya pradāpayetācamya vidhinānena dantenāspṛśya prāśayetdantakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryāddvādaśāṃguladairghyakamkṣīravṛkṣamapāmārgaṃ dantadhāvanamucyateśodhayitvā malaṃ vipra ācamya ca vidhānataḥaghoreṇa tu mantreṇa bhasma śirasi vinyasetśivāṃgairbrahmabhiryuktaṃ japitvā paṃcaprāśayetśiṣyaṃ cādhivasenmantrī maṇḍalasya tu dakṣiṇeagnikuṇḍaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśaṃ tu vāvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayetpālāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodhameva casamidājya caruṃ lājānbaliṃ ca sarṣapaṃ tathāsamidhaṃ sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ hṛdayameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śilānyanneyamaṃ caiva śālīṃ ca puruṣeṇa tuśivāya daśahotavyaṃ vidyeśādviguṇaṃ bhavettriguṇaṃ lokapālāstraṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥsa vastrānsāpidhānāṃśca samagre hemasaṃyutāndhānyopari vidhātavyaṃ candanodakapūritampuruṣaṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tuaiśānyāmīśamantreṇa āgneyyāṃ hṛdayena tutattanmantreṇa saṃyuktaṃ tattatkumbheṣu deśikaḥhṛdayena tu mantreṇa naivedyaṃ dāpayecchiveśubhāśubhāni svapnāni yatnena tu parīkṣayetviṣṭhānulepaṃ rudhirasrutiṃ ca svapneṣu gamyaṃ gamanaṃ ca dhānyampaśyate piśajaṃ svapne mahā(na)rthamavāpnuyātarpitaṃ pilitaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ vā śubhavṛkṣakeśālikṣetre mahaṃ pakvaṃ dṛśyate śālilābhakamdṛśyate puṣpamālāyā arthalābhaṃ vinirdiśetsvapnepi dṛśyate vipra dhanalābhaṃ vinirdiśetśārikāṃ vā bhayaṃ vāpi dṛśyet kuṭumbavardhanampatraṃ vā cārthalābhaṃ vā labhate'tra saṃśayaḥdātavyamapi svapnepi (tu) duḥkhanāśaṃ bhavanti vaijanaṃ vā vānaraṃ vāpi sarpaṃ vāpi ca dṛśyateprāsādārohaṇaṃ vāpi samudraṃ dṛśyate naraḥādityamaṇḍalaṃ svapne darśanādrājyamāpnuyātarthalābhamavāpnoti darśanādarthamāpnuyātvidyālābhaṃ dvijānāṃ tu itarastu dhanaṃ labhetamedhyaṃ darśanaṃ bhakṣye arthalābhaṃ vinirdiśet

sanskrit: raktapāne mahāvyādhirājyaṃ ca dadhibhojanammahatsukhamavāpnoti māsā maraṇamāpnuyātmūḍho vā līyate pakṣe māsānmaraṇamāpnuyātnigalaṃ cātra dṛśye tu mahadvyādhimavāpnuyātpādadeśe sthitā nārī vyādhitairmaraṇaṃ bhavetmāsānmaraṇamāpnoti svapnānte dṛśyate yadisaṃnyāsinaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ boddhaṃ dṛśyate maraṇaṃ bhavetmahāstriyamavāpnoti svapnānte dṛśyate yadikiṃśukaṃ raktapuṣpāṇi karavīraṃ tu varjayetnarāṇāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho rājānāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetdhenuṃ (ca) vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ caiva mṛgaṃ tathākulasthaṃ sarṣapaṃ mudgaṃ dṛśyate vyādhimāpnuyāteteṣāṃ tu phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanadhānyaṃ mavāpnuyātyastu paśyati svapnānte dhanamāyuryaśo bhavetmāṃsaṃ vāpi ca matsyaṃ vā labdho śubhadaṃ bhavetrājā pīḍāmavāpnoti pratārairvyādhimādiśetraṇḍāṃ ca muṇḍāṃ vāpi nagnastrīṃ vāpi paśyatipurīṣaṃ vāpi mūtraṃ vā na svapne darśayettataḥśālyannaṃ bhuṃjate yastu āyuḥ śrīkīrtivardhanamśubhe tu praviśeddīkṣāmaśubhe homamācaretsarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinīsvapnaṃ tu prathame yāme vatsaratraya pākanamcaturthe viśvayāme ca ṣaṇmāsātsidhyate tataḥaruṇodayavelāyāṃ saptāhātsiddhimāpnuyātsvapnaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā prabhāte snapanaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍi cagolokaṃ śivalokaṃ ca kramameṣāṃ prakīrtitamnābhimūlātsamārabhya yāvaddhṛdayadeśakamakāraṃ mūrdhnideśe tu ākāraṃ tu lalāṭakeḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍakedantapaṃktidvaye nyasya aṃ aḥ ityakṣaradvayamṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādakemakāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ caiva vinyasetlakāraṃ mede vinyasya śakāraṃ cādhideśakehakāraṃ prāṇamityāhu lakāraṃ meḍhrameva canavatriṃśatkalā vipra kādipādāntavinyasetnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva catato mohau kṣudhānidrā mṛtyumāyajarā mayādhṛtiḥ kāryā ca rātrī ca bhrāmaṇī mohinī tathānavatriṃśatkalāvyātā devadevena dhīmahiākāśaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya paṃcatatvānkramānnyasettatvā vaiśyaghoreṇa bhuvanādhvā puruṣeṇa tuevameva krameṇaiva śiṣyadehe nyasettataḥhṛdaye brahmaṇaḥ proktaṃ aśvinyāṃ hastayornyasetdeśikaścātmanā vipra śivastatraiva tiṣṭhatiyaddravyaṃ pātraśeṣādi śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥśivamuddiśya sarvaṃ tu vastradhānyādikāñcanamdīkṣāvidhiriti proktaṃ abhiṣekamataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre dīkṣāvidhiḥ navamaḥ paṭalaḥabhiṣekaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho

sanskrit: godhūmayavamudgāṃśca sarṣapaṃ ca yathākramamlakṣmī ca sahādevī ca viṣṇukrāntiṃ trayaṃbalāvinyasettu viśeṣeṇa svasvanāmānumantrataḥaṣṭadikṣu ca homaḥ syāllakṣaṇena samanvitampalāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodha bilvakaiḥsamidājyacarunlājānyavaśālitilānapiyāvadvai kumbhasaṃkhyā tu tāvatsaṃkhyā tu homayetyāgasthānasya vāruṇyāṃ mahādevasya * * * *adhyayanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ caturvedaiścaturdiśiyāgasthānasya vāruṇyāṃ mahādevasya pūrvataḥbrahmairaṃgaiśca saṃyukta vyomavyā(pi)samāyutamgandhapuṣpādinā pūjya prāsādena tu mantrataḥsā varṇaka * atrādya * nta siṃhahani bhojanam* * * * * * * * * * parvatavāhanamācāryāya pradātavyaṃ mānaṃ ca nivedayetsagulaṃ goghṛtairyuktaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutamācāryaḥśiṣyasaṃyuktaṃ bhojayedvidhipūrvakamlājānta saṃyuktamapūvaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutamcatuṣpathe pathe caiva dvipathekai ca vidhiraveevamevakrameṇaiva abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetvidhinā kārayedyastu tasya mṛtyurna vidyateabhiṣekaṃ mayā proktaṃ śaivācāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ abhiṣeko nāmadaśamaḥ paṭalaḥkīdṛśānīha sarvaṃ tadvaktuṃ sarvamihārhasiniṣekādi sapiṇḍāntaṃ śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana

sanskrit: śucau deśe samaṃ kṛtvā sitānvinyasettataḥhastamātreṇa viprendra kuryādvai sthaṇḍilaṃ tataḥvyapoṣya kalaśaṃ tatra hastau prākṣālayettataḥvyāhṛtyāvānayedagniṃ ṣolkālayettataḥparistīrya tato darbhairhastamātraiścaturdiśidakṣiṇānuttarānagrānadhastādvinyasettataḥparīdhīnhastamātreṇa * * * * * caiva hihṛdayena tu darbhāṃśca paridhī śikhayā sahadarbhoparinyasedvipra śarāvaṃ samidhā sahaprokṣayedambhasā caiva gandhapuṣpādinārcayetsthaṇḍilādakṣiṇe bhāge brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥdvedarbhāgrasamāyuktaṃ tiraḥ pavitraṃ vinyasetdarbhānekera viprendra ājyādhiśravaṇaṃ bhavetsruvaṃ caiva tu darbhāṃśca mārjayeddeśikottamaḥpariṣecanaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhṛdayena samanvitamprajāpataye svāheti sruveṇaiva tu homayetathājyabhāgaṃ hotavyaṃ agnesvāheti mantrataḥyuktau vahādi ṣaḍbhiśca bhūyate kramaśodhanamṛtusnātānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca ṛṭusaṃgamanaṃ śṛṇutatra cāgnimukhaṃ kāryaṃ ūrdhvavaktraṃ caturbhujamhṛdayena tu mantreṇa hūyate kramaśodhanamevameva prakāreṇa rākṣasānāṃ tu tṛptayeayantayonirityāśca agnayerājñayā tanupraṇītasyoṣṭha prakṣālya prokṣiṇyāmudakena tuvardhanīṃ vyāpayettatra prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ

sanskrit: śayane śāyayettatra daṃpatibhyāṃ samanviteviṣṇuryoniti mantreṇa mūlaliṃgaṃ bhavanti vaiyonisaṃgamanaṃ kuryāduktareta sa saṃyutamsomābhivardha ityuktaṃ tadasyāṃgaṃ ca tiṣyatiniṣekametaduddiṣṭaṃ tava snehādviśeṣataḥiti vīratantre ṛtu saṃgamanavidhiḥ ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥrohiṇī revatīhastā śravaṇaṃ cānanāyakamsaumya jīvasitendūnāṃ drekkāṇāvasāṃśakampuruṣaṃ jīvanāmeti pradakṣiṇamathācaretsadyena homayettatra paṃcaviṃśatirāhutiḥtataḥ paṃkti viprendra sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥpuruṣeṇodasparśa garbhādhānaṃ bhavanti vaiiti vīratantre garbhādhānavidhiḥ dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥmāsadvayānte kartavyaṃ sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutamguruśukrabudhajñānāṃ udayaṃ śastameva caaṃkurāṇīha kartavyaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥagnimukhaṃ samāstīrya yukto vāhādi bhūyategarbhau agnau vidhānaṃ tu ājyāhutimathācaretnyagrodhaudumbarāśvattha palāśaṃ khādirā sahadakṣiṇe caiva nāsā ca asmai devāna mantrataḥprācīnaṃ vāpyudīcīnaṃ cchedadarśapaṃ tataḥdhruvāyetatyarundhatyāmiti bruvandarśayettataḥstridharmasyā tu strīṇāṃ tu kurute nātra saṃśayaḥtīrthānāṃ tu nakhākośa vānādireva caantarvartnyāḥ patiḥ kuryānna prajā bhavati śruvam

sanskrit: iti vīratantre puṃsavanavidhiḥ trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥmāsāccatuṣṭaye prāpte ṣaṇmāse vāpi kārayetrohiṇyāṃ caiva puṇye ca uttarā ca punarvasusīmantonnayanaṃ kuryācchubhāsye śubhalagnakepuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra agnimukhaṃ ca kārayetājyā hutiṃ kariṣyāmi * * * * * * * *kāmayediti mantreṇa rāvikhareṇakhayetsinībalī khamantreṇa audumbareṇa homayetvanavāsī cāsīva pāśvetikeśārvanilaṃ badhyate tataḥśeṣaṃ puṃsavanādeva kartavyaṃ syātsurottamaiti vīratantre sīmantavidhiḥ caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu viṣṇumabhyarcayettataḥagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvavallakṣaṇānvitamkeśavaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva govindaṃ mādhavaṃ tathāśrīdharaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ tathaiva cacarubhojanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ yāddhṛdavasānakeājyāhutistathaivaṃ syātpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥaṣṭānāṃ brahmacārīṇāṃ bhojayettu viśeṣataḥiti vīratantre viṣṇubalividhiḥ paṃcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥabhijātaṃ kumāraṃ ca darśayed hṛdayena tuadbhyassaṃbhūtamantreṇa snāpayedvidhi pūrvakamīśānādimantrāṇāṃ mūrdhni jighratimucyateaśvābhava paraśubhaṃ japtvā caiva viśeṣataḥbrūhitāntena saṃprārcyāṃ hiraṇyena samāyutamāyurārogyamedhāvīti prāśayet
