source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yastestenemimantreṇa mātussavyastanetreṇa mātustanaṃ dadetsa caivaṃ sthāpayitvā tu agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayethariharaṃ ca mucca * * pa * * tathaiva casadyaṃ ca kamanāya aśvatthāparṇasaṃyutam* * * * * taṃ ca gau tilasarṣapahomayetāveśanāvyatra khīphalīkaraṇa homayetiti vīratantre jātakarmavidhiḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥuttarārevatīhastā śatabhiṣaṅmūlapuṣyakāḥśraviṣṭhā conati nakṣatrātpraśastā nāmakarmaṇiīśānaṃ prājāpatye nāmakaraṇaṃ ca bhūyatemārgasīrṣe tu puṣyeśaṃ śaṃbhuriti smṛtaḥcaitre tu sthāṇu nāmaṃ ca vaiśākhe tu śivastathāśravaṇe sarvanāmaṃ tu bhādramāse triyambakameteṣāṃ nāmamuccārya gurornāmastu vācayetnāmakaraṇaṃ ca mevaṃ tu kartavyaṃ syātsurottamaiti vīratantre nāmakaraṇavidhiḥ saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥaśvinī somadaivatyaṃ revatī ca punarvasucitrādiruttarāścaiva śatabhiṣagrohiṇī tathādaśamasthā grahāścaiva neṣṭāssarvaprayatnataḥīśānena tu mantreṇa svasyātreṇa juhoti casikataiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā aśvatthaṃ sthāpayettataḥsvānnigrahānnāmayantīti evameva vidhīyateiti vīratantre upaniṣkramaṇavidhiraṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥṣaṣṭhame māsi saṃprāpte annaprāśanameva caśravaṇaṃ ca śraviṣṭhā ca hastasvātyanurādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣyaṃ caiva tu nakṣatrā praśastāścānna bhojanepūrvedyurbhojayedviprānyugmaṃ nādimukhaṃ tataḥśubhaṃ saṃpūjayettatra citreṇacchādayettathāputra ca mūrdhni madhye tu atijighratpratipadmajaḥpaṃcabrahmasamāyuktaṃ gomaye sapta cāhutiḥyāmāta oṣadhīsteti madhuno madhunopya cabrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra ācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥiti vīratantre annaprāśanavidhirekonaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ* * * trīṇi saṃprokte śubhanakṣatra saṃyutampuṣyā punarvasū caiva mṛgaśīrṣakameva capuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra kuru brāhmaṇa bhojanameke sino'tinaktaṃ ca iti hutvā hutiṃ tataḥīśānena tu mantreṇa paṃcāśajjuhuyāttataḥpiṇḍaṃ sākṣata saṃyuktaṃ śarāve sādhayettataḥkeśāśca secayettatra kuṃśena prokṣayettataḥkarmamadhye śikhāṃsthāpya gavāmabhimukhaṃ tataḥkumāraṃ snāpayettatra prokṣayeddhṛdayena tusvasti vācakasaṃyuktaṃ dadyādācāryadakṣiṇāmiti vīratantre caulavidhirviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥgarbhāṣṭameṣu viprāṇāṃ rājanyaikādaśaṃ tataḥṣoḍaśābdāvidhiṃścaiva brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥsvātī mṛgaśirāścaiva punarvasuḥ prakīrtitaḥsnānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprenda sarvaṃ cābhi pradakṣiṇamagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetyāvatkuntantatāvatyā vastrayugmaṃ tu veṣṭayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āpañca ācamitrasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadettataḥdevasyatveti savyena pakvāhutimathācaretbrahmasūktena hutvā tu hutvā vyāhṛti nāmataḥcatasṝḥ palāśasamidho hotavyaṃ nīcajīvināāditya vratapate caiva vratānāṃ vratapatepi caagnerdakṣiṇataḥ sthāpya astreṇābhyukṣayettataḥbrahmacāryasyābhimukhaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca japettataḥtatkāle maṇḍalaṃ likhya yathā vidhipurassarammaṇḍalasyottare bhāge kalaśāṃsthāpayettataḥīśānādivyāhṛtibhirnavasamidhā samāyutamācāryaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryādgobhūmīkāṃcanādibhiḥarghyeṇaiva tu māyāṃśca dadyānmāṇavake tataḥprātaḥ snātvā'pa ācamya sūryaśceti jalaṃ pibetagniśceti ca sānneti kāle kāle pibettataḥañjalyodakamādāya vyāhṛtyā sūryābhimukhaṃ sṛjet* * * sahāraṃ * * * * * * * praviśetprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryāṣṭaśataṃ japetmitrassametya nayaści siddhasandhyopasthānamācaretagniṃ caiva paristīrya pariṣecanamācaretevamevakrameṇaiva sāyaṃ prātaśca homayetkṣāraṃ ca madhumāṃsādi lavaṇa caiva varjayetevameva krameṇaiva balaṃ prāyeṇa naktakamdve striyau samalaṃkṛtya śraddhā medhā prayāmitievameva kramaṃ kuryādāyuṣyaṃ balamāpnuyātagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya sruksruve ceti mantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catasrasamidhā caiva pūrvavaddhūpayettataḥpalāśamūle daṇḍaṃ ca ajinaṃ mauñjīmaṇi vā sakhāapa ācamya viprendra jayādiṃ hūyate tataḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śivadīkṣāsamanvitāniti vīratantre upanayanavidhiḥ ekaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥnadītaṭāke gatvā tu navarṣīṃstarpayettataḥagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya ṛṣīṇāṃ ca hūyatepunaḥ pariṣecanaṃ kṛtvā yathā vidhi ca hūyatesahasrasamidhāṃ ca hūyate kramaśastataḥiti vīratantre upākarmavidhiḥ dvāviṃśati paṭalaḥsnātvā tu śucivāsāśca hutvā vai śukriyāvṛtaḥgātraṃ ca veṣṭhakaṃ kuryānnavavastreṇa deśikaḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śivabhaktisamanvitāniti vīratantre śukriyavratavidhistrayoviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥsvātīmūlānurādhā * * * * * * * stathāte nakṣa(trā)ṇi suraśreṣṭha saptame grahavarjitammauñjyā * * * * * * brahmacārikare dadetkṛṣṇakeśā * * * * * * roma tathaiva casnātakasya vrataṃ caiva hutvā caiva viśeṣataḥājyāhutiṃ mayāmaṃ tu sarvāneva hunettataḥevaṃ mantramanusmṛtya bilvaṃ caiva tu nikṣipetprativeśānimantreṇa udaraṃ co'bhimantrayetpūrvasyāṃ diśi śāstreṇa diva * taṃ ca vandayetsamāvartana vṛddhyādi vyāhṛtyājyena hūyatepāṇigrahaṇa pra * * tīryā cairvā vrīhistulāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūryāya prajāpataye prātaścaiva hūyateayāścāgneti mantreṇa hotavyaṃ dīrghajīvināmiti vīratantre samāvartanavidhiścaturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥsvātīmūlānurādhā ca maghā mṛgaśirastathākanyāyāṃ mithune caiva tulāyāṃ mṛgakumbhayoḥsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kanyāṃ caiva parigrahetudaṅmukhaṃ samabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥviśvetveti hi mantreṇa brahmansāmeti mastakamsnāto vastradharo bhūtvā vapurjāta hirarpitampiturutsaṃgamāviśya tasya puruṣaṃ tu mantrakampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra dakṣiṇe pati tiṣṭhatitābhyāṃ hūsasaṃbhūya hantalāśca viśeṣataḥsāvitraṃ ca tato datvāpahāṃsi śirasi nikṣipetdarbhāntanmūlasaṃyuktānsaptapaṃcāni nikṣipetsakhā saptapadaṃ caiva viśeṣa * * lpe tasya paścimatodiśihṛdayeneti mantreṇa hṛdayaṃ sparśayettataḥagneruttarataḥ sthānaṃ sthāpayettu viśeṣataḥhastaṃ prakṣālayettatra lājānhastau tu pūrayetpunaḥ patnīti mantreṇa hṛdayena samāyutamjayādimabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyatehutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭa kṛya caiva hūyatearundhatīṃ ca dṛśyeta dhruvosīti mantrataḥcatubhirmaṃgalībhiśca śayanaṃ kalpayettataḥcaturthadivase caiva agnimukhaṃ ca hūyatejayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rātriśca kramāddhute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaṃ pradadyāddaṃpatyobījaścaiva tu rāhayetguhye vāmena saṃspṛśya ṛtugamanaṃ ca sehategrāmātprāgi prayātu udumbaraṃ ca dṛśyatejānudaghnajale sthitvā vastre * * myāṃśca grāhayetdaśamehani viprendra agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayetdaśabaliṃ tataḥ kuryādgṛhaṃ prāpya ca deśikaḥiti vīratantre vivāhavidhiḥ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥudumbareṇa śākhā ca apte vidhinā mārjayetyamāya dahanapatayetyasadeti vinikṣipetcitāya pretaṃ vinyasya prokṣayeddhṛdayena tuvātāste pasatīsvīti navāṃ caiva tu kārayetasmāttvamabhijāto sītyagniṃvikṣipya deśikaḥśarāvaṃ pāṣāṇasaṃyuktaṃ dvāravāme vinikṣipetekādaśyāmekāddiṣṭasthānamenaiva kārayetśūdrādinā darśayitvā tu savarṇa saṃskārameva caastreṇa gavā sarpādīn kriyāhīnā tathaiva capālāśapatraistriśikhai raṃgapratyaṃgakalpanamvāsasā upavātena karṇasūktaṃ japettataḥdaśarātraṃ baliṃ kṛtvā saptāhaṃ pūrvavatkṛtamekādaśāhe tatraiva ekoddiṣṭaṃ ca kārayetiti vīratantre tṛṇasaṃskāravidhiḥ saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥsnānaṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra aghoreṇa tu mantrataḥnikṣipecchavamevaṃ tu prokṣayetpuruṣeṇa tusajitapītātramamayānti maraṇe ghanaṃ bhavetmama putraṃ ca bālaṃ vai jīvitaṃ snāpayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcagavyena saṃprokṣya tatpuruṣeṇa tu mantrataḥprāṇāpānāya vyānāya udānāya samānāya svāhantetikāṣṭhe pretaṃ samāropya vidhinā ca dahettataḥsarvāsāṃ ca kriyāṇāṃ tu pūrvavatkārayettataḥiti vīratantre gabhiṇīsaṃskāra vidhiraṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥaṣṭamī cāpare pakṣe caturdarśyāmathāpi vāpūrvedyuścaiva śaivāśca kṣaṇaṃ kurvanti deśikāḥpitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ caiva pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuruagnimukhaṃ ca kṛtvā tu pitṝṃścaiva pitāmahaodanaṃ caivāpūpāṃśca pakvāhutimathācaretvastraiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca mālyaiḥ prapūjayetagnerdakṣiṇatobhāge darbhenaikena vinyasetodanaṃ jalasaṃyuktaṃ ūrjaṃ vahanti dāpayetprāyaścittāni hūyante hūyatāṃ kramaśodhunāiti vīratantre aṣṭakāvidhirekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥcaturthe dvādaśe māse sa piṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuruāyāntu pitara iti āvāhya pitṛpitāmahānpitṝṇāṃ rudradevānāṃ svāheti juhuyāttataḥśanno yavosīti ātma * * mahantureva cavāmasya tvitāvaśceti rasanamucettataḥgandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpaiścaiva samāyutamapahanteti mantreṇa vikirettatra deśikaḥye divyā āpa ityarghyaṃ * * * tatra vaiyanme māteti mantreṇa saptājyāhutimeva caodanaṃ tilasaṃyuktaṃ dadhi ca madhusaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pṛthivyādyena mantreṇa dadyātpitṛpitāmahānudakaṃ vinyasettatra madhumānī ca yantribhiḥpradakṣiṇa namaskāraṃ kṛtvā caiva tu deśikaḥādiśaivānuśaivāṃśca * * * * * sarvaśaḥdevoktena ca mantreṇa caivācāraṃ samācaretiti vīratantre sapiṇḍīkaraṇavidhiḥ triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥhṛdayena tu mantreṇaṃ mahecaivaktavantataḥśokācordhva * * * * dīpotsavaṃ prakalpayetdvinetraṃ caturbhujaṃ caiva upavītasamanvitamkuṇḍalaiḥ karṇikairhāraiḥ kaṭisūtrārabandhanaiḥ* * * * * * namaskāraśaivānprakāśayetśaivānsaṃbhojanaṃ yogyāndadyācchaktyā tu dakṣiṇāmiti vīratantre avāntaraśaivācāravidhiḥ ekatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥśucau deśe samaṃ kṛtvā gomayenopalepayetsa sūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca sa hiraṇyānsavastrakānādityaṃ madhyame sthāpya śukraṃ pūrve tu vinyasetmadhyādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāpayetkalaśānnavaketuṃ caiva tu vāyavyāṃ uttare ca bṛhaspatimsanasve ca svaināmena saṃyuktaṃ hṛdayena samanvitambilvapatraṃ śirīṣaṃ ca pūrvā caiva palāśakambakulākasya patraṃ ca aśvatthodumbaraṃ tathāgandhapuṣpādinā'bhyarcya pūrvedyuradhivāsayetāpohiṣṭhāmayo caiva tānsamandīya eva caevamabhyarcya vidhivad grahapīḍāṃ vyapohya casarve doṣā vinaśyanti evameva samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastradhānyādikāñcanaiḥiti vīratantre grahābhiṣekavidhiḥ dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasitatsarvamakhilaṃ (vipra pra) vakṣye caturānanaāvāhanī ca mudrā ca nirvīramudrā ca paṃcabrahmasya mudrikāmudrā ca śodhanī kalyāśaṃ tathādhanurbāṇaṃ ca paṇḍā ca vajramudrā tathaiva cakaniṣṭhikānāmikā tu madhyamāṃguli saṃsthitaḥvayetsadā | surabhimudrābhavedeṣā sarvāriṣṭavināśinīanāmikāsaśuddhi sarveṣya tarjanīnaṃ ca veṣṭayetliṃgamudrā bhavedeṣā sarvakāmārthasādhanīsurāje mukulākāramudreyaṃ mukulī bhavetubhau hastau kaniṣṭhau ca tayoraṃguṣṭha śirasi tarjanyaṃkuñcitau tathā | aṃguṣṭhamadhyamādīni śeṣā ṛjvā sthitānitiubhau hastau kaniṣṭhau ca aṃguṣṭhāṃgaṃ tu mūlakedvau hastau muṣṭisaṃbadhvā ekaikena tu tā yetprasārya dakṣiṇe haste aṃguṣṭhamūrdhvasaṃyutamprasāryadakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ aṃguṣṭhaṃ cordhvasaṃyutamdvau hastau tu prasāryātha aṃguṣṭhaṃ mūrdhni saṃsthitamuttānau tu karau kṛtvā anāmikādyau prasārayetdvau hastau maṇibandhaṃ tu madhyamau dvau prasārayetdvau hastau maṇibandhaṃ tu tarjanīṃ dvau prasārayetpūrvavaddhasta saṃyuktau prasāryātha kaniṣṭhikaudvau hastau ca prasāryātha protaṃ kṛtvā parasparamubhau hastau saṃprasārya nāmikā caiva madhyamaukaniṣṭhikāyā mūle tu aṃguṣṭhāgraṃ nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiro mudrā bhavedeṣā sarvakāmārthasādhinīśeṣātparasparau kṛtya śikhā mudrā iti smṛtāḥśeṣānparasparaṃ kṛtvā kavaceyaṃ prakīrtitamtarjanī madhyamā caiva adhomukhaṃ tu kārayetdvau hastau ca prasāryātha kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhatānvitehastau tu maṇibandhaṃ syāddhṛdaye saṃsthitāni tuuttānau tu karau kṛtvā maṇibandhaṃ tu kārayetvāmāṃguṣṭhasya madhyordhve dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhaṃ vinyasetkalaśamudrā bhavedeṣā snānakāle prayojayetmukulīkṛta hastau dvau padmamudrā iti smṛtāḥśūlamudrā bhavedeṣā sarvaśatruvimardinīkarapṛṣṭadvayaṃ bhūyātsamāśliṣṭhau parasparamuttānau ca karau kṛtvā tarjanī dvau ca tiṣṭhatiuttānau tu karau kṛtvā ūrdhvahastaṃ tu kārayetpāśamudrābhavedeṣā sarvaśatruvimardanāśeṣāṃ muṣṭiṃ ca saṃbadhvā mukulīyaṃ kṛśasya tudakṣiṇaṃ karṇamūle tu dhanurmudrā bhavanti vaiśeṣā muṣṭiṃ ca saṃbadhvā śaramudrā bhavanti vaicaṃcalaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā ghaṇṭamudrā tathaiva caubhau parasparaṃ hastau vajramudrā bhavanti vaimudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ naivedyaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre mudrālakṣaṇavidhistrayastriṃśatpaṭalaḥnaivedyasya vidhānaṃ kiṃ brūhi me parameśvara !tatsarvama * * * vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanatāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛsarānna sahasrebhyo gauḍa?nnaṃ ca viśiṣyateevameva krameṇaiva sahasra guṇitaṃ phalamkṛṣṇaśālī ca nīvāraṃ veṇugodhūmameva cataṇḍulārdhaṃ gṛhītavyaṃ uttamaṃ ca vinirdiśetadhamaṃ pakṣināmaṃ ca tasmāttānparivarjayethṛdaye prokṣayetsarvaśāliṃ netreṇa vinyasetuttamaṃ dvijanārībhiḥ kṣatraviṭkanyayā tataḥulūkhalvo'thamṛtkuṇḍe hṛdayenaiva nikṣipetśūrpaṃ vai viṣṇudaivatyaṃ ityete adhidevatāḥśatadvayaṃ paṃcaviṃśati vrīhibhiśśuktirucyateaṃjaliṃ caiva viprendra prasthaṃ caiva tathaiva caśivaṃ ca droṇakaṃ caiva khārī caiva tathaiva capātrasaṃkhyā bhavettatra āḍhakaṃ ca ekaikaṃ dviguṇaṃprasthaṃ kuḍavasaṃyuktaṃ piśācānāṃ baliṃ bhavetnaivedyaṃ navadhā caiva kalpayetkalpavittamaḥśivaṃ ceva tu vijñeyaṃ madhyamatrayamucyatemadhyamatrayamevoktaṃ uttamaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathabhāratrayaṃ ca viprendra uttamatrayamucyatena doṣāntaṇḍulāngrāhya nirvāpanaṃ tu kārayettribhirvākṣālayitvā tu jalamardhādhikaṃ bhavetagniṃ prajālayettatra agnibījena deśikaḥkṛmikoṭarasaṃyuktaṃ pipīlikādivarjitamatipakvamapakvaṃ ca dhūmragandhaṃ ca śītalambāhyaśuddhikramaṃ kuryāttripuṇṭraṃ kārayeddiśiupadaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bṛhatīdvayaṃ ca kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bṛhanmudgaṃ cālābunīśiśukaṃ bṛhatkandaṃ sāraṇasya tu kandakamrājamāṣāḍhakī caiva mudgaśimbaṃ kulasthakamete vakṣopadaṃśā sā kāravallī tathaiva caevameva kramaṃ kuryādyathā lābhe ca kārayettaṇḍulāścaiva dvitriṃśadupadaṃśamihocyatesūpaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa * * * piṣṭa saṃyutampanasena samāyuktaṃ sūpamājyaṃ nivedayetpūgīphaladvayaṃ caiva aṣṭapatrasamāyutammātuluṃga phalādyāsu pakvādīni nivedayetekasthāne tu viprendra nidhāya sakalaṃ tataḥgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva supūjayetsthalikā caiva sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ kāṃsyameva caathavā kadalīpatraṃ vastropari nyasettataḥvāmadevena mantreṇa pātre cānnaṃ kṣipettataḥcaruṇāṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ dvibhāgaṃ ca nivedayethṛdayena tu mantreṇa dadyātpānīyameva caprokṣayedambhasā caiva tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥagnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāpāyasānnakramaṃ vakṣye mudgaṃ vai taṇḍulārdhakamgulānnaṃ vakṣyate vipra kṣīraṃ vai taṇḍulārdhakamgulānnamiti vijñeyaṃ kṛsarānnaṃ tataḥ śṛṇutilārdhaṃ prakṣipedājyaṃ kṛsarānnamihocyatenālikeraphalairyuktaṃ mudgānnaṃ saṃprakīrtitamāloḍhya pācitaṃ hyetatkadalī bṛhatīdvayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tritripādaṃ ca ghaṭikāmudhamatra ya śeṣataḥkālaṃ yāmasamāyuktaṃ śrībalyaṃ tu ta kārayetvisarjayettu nirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya nivedayetnirmālya laṃghanāddānāttatkṣaṇānnarakaṃ vrajetbhūmau vā khānayettatra agninā dasameva casakalānāṃ nivedyaṃ tu śūdrādīnāṃ tu bhojanamumādevyāśca naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ caiva bhojanamabhojyaṃ sūryabhaktānāṃ jyeṣṭhā caiva sarasvatīitareṣāṃ tu naivedyaṃ na bhojyaṃ sarvadehināmpūrvadvāre'tha dakṣiṇye paścimadvārameva vādvārabhedeṣu bhedānāṃ pūjābhedaṃ na vidyateanyathā kārayedyastu abhicārāyamūca vahievaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyatekulaikaviṃśamuttārya śivalokamavāpnuyātiti vīratantre naivedyavidhiścatustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena bhagavanvaktumarhasitatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanagrāmātprācīmudīcīṃ vā gatvācāryo viśeṣataḥnavatābhimukhasthaṃ tu malaṃ caiva visarjayetūṣaraṃ caiva viprenda śivakṣetra samīpataḥśirovaguṇṭhanaṃ kṛtvā maunena tu visarjayetvāme śiśnaṃ gṛhītvā tu karṇayajñopavītakamśuddhasnānajalaṃ prāpya ācamettu yathāvidhipaṃcabhiḥ kṣālayedvāmaṃ karayoḥ saptamṛttikāāmalīphalamātreṇa pādau prakṣālayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca tridhā kṛtvā hṛdayena tu mantrataḥdakṣiṇe ghoramantreṇa uttare vāmamantrataḥdakṣiṇe ghoramantreṇa uttare vāmamantrataḥdakṣiṇena hṛdā caiva śivadīkṣāṃ tu kalpayettailaṃ cāmalakāyuktaṃ aṃgamālipya sarvaśaḥmārjayecchiramīśānaṃ puruṣeṇa mukhaṃ tataḥpādayossadyamantreṇa mārjayeddeśikottamaḥkālamudrāṃ tu badhvā tu prāsādenābhiṣiṃcayetnābhimātrodake sthitvā āca(myaca) vidhānataḥaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca cakṣuṣīsamupa spṛśetaṃguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu bāhuṃ caiva spṛśettataḥdakṣiṇena tu hastena udakaṃ grāhayettataḥīśānenāgniśceti sāyāhneti jalaṃ pibetsāvitrīṃ ca bhavettatra sūryodakaṃ dadetṛṣīṇāṃ dāpayettatra aghoreṇa tu mantrataḥprāsādena samāyuktaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca śatāṣṭakamjapedvai deśikastatra dhautavastraṃ ca veṣṭayettīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā hastamātreṇa lepayetpādyamācamanaṃ caiva arghyaṃ tasya nivedayetārṣeṇa tu tīthaina ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpayetvimānaṃ prāviśettatra puṣpahastau vicakṣaṇaḥpraṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau arcayettu kavāṭakampūjayedvidhinā vipra kavāṭasthāṃstu devatānevaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyatebhojane devakārye ca maunaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgneyaṃ divyamevaṃ tu vāyavyaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtamāgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ sā pathāvarjayettataḥmantrairmānasamityuktaṃ paṃcasnānaṃ vidhīyatesnānamevaṃ mayā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanamiti vīratantre śaucācamana snānavidhiḥ paṃcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvarabhāsatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhāsatvabhasya cianyaiduṣṭamṛgairduṣṭairbhasmasnānena naśyatitṛtīyaṃ śaivamityuktaṃ caturthaṃ bhogadaṃ bhavetnandā bhadrā ca surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanaṃ tathāuttamaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu madhyamaṃ raktameva cavikaṭāṃgaśca viprendra aṃgahīnaṃ ca varjayetkapilā gomayaṃ caiva uttamottamamucyateākāśo grāhayedaṃgairdarbhe tatpauṣṭikaṃ bhavetpaurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ (ca) śuklakṛṣṇayoḥpiṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tu hṛdayaṃ śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥsadyo jātena mantreṇa grāhayet (ca) viśeṣataḥadhamaṃ tāmrapātraṃ syādalābhe mṛṇmayaṃ bhavetetadāgneyamityuktaṃ mārutaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathamārutākhyamiti proktaṃ śaivalakṣaṇamucyatebhogadaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi kulālānāṃ dahepyataḥcatvāri bheda saṃyuktaṃ bhasmanā ca viśeṣataḥvyoma vyāpi samāyuktaṃ brahmamaṃgena saṃyutammukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇaiva svītau caiva kaṭī tathāsadyo jātena mantreṇa uddhūlayedviśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tripuṇṭraṃ kārayettatra nṛpāṇāṃ vaiśyameva camadhyahātprakṛjalairyuktaṃ toyaṃ tamana varjayetkarṇau ca cakṣuṣī caiva nāsikau cāsya eva cahṛdi nābhau ca meḍhre ca puyūruku ca jānunīdvātriṃśatsthānamevoktaṃ bhasmanā lepayettataḥhṛdaye jaṭhare caiva nābhau pārśve tu pṛṣṭhakemūrdhni caiva lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhe bāhu tathaiva caaṣṭasthāneṣu viprendra vinyasedbhasmameva cavasundharā ca pitarau adhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥbrāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ vistārasi vivistaraṃ bhavetjñānāsūcandanaṃ lipya vaiśyārthaṃ pūrṇameva cadeśikānāṃ tu sarveṣāmanāmikā madhyamatarjanīdusvapne durjanasparśe āturāṇāṃ tu sarvataḥbhojane tuṣakeśaṃ ca citāri nakhānyapidadhikṣīra ghṛtetaila miśrite tu viśeṣataḥpūrvāhne bhojanekāle gamane'pi tathaiva caevameva krameṇaiva bhasma dadhyāttu bhaktitaḥbhasmasnānaṃ mayā proktaṃ mantranyāsaṃ śṛṇuṣvathaiti vīratantre bhasmasnānavidhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥmantranyāsaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhotavasnehādahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsanamaṇḍapaṃ caiva viprendra gomayenānulepayetkūrcaṃ caiva tu nikṣipya pūrvanā(tha) vidhipūrvakamsadyena prokṣayettatra kuśakūrcena vāmataḥghṛtāśikhāgre dvādaśāṃgulye śivatatvaṃ vicintayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trikoṇamaṇḍale vidyādadvitīyaṃ vicintayetbhasmabhūtaḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā amṛtaṃ plāvanaṃ kuruśvetapadmo pariṣṭāttu candrabimbamadhomukhamcintayedamṛtaṃ toyaṃ suṣumnābhinnamastakammṛtyunāśanamevaṃ tu iti śāstrasya niścayaḥrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ trividhaṃ matamāpūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhedacalasya tu kumbhakamhastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśetpūrvaṃ kādipādāntameva cadivi dikṣu ca dātavyaṃ ūrdhvādhaścaiva vinyasetgalāddve tejasaṃśuddhi lalāṭādvāyu śudhyatiprathamaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsaṃ tu sthitinyāsaṃ dvitīyakamgṛhasthaḥ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa brahmacārī sthitirbhavetaṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtamīśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyasetsadyojāte nyasetpādau punaraṃgāni vinyasetbrahmāṇaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya lalāṭe viṣṇurucyatesarasvatīṃ tu vaśvāre hṛdaye īśvaraṃ tathāsubrahmaṇyasya liṃge ca pārśvayorambikā tathāakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ tu lalāṭakeukāraṃ dakṣiṇe nāse ūkāraṃ vāmanāsikeḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍakedantapaṃktidvaye nyasya aṃaḥ parikīrtitauṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādakemakāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ tvaci vinyasetvakāraṃ medodeśe tu śakāraṃ cāsthideśake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hakāraṃ prāṇa ityāhuḥ kṣakāraṃ meḍhrameva casṛṣṭinyāsamiti proktaṃ nyāsaṃ sthitimataḥ śṛṇuīśānaṃ madhyame caiva anāmikena puruṣaṃ nyasetsadyojātaṃ tu tarjanyāṃ vinyasetpṛṣṭhameva caśikhāṃ kaniṣṭhike nyasya kavacāṃguṣṭhake nyasetevaṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasya vidyeśānvinyasettataḥśivottamaṃ mukhe nyasya ekanetraṃ tu karṇayoḥliṃge śrīkaṇṭhamevoktaṃ śikhaṇḍiṃ pādayornyasetśikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥhastau tu maṇibandhaṃ tu īśabrahmāṇimeva casadyojātaṃ kaniṣṭhe tu vāmadevena nāmikāīśamaṃguṣṭhake nyasya ṣaḍaṃgānvinyasettataḥśikhāmantraṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt kavacaṃpādayoḥ sadyamantreṇa kukṣau vāmaṃ nyasettataḥīśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya pādayorhṛdayaṃ nyasetkavacaṃ hṛdaye nyasya netraṃ bāhudvayornyasetindraṃ tu pādayornyasya meḍhre tu pāvake nyasetbāhvau varuṇadaivatyaṃ kaṇṭhe vāyuriti smṛtaḥevameva krame jñātvā vinyaseddeśikastathāsṛṣṭau sthitiṃ ca saṃhāra nyāsaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca pādyaiśca svadehaṃ pūjayeddhṛdāpūrve tu dvārapālaṃ tu nandikālau tathaiva capaścimadvārapālau tu bhṛṃgiṭirvijayastathānandinaṃ dakṣiṇe sthāpya śyāmavarṇasamanvitamkālaṃ kuṃkumavarṇāmaṃ uttare tu pratiṣṭhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṇḍiṃ pūrve tu vinyasya indragopasya saṃnibhammuṇḍī tu paścime nyasya śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhambhṛṃgiṭiṃ dakṣiṇe sthāpya mayūragrīvasaṃnibhamvijayaṃ cottare sthāpya raktavarṇa samāyutamanantaṃ paścime sthāpya kanakābhaṃ tathaiva capaśupatiṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya nīlarūpasamanvitamevameva kramaiḥ sthāpya etairmantraiśca pūjayetsarve ṛjvāgatāḥ sthityā krūradṛṣṭibhayāvahāḥnānābharaṇasaṃyuktā ghorabhayāvahāḥevameva krameṇaiva pūjayeddeśikassadāiti vīratantre mantranyāsaḥ saptatriṃśatpaṭalaḥśivārcanaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhonārudraḥ saṃsmaredrudraṃ nārudro rudramarcayetsarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavetdīkṣitaścāpi yo vipro bhṛtyarthaṃ na prapūjayetsandhisvadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ na doṣāya prakalpayettatkāle vāpyakāle vā evameva krameṇa tutṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhistu caturthaṃ liṃgaśodhanampūrvoktena vidhānena ātmaśuddhiṃ ca kārayethuṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ phaṭkāreṇa samāyutamgomayenopa lipyātha prokṣayed hṛdayena tuarghyapātraṃ puṣpapātraṃ dhūpadīpasya pātrakamhṛdena kṣālayitvā tu astreṇa śodhayettataḥpaṃcabrahmeṇa mantreṇa udakaṃ secayettataḥdravyāṇi prokṣayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayenaiva mantreṇa ghaṇṭāṃ caiva tu tāḍayetpūjāparyaṣitānāṃ tu hṛdayena visarjayetapanīya ca nirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya pradāpayetliṃgaṃ prakṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥevamevakrameṇaiva liṃgaśuddhimathācaretpaṃcabrahmaśivāṃgaiśca prāsādena samanvitamgaṇeśānlokapālāṃśca lokapālāstrameva camantraśuddhirbhavedevaṃ kārayeddeśikottamaḥāsanaṃ kalpayedvidvān anantāntānyathākramamsiṃhāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syād yogāsanaṃ caturthakamśaktyakṣarasamāyuktaṃ navamāṃkurasaṃyutammadhye nālasamāyuktaṃ paṃcāśatkarṇikāyutamanantaṃ pūrvato bhāge vāsukiṃ cāgnigocareśaṃkhapālaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ gulike vāyugocareanantāsanaṃ tu pradadyāt kūrmasyopari saṃśritāḥādhāraṃ cāpyate vipra devānāṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathaekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍikaḥśeṣaścaiva tu nāgendrā gulikāśca caturdiśicaturaśraṃ tu yogaṃ syāt śeṣasyopari vinyasetdevadattadhanaṃjayau madhyame ca vikīryatepraṇavaṃ madhyadeśe tu ākāraṃ pūrvadeśakeadhaścāthordhvacchadanaṃ yogāsanamiti smṛtamāgneyyāṃ dharma vinyasya nair-ṛtyāṃ jñānameva cacatuṣkoṇe mahāsiṃhaṃ āsanaṃ pādanirmitamadharmaṃ pūrvato bhāge ajñānaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇavarṇa samāyuktaṃ ilikāṃ tatra vinyasetmahādikṣu nyasedenaṃ madhyapādastu keśavaḥevaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ proktaṃ padmāsanamathocyatetejorūpaṃ tu dakṣiṇyāṃ vāyurūpaṃ tu nair-ṛtesatvaṃ vāyavyake nyasya rajovinyasya somaketatvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ ādhāraṃ cocyate mayāaghoraṃ dalamevāhu statpuruṣaṃ guhyadeśakedevatāḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kālīṃ pūrve tu vinyasetbalavikaraṇīṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ vāmāṃ paścimato nyasetsarvabhūtadamanīmīśānye manonmanīṃ tu madhyamecaturvedasvarūpaṃ tu vinyased vyāghracarmavatambikāṃ pūrvataḥ sthāpya gaṇāmbikāṃ ca dakṣiṇevimalāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ idamanyacchṛṇuṣvathavimalamarcaneṣūktaṃ bhojyāsanaṃ tu yogataḥgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva tu pūjayetsatvaṃ rajastamaścaiva uparyupari vinyasetcandrabimbaṃ nyasetpaścā ātmānaṃ cāntarātmakamdakṣiṇe hyātmatatvaṃ tu vidyātatvaṃ tu cottareevaṃ nyastvā tu vidhivacchivaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥtryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ caiva candrārdhakṛtaśekharampaṃcavaktraṃ ca deveśaṃ paṃcamūrdhasamanvitammakuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva keyūrakaṭakaṃ tataḥdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ divyagandhānulepitamvāmāṃkuśaṃ caivāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ nāgaṃ ca vahni caevaṃ sadāśivaṃ dhyātvā sarvalokasukhāvaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāpayedvāmadevena aghoreṇa nirodhayetpūrve dvāragehe tu dakṣiṇe vā viśeṣataḥniṣkale sakalaṃ dhyātvā āsanaṃ caiva kalpayetdvārabhedeṣubhedānāṃ pūjābhedaṃ na vidyateaghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayethṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyasetastraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyasetpādyaṃ pādau pradātavyamarghyaṃ śirasi vinyasetuśīraṃ candanopetaṃ pādyadravyamudāhṛtamācamanīyamiti proktaṃ mukhe dadyādviśeṣataḥtilaissiddhārthakaiścaiva arghyamaṣṭāṃgamucyatekṣurikāṃ kalpayettatra dakṣiṇekadireva caśivasya dakṣiṇe pārśve nyasetpāśupatāstrakamevaṃ nyasya vidhānena paścādarcanamārabhetādityodayapūrve tu paṃcasnānaṃ tu kārayetpaṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgaiśca vyomavyāpi japettataḥjalabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetdvātriṃśadvā catustriṃśatpaṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥāḍhakena tu saṃpūrṇaṃ kumbhalakṣaṇamucyatetāmraṃ vā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi abhiṣekaṃ tu kalpayetnālikerasya salilaṃ ikṣukāṇḍasamanvitamnṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ stotraśabdasamāyutamtasyānte pūjako vipra ācamanīyaṃ tu kārayetniryāsaṃ triphalaṃ caiva uśīraṃ ca viśeṣataḥhṛdayena tu gandhaṃ syād vastraṃ vāmena dāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānāvidhaiśca puṣpaiśca pūjayetparameśvarampīṭhapūjā prakartavyā lakṣaṇena samanvitāvistāraṃ tāvadevasyānmṛdenaiva tu lepayetpuṣpairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ nālikerasya pātrakamsarvadvayaṃ ca pīṭhaṃ ca gopuraṃ maṇḍapaṃ tathādarpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaramvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃpāśaṃ tathāṃkuśamdinaṃ prati nyasedekaṃ triṃśaddināntameva capīṭhapūjāṃ ca viprenda hṛdayena tu mantrataḥmāse māse prakartavyaṃ evameva punaḥ punaḥdhūpaṃ caiva tu viprendra dhūpapātraṃ viśeṣataḥekabhāgaṃ tu karpūraṃ lohaṃ caiva catuṣṭayammadhunā secayeddhūpaṃ pātre tu pari nikṣipetśrīphalaṃ cājyasaṃmiśraṃ dhūpaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥdakṣiṇe dhūpapātraṃ tu hṛdayena tu dāpayetprokṣayedambhasā caiva dīpaṃ dadyāttu sadyataḥrakṣādīpaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tatkāle tu viśeṣataḥtaddīpaṃ balipīṭhe tu strībhiścaiva tu dhārayetāḍhakaṃ vā śivaṃ vāpi droṇaṃ vā taṇḍulaṃ pacetājyena dadhisaṃyuktaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥpātraśeṣaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ deśikāya pradāpayetnirmālyaṃ caiva viprendra caṇḍeśāya pradāpayetpadmaṃ śūlaṃ ca paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśamsurabhimudrāṃ liṃgamudrāṃ darśayettu vidhānataḥpuruṣaṃ pūrvataḥ pūjya aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe yajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu pūjayeddeśikassadānair-ṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ pūjya vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ yajetmadhyame śivatatvaṃ tu ātmatatvaṃ tu dakṣiṇemadhyame tu yajeddevaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇammaheśvaraṃ yajenmadhye kiṃcidāgneyamācaretparaṃ śivamayaṃ jñeyaṃ śivātparataraṃ na caanantaṃ pūrvataḥ pūjya sūkṣmaṃ vai dakṣiṇena tuekarudraṃ tu īśānyāṃ trimūrtistvagnigocarevidyeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetad gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇucaṇḍeśamīśadigbhāge nandīśaṃ pūrvato yajetvighneśaṃ nir-ṛte caiva bhṛṃgīśaṃ vāruṇe yajetgaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetat lokapālānśṛṇuṣvathayāmyāyāṃ tu yamaṃ pūjya nair-ṛtyāṃ nir-ṛtiṃ yajetsaumyāyāṃ somaṃ saṃpūjya aiśānyāmīśameva calokeśāvaraṇaṃ hyetat lokapālāstramucyateyāmye daṇḍaṃ yajettatra khaḍgaṃ nir-ṛtigocaregadāyudhaṃ cottare pūjya śūlaṃ cīśānagocaregandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva tu pūjayetāsanasthāṃśca devāṃśca śivasyābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥvidyeśānāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ liṃgamudrāṃ ca darśayettatkāle tāḍayed ghaṇṭāṃ paṭaṃ caiva visarjayetprokṣayedambhasā caiva dīpaṃ dadyācchikhāsahapaṃcavarṇahavirdadyāt paṃcavaktreṣu deśikaḥuśīraṃ caiva kuṣṭhaṃ ca elaṃ candana saṃyutammukhavāsaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūraṃ triphalairyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apūpaṃ pṛthukaṃ caiva phaṭkulī ca samanvitamnivedayettu śarvāya kṣetrapālāṃśca pūjayetsamudraghoṣo vāyughoṣo analākṣaḥ pramardanaḥnīlajīmūta saṃkāśa ūrdhvakeśasamanvitamevameva krameṇaiva pūjayeddeśikottamaḥśiro hastau dvijānvośca cibukaṃ bāhuyuk tathāśiro hastau dvijānū ca paṃcāṃgamihocyatepaṃcāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ ekāvaraṇamucyatevimalāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syād āsanaṃ trīṇi kalpayetekāvaraṇamevoktaṃ pūjayeddeśikassadāagnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryāllakṣaṇena samanvitamgandhapuṣpādinā caiva agnidevaṃ samarcayetprāsādena tu mantreṇa śive daśāhutiṃ hunetpaṃcabrahmaśivāṃgānāṃ ekaikaṃ homayettadāekāhutiṃ ca hotavyaṃ tattatsvanāmamantrataḥpustakārādhanaṃ tatra gandhapuṣpādinā sahauktānuktaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hṛdayena tu dāpayetpraviśya vigṛhaṃ paścād gṛhadevānsamarcayettasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayecchivamādarātātmārthaṃ pūjayed nityaṃ calaliṃgaṃ viśeṣataḥābhicāraṃ kariṣyāmi ekadhā daśadhā tataḥevameva krameṇaiva arcayeddeśikassadāarcanāyā vidhiḥ proktaḥ agnikāryaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre arcanāvidhiḥ aṣṭatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥkīdṛśaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samāsena pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !pratiṣṭhā cotsave caiva śatrūṇāṃ ca pradarśanedīkṣākāle tu vā kuryācchāntike pauṣṭike'pi vācauke vā copanayane samāvartanake'pi vāsīmantopariniṣkrāme agniṣṭomādiyāgakekuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ vāpi kārayeddeśikastathāvṛttaṃ * * * * kuryān nityakarma ihocyatetrimekhalā samāyuktaṃ nābhiyonisamanvitamkhananaṃ hastamātraṃ tu darpaṇodaravattataḥśoṣitaṃ pācitaṃ caiva śoṣaṇaṃ pācanaṃ tathāpraṇītā spṛśyapātraṃ tu sudhāparidhayaḥ sruvāḥvastraṃ coṣṇīṣamevaṃ tu arghyaṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpakamājyaṃ caiva caruṃ caiva homadravyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥsādhayeddhṛdayenaiva prokṣayedambhasā tataḥtisṝḥ pūrvamukhā rekhā udagrekhāstathaiva caarcayedgandhapuṣpāṃśca hṛdayena tu mantrataḥśrotriyasyāgnihotrācca janayejjātavetasamvistāraṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ viṣkambhaṃ tu triyaṃgulammathitvā paṃcabrahmeṇa pātre vinyasya deśikaḥhṛdā cāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya agnyādhānaṃ tu kārayetpātrāṇāṃ sādanaṃ caiva prokṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇī tathāūrdhva praveśanaṃ cāpi tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥagnau kāṣṭhaṃ vinikṣipya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥkuśenaiva paristīryaḥ pūrve tu cottarāgrajātuttare pūrvamūrdhvaṃ tu vinyaseddeśikastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvaṃ saṃsthādvayaṃ caiva āgneyyāmīśadeśataḥṛtusnānaṃ ca saṃkalpya yonimārgeṇa jāyatetatpuruṣeṇa mantreṇa puṃsavanaṃ bhavanti vaivāmadevena mantreṇa jātakarma ca hūyatecatuḥśṛṃgasamāyuktaṃ ṣaṇṇetreṇa samanvitamjaṭāmauṃji samāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājinasamāyutamatiraktā bahurūpā saptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥuttarā raktamākhyātaṃ yāmye kṛṣṇā iti smṛtābahurūpā caiva jihvā syāt saptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥjātakarma mayā proktaṃ nāmaṃ tu hṛdayena tucaulamantreṇa kartavyaṃ upanayanaṃ hṛdayena tuhṛdayena tu mantreṇa samāvartanavivāhakamdakṣiṇe brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ darbhāsanopari nyasetviṣṇustatrādhidaivatyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayetkuśenaiva tu viprendra udakopavanaṃ kuruutplāvanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt praṇave naiva nikṣipetagneruttarabhāge tu aṃgārakopari nyasetājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kāryaṃ darbhānande vinikṣipetsruvaṃ caiva tu viprendra kṣālayeddhṛdayena tumadhyaṃ madhyena saṃspṛśya mūlaṃ mūlena saṃspṛśetatīte tu mavasveti dakṣiṇe pariṣiñcatisarasvate'numanyasveti uttare pariṣiñcatipalāśasamidhaścaiva idhmaṃ ṣoḍaśameva caprajāpataye svāheti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvādhakesomāya svāheti mantreṇa dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evameva krameṇaiva hotavyaṃ dīrghajīvināagnimarcayate caiva ājye vāmena saṃyutamgaurībījena tadvacca paṃcabrahmaśivāṃgakaiḥvarṇāgnigandhaśabdāni lakṣayeccaiva deśikaḥraktapaṃkajasaṃkāśaṃ kiṃśukasya samaprabhamuśīraṃ kuṣṭhagandhaṃ ca karpūrāgarumeva capadmaṃ kusumagandhaṃ ca śubhānyetāni nikṣipetvāruṇe śāntikaṃ proktaṃ saumyāyāṃ mṛtyunāśanamāgneyyāmagnidagdhaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ caiva tu yāmyakeīśānyāṃ jñānalābhaṃ ca śikhāniṣkrāntalakṣaṇamulūkadhvanite vahnau kārāgṛhamavāpnuyātvṛṣabhadhvanite vahnau agamyāgamanaṃ bhavetkharavad dhvanite vahnau apamṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥgokharavadbhavecchabdaṃ svadravyaṃ taskarāvahamgovacca dhvanite vahnau sarpeṇa maraṇaṃ bhavetbhāṇḍavad dhvanite vahnau rogo bhavati niścayamkapiladhvanite vahnau surāpānamavāpnuyātlaśunagandhaṃ bhavedagnau kṣayarogamavāpnuyātatigandhaṃ bhavedagnau mahājvaramavāpnuyātmūtragandhaṃ bhavedagnau pāṇḍurogamavāpnuyātromagandhaṃ bhavedvipra kukṣirogamavāpnuyātśubhāśubhaṃ mayā proktaṃ agnidevasya padmajapariṣecanaṃ tu kuryāttu taddoṣaśamanāya casamidājyacaruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānhṛdayenājyahomaṃ tu caruṃ ca śikhayā hunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aghoreṇa yavaṃ hutvā kavacena tilānapisarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccarankṛtvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛt caiva hūyateīśānyāṃ caiva hotavyaṃ kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vāindradhanuśca dṛṣṭvā ca taddoṣaśamanāya caācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā vastrāṃgulīyakādibhiḥagnikāryaṃ mayā proktaṃ nityotsava mataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre agnikāryavidhiḥ ekonacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥnityotsavaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhosarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokasukhāvahamnityaṃ nityārcanānte tu nityotsavamathācaretucchiṣṭāścaiva vetālā kūṣmāṇḍārhatathāgatamnityotsavasya śabdāṃśca śrutvāgarjanti tatra vaidvitīyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ caiva viṣṇuprītikarāya capūrvāhne ca tava prīti puṣpaliṃgasamanvitamsāye taṇḍulaliṃgaṃ syād nārāyaṇapriyaṃ tathācalaliṃgeṣu sarveṣu śrībaliṃ ca na kārayetevameva krameṇaiva nityotsavaṃ tu kārayetbalipākaṃ tu kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitamekatālena hīnaṃ tu madhyamaṃ pātramucyatetripātraṃ ca tridhāharmyaṃ madhye padmaṃ tu kārayetpadmasyotsedhamānaṃ tu ekāṃgulamihocyateevameva krameṇaiva balipātraṃ tu kārayetdviprasthamadhamaṃ proktaṃ āḍhakaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetatyuṣṇamatiśītaṃ ca āmlaṃ lavaṇavarjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇakambusamāyuktaṃ māraṇaṃ tu vinirdiśetśivāgre maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasyottare diśiprokṣayedastramantreṇa kuśenaiva tu vāriṇākṣīraṃ vā dadhisaṃyuktamājyenaiva samāyutamaṣṭāṃgulaṃ tu cotsedhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya mūlakamadhamaṃ liṃgamityuktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ śṛṇuagramaṣṭāṃgulaṃnāhaṃ uttamaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥagraṃ daśāṃgulaṃ nāhaṃ annaliṃgamihocyatedakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ * * * vāmahastaṃ kaṭispṛśamevaṃ svarūpakaṃ dhyātvā baliliṃge tu vinyasetgandhaṃ hṛdayamantreṇa śikhayā puṣpamucyatehastamātraṃ bhaveddaṇḍaṃ agre cakradvayaṃ bhavetprokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥaghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayethṛdayaṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyasetastraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netre tu vinyasetsthalikāṃ caiva coddhṛtya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥjapetpāśupatāstraṃ ca śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇampurastātpratimaṃ gacchelliṃgaṃ tu tadanu vrajetśivasyābhimukhaṃ caiva gomayenānulepayetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vādyakaṃ pūjayettataḥsuṣiraṃ gānavaṃ caiva śabdabhedaṃ tathaiva caevaṃ vidhisamāyuktaṃ vādyakānvādayettataḥdvitīyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kuryād aṣṭatāla samanvitamdakṣiṇe kaduvādyaṃ syān nair-ṛtyāṃ saṃkarī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naṭaprahāraṃ saumyāyāṃ aiśānyāṃ mallatālakambāhyapīṭhe kramāvṛtya prāsādaṃ tripradakṣiṇampaścime vā trisaṃdhyāyāṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaretsāyāhne paścime caiva balimevaṃ visarjayetsarvadvāre tu kartavyaṃ pūrve tu balipīṭhakamyamasya bhṛṃgiṇī tālaṃ nair-ṛtyāṃ mallatālakamsaumye ca koṭikāḥ proktā īśānyaṇḍaṃkarī tathāgāyaṃ gāndhārapūrvaṃ syād dakṣiṇe kauśikaṃ tathāāgneyyāṃ caiva kollī ca nair-ṛtyāṃ nāṭṭabhāṣayādvāradeśamanuprāpya vṛṣabhasyādhidaivatamnirmālyaṃ ca visṛjyātha jale caivābhiṣecayetarcayetpādukau vidvān * * * * * * dvayoḥpṛthivīṃ paścime nyasya medinīṃ cottare nyasetbalavikariṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūtamanonmanīmanonmanī nyasenmadhye arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥvisarjayettu cāstreṇa namaskāraṃ tu kārayetgaṇikāṃ snāpayettatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayettasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu brahmāṇaṃ pūjayettataḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ nṛttaṃ bhāvayedgaṇikā tataḥagnimukhīkaraṇaṃ yattu tadā vāhanamucyatepradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ tathaiva caevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātśivalokamavāpnoti śivavanmodate sadānityotsavamidaṃ proktaṃ parivārāṃcchṛṇuṣvathaiti vīratantre nityotsava vidhiścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parivāraṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhoparivāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhi purassarampurato vṛṣabhasthānaṃ sthāpayedvṛṣabhaṃ tataḥīśānyāṃ śaiva viprendra bhāskaraṃ vinyasettataḥidamanyaprakāreṇa vakṣyehaṃ caturānana !dakṣiṇe mātṛdevāṃśca vighneśaṃ nair-ṛte tathājyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyadeśe tu viṣṇuṃ cottaradeśakeuttarāyāṃ diśi caiva durgāṃ devīṃ ca vinyasetpūrve tu bhārgavasthānaṃ kumāraṃ * * * * *āgneyyāṃ gaṇapatiṃsthāpya vinyasettu daivatāndakṣiṇadvāragehasya dakṣiṇe vṛṣabhālayamjyeṣṭhāṃ ca vāyudeśe tu (uttare) viṣṇurucyatedurgāmāgneyadigbhāge kṣetrapālaṃ tu vinyasetmaryādā vīradigbhāge yāmye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāvāyavyāṃ vinyasejjyeṣṭhāṃ viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥṣoḍaśadvāradevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munisattamayamanair-ṛtayormadhye vasavo'ṣṭau ca vinyasetvaruṇa vāyavyayormadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ sthānamucyatesoma īśānayormadhye aṣṭanāgaṃ prakalpayetevameva prakāreṇa maryādau ca vinyasetrakṣādīpaṃ kathametat tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !rakṣādīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ cocyate mayāsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vāpūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathāaṣṭāṃgulasamutsedhaṃ * * * * * * bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādaṃ caiva daśāṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ tu vidhīyate* * * * * saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayetvistāraṃ tu caturviṃśad aṃgulyā sthalitā bhavetetatpauṣṭikamityuktaṃ kāmadaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇusaptapātrā * * * * ke teṣāmūrdhve tantathāninnityāne kuryāt tasyānnaṃdīpamucyatenityāgni kuṇḍe viprendra ! * * * * * dīpayetsthalikāṃ vinyasettatra śikhāmantreṇa saṃyutamvartiṃ tatraiva * * * * * * dīpayettataḥpūrve tu puruṣaṃ caiva aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tuīśānena tu mantreṇa vyomavyāpi samanvitamgaṇikā (vātha) dāsī vā dhārayeddīpamuttamam* * * * samāyuktaṃ śaṃkhadhvani samāyutamgaccha pradakṣiṇaṃ tatra ninayecchivasaṃnidhauīśānena tu mantreṇa arcayeddīpameva caekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācaretetacchāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuvinyasetsthalikāṃ tatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥhṛdayena tu mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyācchivasya tu* * japettato mantrī bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipetevaṃ pauṣṭikamevā tu kāmadaṃ śṛṇu tatvataḥsaptapātre tu viprendra dīpaṃ saṃyojayettataḥśive dīpaṃ susaṃyojya visarjayettu vā mataḥuttamaṃ dīpamākhyātaṃ saptāṃgulasamucchrayamuttamaṃ goghṛtaṃ caiva madhyamaṃ ja saṃbhavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dūrvākṣataiśca saṃyuktaṃ darpaṇaṃ bhasmameva cadīpasya darśanādūrdhvaṃ śive dadyādviśeṣataḥyāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ īkārasvarasaṃyutametanmantraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ tava snehātprakāśitamkaraṇḍamakuṭopetaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanamevaṃ vidhasvarūpaṃ tu dhyātvā vai pūjayettataḥbalavikaraṇī balapramathinī sarvabhūtadamanyathamadhye manonmanīṃ nyasya pūjayeddevi bāhyataḥrāhuketuṃ ca viprendra tadbāhye pūjayettataḥsomeśānasamāyuktaṃ tādbāhye pūjayettataḥbhasma dadyācchive tatra dadyāccheṣaṃ janāya capariṣecanakāle tu rakṣādīpaṃ karoti yaḥrakṣādīpaṃ mayā proktamaṃkurārpaṇakaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre rakṣādīpavidhidvicatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥaṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !utsavāṃkuramevoktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥathavātryaṃkuraṃ vidyād dhvajāṃkuraṃ tu cocyatesthāpane prokṣaṇe yāge utsave snapane'pi caśrīkaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ca śrīpradaṃ ca tridhā bhavetkṛtvā navapadaṃ tatra daivatāṃśca śṛṇuṣvathadakṣiṇe tu yajurvedaṃ ekāraṃ caiva nir-ṛtevāyavye pavanaścaiva atharvaṃ somake pademadhyame tu pade caiva somakumbhaṃ pratiṣṭhitametacchrīkaramityuktaṃ śrīnivāsamataḥ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣoḍaśānpadamevāhuḥ devapādāṃ śṛṇuṣvathasugrīvo varuṇaḥ śoṣa mukhya somāditistathāīśānogniśca sugrīvo mukhyasya tu padāni cajayanto vitathaścaiva varuṇassoma eva caādityaśca yamaścaiva śoṣaścaiva diti sthitaḥetadvai śrīnivāsaṃ tu śrīpradaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathapaṃcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetkramaśastathāsvabhṛṃgaśca sugrīva varuṇāḥ śoṣamārutauāpavatsārya sāvitrī vivasvānindramitrakābrahmaṇaśca pade caiva sthāpayetsomakumbhakampitṛdauvārikau caivaṃ marutaścaiva mukhyakaḥādityaśca prathaścaiva yamaścaiva tu bhṛṃgarāṭśarāvānvinyasettatra ghaṭikāṃśca śṛṇuṣvathalakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana !tatrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ pālikādīni caiva hiṣoḍaśāṃgulaṃ madhyaṃ syād adhamaṃ ca daśāṃgulamparitoṣṭau ca viprendra ṣaḍbhāgaikamiti smṛtamghaṭasyotsedhamānaṃ tu pālikāsamameva cavaktraṃ caiva ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ paṃcavaktra samanvitamvaktraṃ caiva ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ paṃcavaktra samanvitamtadardhaṃ pāda vistāraṃ tripādaṃ vā samucyateghaṭikā brahmadaivatyaṃ pālikā viṣṇurucyatecaturviṃśati saṃkhyā tu uttamaṃ tu vinirdiśetpālikāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ adhamaṃ tadihocyatenavame saptame vāpi triśūlena samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadante pālikādīni dhārayecchivabhaktakānsuśuddhabhūtalaṃ prāpya prokṣayecchuddhavāriṇākundālīṃ caiva saṃpūjya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥmṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya vāmena vāmena mṛdamarcayetprāsādasyāgrato vāpi īśāne dakṣiṇe'tha vāaṣṭadroṇena śālisyātsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥmadhyame somakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetsomabījakaiḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥdarbheṇa suṣiraṃ nyasya mṛdaṃ tatraiva pūrayetpuṇyāhaṃ tatra kurvīta tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥniṣpāvaṃ śimbasaṃyuktaṃ apāmārgaṃ ca sarṣapampayasā kṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥvāpayecchivamantreṇa śivabhaktāśca vāpayetsomādhidevatānkumbhātpariṣicya tato jalamsuguptadeśe saṃsthāpya somakuṃbhena saṃyutamhavirnivedayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥhomayeccaiva viprendra apūpāni tathaiva caaṃkurārpaṇahīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛtevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyātaṃkurārpaṇamevoktaṃ utsavasya vidhiṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre aṃkurārpaṇavidhistrayaścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥutsavasya vidhiḥ ko vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !udgataṃ tu savoṃ yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyatejvaramāryā prakartantu śūtrūṇāṃ pīḍane'pi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarveṣāmiṣṭakāmyārthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanamdvividhamutsavaṃ caiva tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathapuṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakamvaiśākhe tu viśākhāntaṃ jyeṣṭhāntaṃ jyeṣṭhamāsakepūrvāṣāḍhe tu mevoktaṃ pūrvabhadreti māsakamkārtike kṛttikāntā tu kārayettu śivotsavamrājñāṃ janmadinānte vā grāmanakṣatrameva vāśaivaṃ gauṇaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca bhauvanaṃ daivikaṃ tathāeteṣāṃ bhedakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !triyahena samāyuktaṃ gauṇamityabhidhīyateeteṣāṃ tu kramāṇāṃ tu vakṣyate vidhinā'dhunāprātaḥkāle tu tīrthaṃ syādekāhe tu balidvayamsāyaṃkāle samārabhya tadrātrau cādhivāsayetbalimekaṃ mayā proktaṃ ekāhe cotsave tathāevameva krameṇaiva vividhaṃ cocyate mayāprātaḥkāle tṛtīye syādbalirvipra ṣaḍeva tutṛtīye tu dine caiva balireko vidhīyatecūrṇotsavānte tīrthaṃ syāddvividhaṃ cocyate mayāsāyaṃkāle samārabhya tatpūrvaṃ homamācaretṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhne cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayetsāyaṃkāle samārabhya tadrātrau cādhivāsayetdvitīye tu dine caiva balireko vidhīyatecūrṇātsavānte tīrthaṃ syād dvividhaṃ cocyate mayāsāyaṃkāle samārabhya tatpūrvaṃ dinamārabhetṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhne cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāyaṃkāle samārabhya paṃcāhaṃ syāddine tathādvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturthe ca balidvayamkuryādvai tīrthakarmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ cocyate mayāaṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhetcaturdaśabaliṃ dadyāccūrṇotsavaṃ ca kārayetsaptāhe sāyaṃmārabhya adhivāsya tato budhaḥdvitīye divase caiva (tṛtīye ca caturthake)saptāhe balirevaṃ syād balyante cūrṇamucyatesaptāhe dvividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvathahomaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayetcūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthaṃ kuryāttato budhaḥnavāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhetdvitīye divase caiva tṛtīye tu caturthakenavāhe'pi ca viprendra balinā dvitayaṃ bhavetnavāhaṃ dvividhaṃ caiva procyate kamalāsana !sūryavāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra havirnivedayettataḥnityotsavasya kāle tu kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇampraviśedālayaṃ tatra pādukārcanamācaretliṃge vā pratimāyāṃ vā tailābhyaṃgamihocyatehavirnivedayetpaścāllokapālabaliṃ kṣipetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvātodya samanvitamsāyaṃkāle samārabhya prātaḥkāle baliṃ dadetmaṇṭapāddakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayetkalaśānnavasamidājyacaruṃ caiva hutvā vai paṃcaviṃśatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: baliṃ dadyāttu viprendra sāyaṃkāle viśeṣataḥtīrthaṃ kuryāttato bidvānpraviśedālayaṃ pratimārtāṇḍīyamidaṃ proktaṃ * * rambhaṃ śṛṇu dvija !bherītāḍanapūrvaṃ ca trividhaṃ cocyate mayābherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu aṃkurārpaṇa pūrvakamevameva krameṇaiva trividhaṃ cocyate mayādviguṇīkṛtya vā kuryād dhvajamāropayettataḥbhauvane daivike kuryād anyeṣu ca vivarjayetyatpakṣe yaddine vāre astaṃ yāti divākaraḥanyeṣāṃ tithi na spṛṣṭaṃ tasmātpūrvaṃ vidhīyateitareṣāṃ ca viprendra tannadīṣu na kārayetyatpakṣe vāre astaṃ yāti divākaraḥśivasya ca vrataṃ kuryāt snapanaṃ tadanantaramutsavārambhamevoktaṃ vṛṣayāgamataḥ śṛṇuprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryān maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakamdarbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālā valambitamlokapālādhidaivatyaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tu lāṃcchayetvitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtammudgānnaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ upadaṃśaissamanvitamaṣṭadroṇena śāliṃ tu tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairapitasyopari nyasettatra kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayāpūrayedgandhatoyena suvarṇaṃ tatra nikṣipetpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭakumbhakānācamanaṃ dakṣiṇenyasya śuddhodakaṃ tu nair-ṛteuttare paṃcagavyaṃ tu īśāne ratnodakaṃ nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛṣabhaṃ madhyame nyasya ukṣāṇaṃ pūrvato nyasetnair-ṛtyāṃ nandinaṃ caiva paścime tu paśoḥ patimmahodakaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ vinyasetkalaśeṣu caaṣṭapadmaṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretuttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ navahastakamardhādhikatritālaṃ tu dhvajadairghyamihocyateardhādhika tritālaṃ tu kanyasaṃ tviha cocyatebrāhmaṇasya bhavecchvetaṃ kṣatriyasya ca raktakamvistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ pucchārdhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavetvṛṣabhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu raktavarṇaṃ tu śṛṃgakaunetraṃ śvetamayī caiva madhyaṃ raktamayī tathāpārśvau dīpadvayau nyasya citramūrdhve tu kārayetpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vṛṣamūrtiṃ nyasettataḥprokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥpūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vṛṣamūrtiṃ nyasettataḥtadbāhye pūjayettatra lokapālāstrameva capadmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaretvāmādīnāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ śūlaṃ mūle pratiṣṭhitaḥtaṭī caivāgnidaivatyaṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva daṇḍakegandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca ṣaṇṇavatyena pūjayettato homaṃ prakurvīta sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakamsamidājyacaruṃ lājān sarṣapaṃ caiva hūyatepratyekaṃ śatamardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyatedhvajārohaṇamevaṃ tu vakṣyāmi munisattamavarṇaṃ vai raktavarṇaṃ tu stambhanaṃ pītavarṇakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhūmraṃ vyādhipradaṃ caiva evameva krameṇa tuvarṣārdhaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu kṣīrābhaṃ sarvaśāntikampūrvāhne brāhmaṇaprītira madhyāhne rājavṛddhidamdhvajasthānamahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana !pīṭhāgrevā'tha kuryāttu dhvajasthānaṃ vidhīyatecampako devadāruṃ ca stambako bilvakairapiprāsādasya samaṃ vāpi prāsādagrīvameva vāmūlāntaṃ tu kulāntaṃ vā daṇḍasyotsedhamucyatedvādaśaṃ daśahastaṃ vā dhvajasyotsedhamucyatedvāviṃśatyaṃgulaṃ vātha nāhastasya vidhīyateekapūrvaṃ vināśārthaṃ dvipūrveṇa bhayaṃkarampaṃcaparvadvayaṃ loke ṣaṭparvaṃ śriyamāvahetnavaparvaṃ kulakṣīṇaṃ daśa vai sarvakāmadamita ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyaṃ hastamānaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuādhāraphalakādīni yājñikairvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥsuṣiradvayasaṃyuktaṃ kramukaṃ veṇunā sahapaṃcaṣaṭsaptamāṃgulyaṃ veṇudaṇḍasya nāhakamkaniṣṭhāṃgulīpramāṇena tantunā rajjurucyatemāṇavakaḥ śucirbhūtvā prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ* * anyadhvajaṃbandha kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇamnānādhvajasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃchasamāyutamnānācchatra samāyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣa samanvitamagrataḥ pṛṣṭhato gatvā ācāryo yajamānakaḥavaṭaṃ khānayettatra hastadvayapramāṇataḥṣaṭtālamadhyena vinyasya suvarṇaṃ kūrmameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayena tu mantreṇa kṣālayed dhvajadaṇḍakamvṛṣagāyatrīmantreṇa prokṣayetkalaśodakaiḥvālukena hṛdā caiva pūrayedavaṭaṃ tataḥṣaṭtālaṃ paṃcatālaṃ vā catustālamathāpi vātadūrdhve padmaṃ saṃkalpya aṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanamutsedhaṃ tu tridhā bhajya ekaikaṃ mekhalocchrayamśrīdevīṃ madhyame pūjya tṛtīye ca sarasvatīmekamekhalayā kuryād bhūmidevīṃ nyasettataḥyāgasthāne tathā devaṃ snāpayetkalaśena tuvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa paścātsūtre tu sūtrayetrajju yantreṇa vā kuryād dhvajamāropayettataḥśūlahastaḥ pinākī ca aṣṭanāḍī daṇḍamuṇḍiyaḥpūjayedgandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpadīpaiḥ samanvitampuṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra kalaśānnava vinyasetindrādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasetkalaśāṃstataḥsthāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vṛṣagāyatrimantrataḥtatkāle tu prajārthīnāṃ piṇḍān (vai) bhojayettataḥvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa piṇḍaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥ* * * * * kartavyaṃ dhvajamūle samāśritaḥantyajātistu sarveṣāṃ pratilomaṃ ca kārayettāmbūlaṃ dāpayettasmai janānsarvānviśeṣataḥiti vīratantre dhvajārohaṇa vidhiścatuścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥprātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne dhvajamāropayettataḥlakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !vyāghravṛkṣeṇa vā kuryādbherīṃ vā paṭahaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcatālaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt ṣaḍaṃgulyavihīnakamāyāmasya samaṃ nāhaṃ madhye paṭahamucyateevameva krameṇaiva kuryātpaṭahamuttamammardalairhāhalaiścaiva haṃsadhvanisamāyutamanyaiśca sarvavādyaiśca yathā lābhena tāḍayetmaṇḍapasya tu madhye tu gomayenānulepayetaṣṭadroṇena śāli syāt sthaṇḍilau dvau tu kārayettadardhaṃ taṇḍulairyuktaṃ prokṣayedambhasā tataḥpaṭahasya tadākāraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥtato'gre sthāpayecchalaṃ astramantreṇa deśikaḥevaṃ vai pūjayecchūktaṃ paścādbherīṃ samarcayetāpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayitvā kuśāmbhasādakṣiṇe rudramabhyarcya vāme viṣṇuriti smṛtamvāsukī carmasūtre tu valayau ravi candramāḥkauṇadaṇḍena saṃyuktaṃ pūjayedastramantrataḥśuklavastra paridhānaṃ gandhamālyaṃ tu lepanamarcayitvā yathā nyāyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinā tataḥācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vādyakaṃ pūjayettataḥtāḍayecchivamantreṇa ācāryau mantravigrahaḥkulodgato'pi dīnāśca tāḍayettālameva caindrasya samatālaṃ tu agnau badhvā vaṇaṃ bhavettatogrāmabaliṃ dadyāllakṣaṇena samanvitamdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃcha samanvitamtriśūlena samāyuktaṃ annaliṃga samāyutamvimāna pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryācchivabhakta samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmādyaiśānaparyantaṃ grāme caiva baliṃ dadetsarveṣāṃ tu gaṇānāṃ tu bhūtānāṃ tu piśācakaiḥdhvajamūle tu cāvāhya baliṃ tatraiva nikṣipetbherītāḍanamevoktaṃ yāgasya maṇḍapaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre bherītāḍanavidhiḥ paṃcacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥpratiṣṭhā cotsave caiva dīkṣāyāṃ prokṣaṇe'pi capūrvameva mayā proktaṃ bhūmisaṃgrahaṇaṃ dvijaindra īśānayormadhye (madhye) cānalaśakrayoḥkārayenmaṇḍapaṃ tatra lakṣaṇena samanvitamsaptaṣaṭpaṃcahastaṃ vā sapta * * * cocyateekāśīti padaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayedgandhavāriṇāṃveditāratnicotsedhaṃ darpaṇodaravatkṛtammadhyame tu pade caiva homakuṇḍaṃ vidhīyateuttare caiva viprendra kuṇḍaṃ syāccaturaśrakamsarveṣāṃ caturaśraṃ vā sarveṣāṃ vṛttameva vāīśāna indrayormadhye vṛttakuṇḍamiti smṛtamtrimekhalā samāyuktamekamekhalameva vācatustoraṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturdvāreṣu deśikaḥtrihastatālasaṃyuktamadhamaṃ tviti kathyatepalatraya samāyuktaṃ śūlaṃ tālasamaṃ bhavetuttamaṃ saptadarbhaiśca hastamātra pralambitamvitānoparisaṃcchannaṃ muktāsragdāma saṃyutampūrvāyāṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu āgneyyāṃ raktavarṇakampaścime pītavarṇaṃ tu vāyavyāṃ nīlameva calokapālasya rūpaṃ tu dhvajānāṃ madhyame nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṃgalamgadā triśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca padmaṃ ceti daśāyudhamhastamātra pramāṇena kārayedaṣṭamaṃgalamkṣālayettu mṛdā caiva śuddhatoyena saṃyutamvedibāhye nyasecchāli tatsamaṃ samalaṃkṛtamdarbhopari nyaseccaiva kūrcenaiva pidhāya caevameva nyasedvidvān aṣṭame navameva cavajrādīnarcayettatra svaiḥ svairnāmnā ca mantrataḥtato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ ekaṃ vā paṃcame'pi vāācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā pādāthīnpūjayettataḥiti vīratantre maṇḍapalakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥutsavasyādirātro tu ārabhedadhivāsanamvinyasetpālikādīni madhyame somakumbhakamsuguptadeśe saṃsthāpya pālikādīnyathākramampratimāṃ vinyasettatra astraṃ caiva tu vinyasetkārpāsasūtraṃ vā kuryāt prokṣayeddhṛdayena tutāmbūlaṃ dāpayetpaścājjanānsarvānviśeṣataḥtaṇḍulaistala saṃyuktaṃ darbhaiścaiva paristaretsasūtrānsāpidhānāṃśca savastrānvāripūritānratnāni vinyaseddhemaṃ gaurībījena vinyasetnānā vādyasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiṃcha samāyutamvimānaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedyāgamaṇṭapamācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā mantradehasamanvitaḥgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥyajñamūrtiṃ pravakṣyāmi ekavaktra samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmamadhye sukhāsīnaṃ jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyutamvaradābhayahastaṃ ca divyāmbaradharaṃ haramdvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ dvibhujāṃ ca suyauvanāmsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktāṃ vardhanīmadhyame nyasetdvārasyābhimukhaṃ caiva vinyasedyāgamūrtinampūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭakuṃbhānkramānnyasetvedikāścaiva digbhāge śūlaṃ vai sthāpayettataḥarcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svasvanāmnā viśeṣataḥgadā triśūlaṃ padmaṃ ca cakraṃ ceti daśāyudhampadmāstraṃ nair-ṛte bhāge cakraṃ caiśānagocareśrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭa maṃgalamgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya tattatsvanāmamantrataḥtato homaṃ prakurvīta lakṣaṇena tu deśikaḥsamidājya caruṃ lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānsamidhaḥ sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyatesarṣapānīśamantreṇa yavānvā yamamantrataḥnetreṇa mudgaṃ hutvātha śālīnastreṇa homayethutvā caiva viśeṣeṇa dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥsarvadravya samāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaranjayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛcca kramāddhunetkuryādadhyayanaṃ tatra caturovedapāragānsāyaṃ prātarbaliṃ dadyād homānte tu viśeṣataḥannaliṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvavallakṣaṇānvitampāśaṃ vāmakare caiva abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe kareevaṃ pāśupataṃ dhyātvā baliliṃgaṃ suyojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prathamaṃ vighnarātraṃ tu dvitīyaṃ bhūtarātrakampaṃcamaṃ tvindrarātraṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai ṛṣirātrakamnavamaṃ śaivamityāhu rityete rātridevatāḥpaṃcāhe tu prakartavyaṃ indrarātrādhivardhayetekāhamutsave caiva śivarātramiti smṛtamśuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ apūpaṃ laḍḍukānvitampadmapuṣpaṃ ca rajanī lājapāyasasaṃyutampadmamūlaṃ kuśāgraṃ ca śālyannaṃ ghṛtamiśrakamharidrānnaṃ sa sarpiśca nālikeraphalairyutamindravallī haridrānnaṃ priyaṃgughṛtasaṃyutamgulodanaṃ sasarpiśca kadalīpanasāyutamgulodanaṃ ghṛtaṃ yuktaṃ bṛhatīphalasaṃyutammāṣānnaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaṃ caṃpa samanvitamśuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ lājāpūpasamanvitamnavame'hani dātavyaṃ śivamantramanusmaranbrahmādīśānaparyantaṃ balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipetmātrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ vistārāyāma tatsamammekhaloccaṃ dvayāṃgulyaṃ veśanaṃ tāvadeva tuhastamātraṃ tu vistāraṃ utsedhaṃ tālamātrakamvistāraṃ tu tridhā kṛtvā ekaikaṃ dvidvihastakamraṃgeṣvārūḍhato vāpi rathedyāmau vrajettataḥprathame tu patākāśca dvitīye vādyakāstathāpaṃcame vānnaliṃgaṃ tu vitānavastra saṃyutamdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ ghaṇṭārava samanvitamcaṇḍarudrāya gosthāne vyāpya * * darāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣetreṣu kṣetrapālaṃ syāt sabhāsthāne sarasvatīevameva baliṃ kuryād balipīṭhe vinikṣipetkautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇamnānājanapadairyuktaṃ nānādhvaja samanvitamprathame ca patākāśca dvitīye vādyakastathāpaṃcame nṛtayantrāśca tadā yaṣṭitaṭātakānnavame tu * * * * vṛṣabhaṃ daśame tataḥbhikṣāṭanaṃ tadante tu ardhanārīṃ caturdaśaṣoḍaśe harirardhaṃ tu tadante kālahā vrajetbimbakordhve tu viprendra umāskandahitaṃ vrajetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā balidānasya deśikaḥālayaṃ praviśedvidvān pariveṣamathocyatedakṣiṇābhimukho vāpi pūrvābhimukha eva vāmahāmaryādau maryādau kuryānnoda maṇḍapamsnānaṃ kuryāttu viprendraṃ gandhapuṣpādinā'rcayetuttare nṛpatiṃ vidyād dvau pārśvau yoṣito nyasetdakṣiṇena tu śaivānāṃ uttare samayānsmitāntatkāle caiva viprendra pūrvoktavidhinā sahaarcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ dadyādvai dhūpadīpakampṛthak pātre vinikṣipya gaṇikā dhārayetkramātevameva prakāreṇa dinaṃ prati samācaretiti vīratantre adhivāsanavidhiḥ saptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥrākṣasānāṃ tu divase vanayātrāṃ samārabhettripurāntakarūpaṃ gacchedāyudhakaṃ dharetkeciddhanurdharāścaiva kecitkhaḍgadharāstathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evameva divā kuryād rātrau kautukabandhanamkautukaṃ caiva śūlaṃ ca vardhayetkautukaṃ hṛdāsthalikāṃ vinyasettatra taṇḍulānupari nyasetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya prāsādena tu mantrataḥnānādīpa samāyuktaṃ nānāvādya samanvitampūrvoktena tu mantreṇa śūlaṃ vai bandhayettataḥtīrthasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryācchivāgre maṇṭapaṃ tataḥmadhyame vinyasetkumbhaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakamhemaṃ tatraiva nikṣipya gandhapuṣpādinārcayettīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayet * * * tataḥdigbandhanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ astramantreṇa deśikaḥsādhitaiḥ kalaśaistatra śūlaṃ vai snāpayettataḥiti vīratantre yātrā kautukavidhiraṣṭacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥkautukaṃ balidānānte kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇamkautukasyāgrato vāpi cūrṇamabhyukṣya lūkhalegomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ śālinā kurupadmamaṣṭadalaṃ nyasya darbhaiścaiva paristaretplakṣodumbaramaśvatthaṃ padaṃvai na tu lūkhalamkṣālayedastramantreṇa sthāpayeddhṛdayena tulūkhale * * vinyasya madhyena hṛdayena tu* * * vyajanairyuktaṃ gaṇikā cūrṇayettataḥtakkolaṃ caiva jātī ca gaṇikā cūrṇayettataḥsavastra hemasaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayetmūlabimbe nyasettatra cūrṇaṃ caiva tu tailakambhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indrādi lokapālānāṃ cūrṇaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥgehaṃ praveśayettatra tatastīrthaṃ samācaretiti vīratantre cūṇotsavavidhirekonapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥsthaṇḍilaṃ śālinākuryāt taṇḍulaistilasaṃyutamgaurībījena mantreṇa vardhanīṃ tasya vāmataḥsvasvanāmnā ca mantreṇa pūjayettu viśeṣataḥkautukaṃ śivasaṃyuktaṃ kuryādgrāmapradakṣiṇamtīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuruarcayitvā tu gandhādyaiḥ śūlaṃ kalaśasaṃyutamkautukaṃ ca visṛjyaiva pratimāṃ śūlameva casahasnānaṃ tu yomartyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyatepūrṇāhutiṃ ca kṛtvā tu agniṃ caiva visarjayetsnapanaṃ kārayettatra lakṣaṇena samanvitamtadrātrau caiva viprendra baliṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥvāpayetsṛtayenāpi piṇyākena samāyutamsandhau catuṣpathe caiva devālaye śmaśānakebaliṃ dadyādviśeṣeṇa rājarāṣṭrasukhāvahamiti vīratantre tīrthavidhiḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥtīrthāhe vā tṛtīye vā paṃcāhe saptame'pi vātīrthāhe vā tṛtīye vā paṃcāhe saptame'pi vāsaptāhātparamaṃ caiva snapanaṃ tatra kārayetcaṇḍeśvarāgrataścaiva gomayenānulepayettilānvinyasya viprendra darbhaiścaiva paristaretnavakumbhānsamādāya sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayetsnāpayeccaiva caṇḍeśaṃ caṇḍamantreṇa buddhimān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caṇḍeśasyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī śucirbhavetpuṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtya gandhacandanakādibhiḥṭaṃkahastasamāyuktaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigrahamśibikordhve nyasettatra dhvajasthāne praveśayetdhvajāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayetkalaśānnavavṛṣamantramanusmṛtya dhvajaṃ vai sthāpayettataḥdiśāṃ baliṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhvajaṃ caiva visarjayetṭaṃkena cchedayettatra dhvajavedīṃ viśeṣataḥlājasakthu samāyuktaṃ haridrānnaṃ dadhisaṃyutamsandhisthaṃ pīṭhamudvāsya ṭaṃkenaiva tu chedayetācāryaścaivaṃ viprendra ! pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuruācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastradhānyādikāṃcanaiḥgaṇikānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettataḥkulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchatigacchecchivapuraṃ divyaṃ yāvanto dhṛti saṃplavamutsavasya vidhiḥ proktaḥ prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre utsavavidhirekapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥprāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !vināśasya tu saṃdhānaṃ prāyaścittamiti smṛtamakṛtānāṃ vinaṣṭānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate(prāsādaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuru)āgneyyāṃ vahninā dagdhaṃ dakṣiṇe maraṇaṃ bhavetvāyavyāṃ bandhuvṛddhiḥ syād uttare putravardhanamravātvaṃ vyapohya sarvaṃ tu sakalikenna bandhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādaṃ naṣṭamevaṃ syāt prāsādaṃ caiva kārayetpūrvasthānagataṃ liṃgaṃ anyasthānagataṃ bhavetpūrvadeśe calaṃ liṃgaṃ kiṃcideva tu saṃsthitamliṃgaṃ vā pīṭhamevaṃ vā sphuṭite dagdhameva vāvyapohyaiva tu talliṃgaṃ sthāpayennavaliṃgakamtalliṃgaṃ sthāpayedanyaddeśilakṣaṇa saṃyutamjalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāllakṣaṇanena samanvitamgulaṃ sākṣānmadhūcchiṣṭaṃ sajjarasamanvitamjalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt samīpe snapanaṃ bhavet* * * * * * * * śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetpratimasyāṃgahīnaṃ tu śilpinā kārayettataḥpratimāṃ caiva deveśaṃ parito viśvarairyutamhutvā pratiṣṭhāmārgeṇa sthāpayettadvadeva cayojayetpratimāṃ viprasnapanaṃ tatra kārayetbhinne ca sphuṭite caiva pramādācchedane'pi cajalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetsadyogandhādināpūjya śivamaṣṭaśataṃ japetpūrvavatparimanyā vā saṃprokṣaṇādi kārayetjvarādipīḍanaṃ kuryād upaśāntiṃ karoti cacatudikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥsamidājyacaruṃ lājā saktuṃ caiva tu hūyateaṣṭottaraśataṃ caivaṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥevameva krameṇaiva saptāhaṃ kārayeddvijaḥśaivāṃśca bhojayettatra savyaṣṭiparicārakāndinānte caiva viprendra ! rātrau grāmabaliṃ dadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ svasvanāmnā vinikṣipetnityārcanā vihīne tu śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetsandhyāṃ ca dvitrayo hīne paṃcagavyābhiṣecanamekāhe tritaye vāpi paṃcāhe vāpi hīnakediśāhomaṃ cārdhamāse tu snapanaṃ caiva kārayetsthitaliṃgamidaṃ proktaṃ calaliṃgamataḥ śṛṇutriṃśāttu divasādūrdhvaṃ snapanaṃ kārayettataḥnityāgnau ca vihīne tu dviguṇaṃ homamucyateparivāre tu vicchinne sthāpayetparivārakāngarbhagehe dīpahīnaṃ puṇyāhaṃ tatra kārayetnityotsave dīpahīne tu puṇyāhaṃ tatra kārayetśuddhanṛttavihīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayetśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryānnavaliṃgaṃ prakalpayetpratime patite vāpi snapanaṃ tatra kārayetjalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścānnityotsavaṃ kuruśvānakākādibhiḥ spṛṣṭe liṃge vā pratime'pi vākāle cotsavahīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayetpaṃcāhe balihīne tu diśāhomaṃ tu kārayetbalidravyavihīne tu dviguṇaṃ ca prayojayetbhinne vāṃgavihīne tu pratiśūlaṃ tathaiva caāvāhya śūlaṃ tatraiva baliśeṣaṃ samācaretaṣṭamaṃgalarūpe vā āyudhe vā vihīnaketatsvarūpaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā prokṣayetpūrvavatkramātsnapanaṃ tatra kurvīta caṇḍayāgaṃ tu kārayetcaṇḍayāgavihīne tu snapanaṃ tatra kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāgaśālāvihīne tu śāntihomaṃ hunettataḥdīpaṃ tatraiva saṃyojya taddoṣaśamanāya cagandhapuṣpavihīne tu dhūpahīne tathaiva caācāryastu viprendra ! pramādāvyādhisaṃbhaveputrapautrādinā caitacchiṣyeṇaiva tu kārayetvṛṣabhaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya sthāpayedvidhinā sahaśilpinā kārayetpīṭhaṃ sthāpayellakṣaṇairyutampunaḥ pūjāṃ samārabhya taddoṣaśamanāya capuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra punaḥ karmasamārabhetsnapanaṃ tatra kurvīta punarvārotsavaṃ kuruśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryādamāvāsyāṃ punaḥ kurusnapanaṃ tatra kurvīta punarmāsotsavaṃ kurupuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra punaḥ snapana mācaretkhanitvā cāstramantreṇa valmīkaiḥ pūrayettataḥprākāre maṇṭape vāpi prāsādasya samīpaketatkāle paṃcahavyaṃ tu tadevaṃ prokṣayettataḥbhūtavalyaṃ ca viprendra ! dīpahīnaṃ bhavettataḥagnikuṇḍavihīne tu śāntihomaṃ tu kārayethomagarbhe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ prokṣaṇe cotsave'pi vāśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanaṃ tatra kārayettraivarṇikakule jātā strīṇāmārtava saṃyutamprākāre gopure caiva paṃcagavyena śudhyatisnapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ taddoṣaśamanāya camantrahīne kriyāhīne dravyahīnasya kālakeupadaṃśādi vicchinne puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pīṭhapūjā vihīne tu puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥśuddhanṛttavihīne tu kuryātsnapanamuttamamśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhanṛttaṃ tu kārayetgaṇikābhṛtyavarge vā rajodṛṣṭena saṃbhavediśāhomaṃ tataḥ kuryān mahāhavirnivedayetpuṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra śāntihomaṃ ca kārayetiti vīratantre prāyaścittavidhiḥ dvipaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena vaktumarhasi me prabho !anāvṛṣṭyādikāleṣu jvaramārī pravartaneśatrūṇāṃ pīḍane kāle kṣīrasnānaṃ vidhīyateadhamaṃ raktajaṃ proktaṃ snāpayeddeśikottamaḥpaṃcagāvasamutpannā lokānugrahakāmyayākṣīrasnānaṃ tridhā proktaḥ muttamaṃ madhyamādhamamadhamaṃ caitaduddiṣṭaṃ madhyamaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuśivasya purato vipra ! gomayenānulepayetsūtrapātaṃ prakartavyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena tantunāuttarāgraṃ tathā sūtraṃ vinyaseddeśikottamaḥtadbāhyāvaraṇādbāhye padamekantu hrāsayetmadhyamena pade caivaṃ śālinā vikirettataḥparistarettu darbhaiśca prokṣayed hṛdayena tukalaśāngrāhayettena sūtreṇa veṣṭayettataḥmadhyame śivakumbhaṃ tu kṣīreṇaivābhipūrayetśivabījena mantreṇa sthāpayecchivakumbhakamsavastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ sāpidhānakamprathamāvaraṇe caiva kalaśānaṣṭa vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva ṣaṭtriṃśatkalaśānnyasetkṣīreṇa pūrayeddhīnaṃ savastraṃ sāpidhānakamprathamāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvarāṃśca vinyasettṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva brahmā tatrādhidevatātato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ navapaṃcaikameva vāagnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvoktena krameṇa tumudgamāṣasamāyuktaṃ navadravyamihocyateaghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājānvāmena caiva hitilānvai śiromantreṇa mudgaṃ tu śikhayā yutamaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥghṛtamikṣeti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaramācāryaṃ pūjayettatra padārthīnpūjayettataḥgaurībījena mantreṇa vardhanīṃ snāpayettataḥpaṃcāśadbhiḥ paṃcaviṃśadbhiḥ snāpayetsnapanoktavatdadhisnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ ghṛtasnānaṃ tathaiva caiti vīratantre kṣīrābhiṣekavidhistripaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥkuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho !sruksruvāṇāṃ vidhiṃ caiva śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !dahatyaśeṣabhāvena tatkuṇḍamiha saṃjñitamsnapane dīkṣākāle tu pavitrārohaṇādiṣuhastamātra pramāṇena mātrāṃgula samanvitamyonyādi sarvakuṇḍāni caturaśre prajāyateyāmyāyāmardhacandraṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ tu trikoṇakamsaumyāyāṃ saptakoṇaṃ tu aiśānyāmaṣṭakoṇakamkarṇasūtrasya mokṣāṃśaṃ paścime vinyasettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇe cottare vṛttaṃ kārayeddeśikottamaḥkoṇādi tatra sūtraṃ ca vinyaseddeśikottamaḥcaturaśrasya karṇaṃ tu grāhayettu dvijottamaḥbhāgamekaṃ nyasetpūrve madhyātpūrvādi bhrāmayetaṣṭabhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ ekabhāgaṃ tu dakṣiṇevinyaseccaiva viprendra ! tena mānena sūtrakamsaptabhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vinyasetpūrvamekaśaḥkarṇārdhamaṣṭadhā bhitvā karṇārdhena samanvitamlikeśāṃśaṃ tu kṣetraṃ syātpūrvamekena vinyasetkṣetraṃ dvātriṃśadaṃśaṃ tu kṣetrārdhena tu yojayetvasubhāgakṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ dakṣiṇe cārdhabhāgataḥtasmānmadhyaṃ gṛhītvā tu kṛtvā ṣaṭkoṇameva cadakṣiṇe cottare caikaṃ koṇamityabhidhīyateaṣṭapatrasamaṃ kṛtvā padmakuṇḍamihocyateabhyantare tu vinyasya caturdikṣu viśeṣataḥlāṃchanaṃ koṇakaṃ gṛhya etadabhyantarasya tuathavānyaprakāreṇa kuṇḍaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥmekhalāṃ ca prakartavyaṃ vistārotsedhatatsamamadhastānmekhalā vipra ! dvyaṃgulaṃ tadihocyatevistāraṃ caturaṃgulyaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu dairghyakamhastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ vistāraṃ talameva tumadhye nābhiṃ prakalpyātha ekāṃgulaṃ tu viṣṭharamvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśamsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ yājñikaṃ vṛkṣameva vāvaikaṃkatamayaṃ vāpi kuryādastramanuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistāraṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ ghanaṃ tasyārdhamucyatemadhye padmamṛjuṃ kṛtvā bahirvakraṃ tu pārśvayoḥtadadho gaṇḍikāṃ kuryādardhāṃgulena kārayetmadhyame gaṇḍikāṃ kuryādaṃguladvyamānataḥevameva krameṇaiva dvayoragraṃ tu śūlavatcaturaṃgulavistāraṃ dīrghaṃ pūrvavadeva tutasyocchrayaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ ekāṃgulena gaṇḍikātadūrdhve tadadhaścāpi dvābhyāmaṃgulinā bhavetvajravatphalakā caiva tadūrdhve gaṇḍikāṃguliḥghaṭasyoccaṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ tadadho gaṇḍikāṃguliḥpūrvavaddīrghamevaṃ syān madhye vakraṃ tathaiva camūle tu phalakāṃ kṛtvā vistāraṃ tu ṣaḍaṃgulamtaddīrghaṃ phalakāṃ kṛtvā madhye pāśaṃ tu lekhayetdīrghaṃ tu pūrvavatkṛtvā agre sūcīmukhaṃ tataḥcaturaṃguladairghyaṃ tu nāhamekāṃgulaṃ bhavetgadāṃ tu daṇḍavatkṛtvā agre sūciṃ tu kārayetpālikā tu catuṣkoṇe vṛṣabhaṃ sthāpayetpunaḥcakrasya śūlavanmānaṃ vṛttarūpamihocyateevaṃ cakraṃ samākhyātaṃ padmaṃ caiva śṛṇuṣvathapaṃcāṃgulaṃ tu viprendra ! daṇḍanāhamihocyateṣoḍaśāṃguladairghyaṃ syādaṣṭāṃgulaṃ tu vistaramdarpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugmacāmaramvinyasetphalakāmadhye aṣṭamaṃgalamucyatevarṇena lekhayitvā tu lāṃchayecchilpinā tataḥsruvasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye caturviṃśatiraṃgulī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇaṃ triyaṃgulaṃ proktaṃ mānaṃ pūjyākṣayaṃ bhavetnāsikāvadbaliṃ kṛtvā sruvalakṣaṇamucyateṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulāyāmaṃ aṣṭāṃgulasuvistaramagraṃ caiva tribhāgaikaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ tu dairghyakamrasāṃgula pravistāraṃ karṇaṃ caiva samāhitaḥaṣṭāṃgulena vediḥ syād vistāra tāvadeva tumadhyame caturaṃgalyaṃ baliṃ caiva tu kārayetdvayoḥ paṭṭikayormadhye yavadvayaṃ tu nimnakambilāccaiva mukhāntaṃ syātkhātaṃ kaniṣṭhamānataḥgajoṣṭra sadṛśākāraṃ matsyapṛṣṭhākṛtirbhavettadadho gaṇḍikā bāhyāṃ tadadho gaṇḍikāṃ śṛṇudvayāṃgulapramāṇena ghaṭaṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥpaṃcahastapramāṇena uttamaṃ toraṇocchrayamutsedhārdhaṃ tu vistāraṃ phalakāṃ caiva vinyasetevaṃ toraṇamākhyātaṃ darbhamālāṃ śṛṇuṣvathaadhamaṃ trīṇi darbhāṇi tadagre rajju rucyateparidhīlakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ śubhamṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulāyāmaṃ tridhā darbhaiḥ paristaretcatvāri viṣṭharaṃ kuryādājyasthālyādikaṃ śṛṇuvistāraṃ ca ṣaḍaṃgulyaṃ utsedhaṃ tu dvayāṃgulamājyaṃ sruvaprapūrṇaṃ ca hastamātrapramāṇataḥannamakṣa pramāṇena gulaṃ vai tatpramāṇataḥsthalikā caiva kartavyā hastamātra pramāṇataḥpīṭhoccaṃ tu tripādīṃśca kārayeddeśikottamaḥmadhyamaṃ paṃcadarbhaistu saptadarbhaistu cottamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kūrcānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ vastrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuuttamaṃ dvādaśa proktaṃ vistāraṃ paṃcatālakamṣaṭsapta caiva dīrghaṃ syādaṣṭatālaṃ tu vistaramkuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śāntihomaṃ śṛṇuṣvathaiti vīratantre kuṇḍādilakṣaṇavidhiścatuḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥmūrtihomaṃ kathaṃ śaṃbho ! brūhi me parameśvara !pūrvoktamaṇḍapaṃ vāpi agniśālāmathāpi vācaturaśraṃ vātha vṛttaṃ agnikuṇḍaṃ tu kārayetevaṃ tatraiva saṃkalpya darpaṇodaravatkṛtammathitvā tu gṛhītvā tu hṛdayena pratiṣṭhitamupasthānaṃ śirasā kṛtvā paristaraṇameva cadakṣiṇe paścime caiva uttare ca paristaretpātrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ caiva hūyate kramaśastataḥaghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā juhuyāttu śatāhutiḥśāntihomamitikhyātaṃ diśāhomaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuiti vīratantre śāntihomavidhiḥ paṃcaḥ paṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥdiśāhomaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana !agnimukhaṃ ca saṃkalpya pūrvoktena vidhānataḥprāsādasya caturdikṣu pūrve tu caturaśrakampadmaṃ caiva tu saumyāyāṃ kuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ tu vāaśvatthaṃ vāruṇe caiva vaṭaṃ caivottare diśisahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vāājyena caruṇā caiva juhuyāttu śatāhutiḥdravyānte caiva dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥśivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ śālibhiḥ kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa vastraṃ sa hiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcaṃ vāripūritamādityaśca tathācāgniḥ somo dharaṇireva capūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥkalaśānbāhyato vipra ! aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭa homayetekaikāṣṭaśataṃ caiva īśānādīni hūyatehavirnivedayetpaścāt śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥprāsāde maṇṭape caiva liṃgasthāpanakarmaṇiudyāne vāpi viprendra ! vāstuhomaṃ tu kārayetsamarīya pade kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ sikatena vāśuddhatoyena saṃpūrya homaṃ tatraiva nikṣipetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya ullekhanaṃ tu kārayetaghorāstreṇa cā likhya prokṣayetpuruṣeṇa tuparistareta darbhaiśca pūrvoktena paristaretpraṇītāmuttare sthāpya brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe yajetājyādhiśravaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥdakṣiṇe cottare caiva uttare paridhīnnyasettūṣṇīmadhyaṃ tu dadyāttu aghoraṃ caiva hūyatecaruṃ hutvārthabhasmannājyaṃ vāstoṣpateti casadyādīśānaparyantaṃ ghṛtenaiva tu homayetpāyasānnaṃgulaṃ yuktaṃ ghṛte naiva pariplutamjayādirabhyadhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛccaiva hūyatesviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantarepariṣecanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paridhānyāni dhāpayetpraṇītodakena saṃprokṣya pavamānamudīrayansavatsāṃgāṃ pradadyāttu ācāryāya viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kriyāśarīramityuktaṃ dakṣiṇā jīva ucyatetasmātsarvaprayatnena ācāryaṃ pūjayetsadāvāstuhomamitikhyātaṃ sakalārādhanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre mūrti vāstuhomaḥ ṣaṭpaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥsakalārādhanaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabhojalasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā bhasmasnānaṃ samācaretuttarābhimukho bhūtvā pūrvābhimukha eva vātasyaiva vāmabhāge tu darbhaiścaiva paristaretpādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ hṛdayena tu vinyasettripādamadhyame caiva śaṃkhaṃ caiva tu vinyasetrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca samācaretphaṭkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ daśadikṣu ca śodhayetīśānamaṃguṣṭhe nyasya tarjanyāṃ caiva deśikaḥpuruṣaṃ tarjanīṃ nyasya aghoraṃ madhyame nyasetṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasettatra pūrvoktena vidhānataḥśikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥīśānamūrtiṃ vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyasetsadyojātaṃ nyasetpāde vinyasettu viśeṣataḥmukhe viṣṇuṃ nyasedvidvānkarṇayoraśvinau nyasetādityaṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau somaṃ vinyasya vāmakevaruṇaṃ dakṣiṇe jānau apare vāyurucyatevinyasetsṛṣṭimūrtīnāṃ sṛṣṭi nyāsamudāhṛtamsaṃhāramūrtināṃ caiva saṃhāra nyāsamucyateevaṃ nyāsavidhānena paścātpūjanamārabhettālamātrapravistāraṃ tadardhaṃ cocchrayaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātrāṃgulena kartavyaṃ mekhaloccaṃ dvayāṃgulampratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ pīṭhe karmārcanaṃ yajetcalaṃ caivācalaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ pratimaṃ bhavetśilābhirmṛṇmayairvāpi bhitticitre paṭe'pi vāśailajaṃ pratimaṃ caiva abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetlohajaṃ pratimaṃ caiva snāpayetprokṣayettu vāpīṭhe saṃpūjayettatra parivāra samanvitamkevalaṃ sthāpita idamanyacchṛṇuṣvathaparivāraṃ na kartavyaṃ śrībilvaṃ ca na kārayetvīrāsanaṃ tadūrdhve tu kalpayeddeśikottamaḥniṣkalāśritaṃ yattu āsanāvaraṇāyutampratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ tiṣṭhantadyenameva vāāsīnastatra sakalaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥanyarūpaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ cedvināśanamvastramābharaṇaṃ caiva kṣālayecchuddhirucyatevastraṃ datvā tvaghoreṇa gandhaṃ vai śirasā dadetdīpaṃ sadyena dadyāttu hṛdayena havirdadetpūrvoktena krameṇaiva garbhāvaraṇakaṃ yajetevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ sarvapāpādvimucyatesakalārādhanaṃ proktaṃ vighneśasthāpanaṃ śṛṇuiti vīratantre sakalārādhanavidhiḥ saptapaṃcāśaḥ paṭalaḥguruvaktrāttu vijñeyaṃ anyathā naiva kathyateīśādisadyaparyantaṃ uddharettu yathā kramamcakraṃ trayodaśaṃ grāhya paṃcadaśa samanvitamvāsavasya caturthaṃ ca śūlādyaṃ ca tataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajraṃ tena samāyuktaṃ īśānasya tṛtīyakamtadeva punaruddhṛtya agnibījena vā yutamvaruṇasya tṛtīyaṃ tu vāsavena samanvitamvajradvitīyasaṃyuktaṃ varuṇasya tu paṃcamamtatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavanvaktumarhasitatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !lokadravyādbubhukṣante eteṣāṃ vighnāya pūjayetprāsādaṃ kārayettatra śāstradaṣṭena karmaṇāvyomavyāpi japitvā tu karṣayeddeśikottamaḥpakṣe santi ca sarvāṇi gogaṇānāṃ nivedayetdarpaṇodaravatkṛtvā gomayenānulepayetpūrvokte caiva nakṣatre yoge ca karaṇānvitedvārasya dakṣiṇe pārśve prathameṣṭāṃ tu vinyasetśilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā dārumṛdbhirathāpi vānavahastaṃ paṃcahastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vāpi kārayetprāsādasyavaśādvidvā prākāraṃ kārayettataḥpaṃcatālottamaṃ viddhi catustālaṃ tu madhyamamṣoḍaśāṃśe vibhajyaṃ tu upānamekabhāgikamekena paṭṭikāṃ kuryād grīvā caiva triyaṃśakampīṭhotsedhaṃ caturbhāgaṃ padmamūrdhve prakalpayetuttamaṃ lohajaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu śilāmayamsauvarṇaṃ caiva saubhāgyaṃ mokṣārthī rajataṃ bhavetcalitaṃ lohajaṃ caiva ratnajaṃ dārujaṃ tu vāsthāpitaṃ tu parārthaṃ syādanyadātyārthamucyategajānanaṃ gajakarṇaṃ lambodaraṃ tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ caiva tu mūrtīnāṃ svanāmādyakṣarairyutamtasya yantraṃ vadāmīha sarvāśubhanivāraṇamlikhitvāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ kesarāsya sakarṇakamvinyasedaṣṭapatreṣu aṣṭamūrtyakṣarānbudhaḥpūjayettu viśeṣeṇa mūlamantreṇa homayetsarvaroga (haraṃ hyetat) siṃhadṛṣṭagajaṃ yathārohiṇyādityapuṣyeṣu hastapauṣṇatriruttarāsthirarāśau tu kartavyaṃ ubharāśāvathāpi vāāsīnaṃ vā sthitaṃ vāpi vāhanārūḍhameva vānānābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ nāgayajñopavītinampaṃcatālena kuryāttu pratimāṃ kārayecchubhāmpādoccaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ tu kuryātpratimamuttamamvāme pāśasamāyuktaṃ dakṣiṇe cākṣasūtrakamevaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ pratimāṃ kārayedbudhaḥṣaḍbhujenaiva kartavyaṃ paracakra jayecchatāmadhyamaṃ caturaṃśena trayaṃśamadhamaṃ bhavettāla saṃkhyākramaṃ vakṣye adhamaṃ tālamucyateyajamānecchayā yuktaṃ śilpinā kārayettataḥkāmadaṃ mokṣaphaladaṃ sarvapāpavināśanamśuddhasnānamanuprāpya śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tato budhaḥakārādi kṣakārāntā nyakṣarāṇi vilekhayetdvivargasya tṛtīyaṃ tu prathamasya caturthakammūlamaṃtramidaṃ proktaṃ vighneśvarasya padmaja !eteṣāṃ sthāpaneṣūktaṃ vibhavasyānurūpataḥprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ paṃktimānamathocchrayaḥkramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ vā avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ tathāmadhyame vedikāṃ kuryāt paritaḥ kuṇḍamucyatevajraṃ pūrve tu vinyasya āgneyyāṃ tu pravālakamvāruṇyāṃ padmarāgaṃ tu vaiḍūryaṃ vāyugocaremadhyame caiva māṇikyaṃ vinyasettu viśeṣataḥtato devaṃ samāyojya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥevameva prakartavyaṃ lohajānāṃ viśeṣataḥnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana !nayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvokte maṇṭape śubheaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālībhiḥ tadardhaistaṇḍulairapitatraiva pratimāṃ sthāpya pūrvābhimukhameva vāabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasettoyapūritāngandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdinā pūjayettataḥakṣihomaṃ tataḥ kuryādājyenaiva tu deśikaḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutimathācaretpadmarekhāṃ samālikhya tanmadhye kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamhemapūrvaṃ tathā caiva madhvājyaṃ vinyasettataḥmadhuvāteti mantreṇamadhunā tarpayettataḥgaṇānāṃ ceti mantreṇa savatsāṃgāṃ pradarśayetprokṣayedbrāhmaṇāstatra sākṣataṃ sakuśodakamprokṣayetkalaśānvipra ! paṃcabrahmeṇa saṃyutamgeyanṛttasamāyuktaṃ jayaśabdaissamanvitampaṃcamṛtpaṃcagavyaiśca paṃcāṃgaiśca samanvitamrathevā śibikāyāṃ vā pratimāṃ ropya bhaktitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratimāṃ paṃcagavyena snāpayeddhṛdayena tumūlamantreṇa viprendra ! jale caivādhivāsanamabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vidyeśvara samanvitānekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā paṃcarātramathāpi vājalāduttīrya pūrvedyuḥ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu deśikaḥnavavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥśālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ nyasetanḍajaṃ muṇḍajaṃ caiva romajaṃ carmajaṃ tathātasyopari nyasedbījaṃ kūrcenaiva samanvitamabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vinyasenmūrtisaṃyutānsavastrānsāpidhānāṃśca sahiraṇyānsakūrcakānvighneśaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥlokapālāṃśca kumbhāni vinyasetpūrvameva cavṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā sarvakuṇḍāni kārayetplakṣāśvatthaṃ ca nyagrodhaṃ bilvaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥpālāśaṃ caiva viprendra ! navakuṇḍeṣu homayetsarveṣāmapyalābhe tu palāśasamidhā yutamkadalīphalasaṃyuktaṃ homayeddeśikottamaḥhṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śikhāmantreṇa hūyatehutvā hutvā spṛśedbimbaṃ dravyaṃ prati viśeṣataḥlaḍḍukaṃ nālikeraṃ ca mātuluṃgaphalāni cacaturdikṣu caturvedaiḥ kuryādadhyayanaṃ tataḥsnānavedyāṃ samānīya snāpayenmūlamantrataḥśilādīnsthāpayedvidvāndeśe'pi tu pade'pi cayajanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva caturānana !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmaṃ carettatra paścādbrahmāṇi vinyasethṛdayātpaṃca vinyasya vighneśaṃ hṛdaye nyasetpādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakamtato lohajaberaṃ cet snātvā parvaṇi parvaṇimṛṇmaye bhitticitre vā pīṭhe karmārcanaṃ bhavetsiṃhaṃ padmaṃ ca vimalaṃ yathā krameṇa vinyasetcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca prasannavadanānvitamnirmālyaṃ ca visṛjyātha śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥpuṣpaṃ vai śikhayā caiva vāmo dhūpaṃ ca dīpakambhakṣyaṃ caiva gaṇānāṃtvā evameva krameṇa tupuruṣaṃ pūrvadeśe tu aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tuīśānyāmīśamantraṃ tu āgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasetīśānyāṃ ca śiraścaiva netramastraṃ diśāsu caśukraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ caiva aśvinyau ca tathaiva caśāstā caiva tu durgā ca pradakṣiṇe krameṇa tuvibudhamīśadigbhāge nirmālyaṃ dhārakaṃ nyasetpūrvoktena vidhānena agnimukhaṃ ca kalpayetsaptāhutiṃ ca vighneśaṃ mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥnityotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryādvighneśa pratimānvitambrahmacārī śucirbhūtvā soṣṇīssottarīyakaḥpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā ālayaṃ tu praveśayetutsavaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsanaprāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapaṃ kārayettataḥmudgamāṣa samāyuktaṃ sarṣapena samanvitamsugupte sthāpayettatra dhvajārohaṇamārabhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00253 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
